papers.title: DotSpace: A New Kind of Network for People and Their Agents
papers.abstract: We introduce DotSpace, a network paradigm in which people and their agents participate as first-class members. Participants interact in persistent shared spaces, forming relationships, exchanging knowledge and taking action across ownership boundaries, while each owner retains authority over their own agents. In such a network, relationships can become channels for coordinated action: people and their agents share context, make decisions, create things and maintain ongoing commitments together, while their agents carry the work forward between people's visits. Our central proposition is that persistent networks of people and their agents can widen access to distributed capabilities and support increasingly complex collective activity. Over time, such networks may become environments in which knowledge, practices and capabilities develop, shaping both what participants can accomplish and how they organize their activity together.

papers.title: PrivacyFlow: Privacy in AI Agents through Information Flow Analysis and Consequence-Aware Risk Management
papers.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents executing multi-step workflows over personal data often misalign with user privacy expectations and leak sensitive, out-of-context information. Although Contextual Integrity (CI) formalizes this problem, existing benchmarks and defenses rarely operationalize CI for realistic multi-step task sequences in evolving environments. In this work, we first introduce agentic PrivacyBench, a benchmark of 5873 tasks in 986 task sequences with dynamic environment updates and CI-grounded allow-sets for sensitive information. We also introduce PrivacyFlow, a defense that separates deliberative privacy planning (System 2) from task execution (System 1), treating each sharing decision as a structured risk-management problem. Before execution, PrivacyFlow traces the provenance and purpose of each planned data flow, models recipient background knowledge, and simulates what external actors could infer. This allows us to model the downstream consequences of disclosure, including inference attacks and context-dependent harms. It then weighs the remaining disclosure risk against task utility and executes a minimized plan, blocks it, or consults the user. Across six models, PrivacyFlow significantly reduces step-level privacy failures and raises the share of completed task sequences without a detected privacy violation by 22--55 percentage points. We further highlight a new privacy--utility--autonomy tradeoff: allowing PrivacyFlow to proactively prompt the user in case of uncertainty can increase authorized task completion at the cost of shifting decision effort back to the user. Our results suggest that proactive CI reasoning can substantially improve agentic privacy and motivate further study of this tradeoff.

papers.title: Characterizing LLM Agent Behaviors in Module Shadowing Environments
papers.abstract: LLM agents operating in untrusted workspaces face the risk of untrusted code execution during routine tasks, yet final reports and workspace states alone cannot reliably establish whether execution occurred. We introduce an evaluation framework that codes observation, reasoning, execution, and response behaviors from agent trajectories and aligns them with independent environmental records to reconstruct execution histories and verify final reports. We apply this framework to module shadowing, in which a local file is loaded in place of a trusted module during import, enabling untrusted code execution without adversarial prompts. Across 90 trials with 15 models, the payload executed in 51% of direct shadowing trials and 87% of indirect shadowing trials. Even explicit recognition of the shadowing mechanism did not ensure prevention, as the payload ran in 10 of the 29 trials with recorded recognition. These failures were often omitted from final reports, as 49 of the 62 triggered trials ended without mention of the security issue. Three reports even denied execution, including one from a trial in which independent logs recorded 19 payload executions. Final workspace states also obscured prior execution when agents deleted or overwrote the payload marker in 10 triggered trials. These findings demonstrate that combining behavioral coding with independent environmental auditing enables rigorous and transparent evaluation of agent safety.

papers.title: MetaVul: Agentic Harness Discovery for Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to automate vulnerability detection, but reliable detection is challenging because agents must distinguish subtle, security-relevant fixes from benign code variation. While underlying LLM capability has improved significantly, the accuracy of the agent still depends heavily on the harness: the code that defines the scaffolding around the LLM. Harnesses are typically fixed, and largely hand-written, limiting adaptation to evaluator feedback. Additionally, when harnesses are static, improvements on one dataset or model may not transfer to others. To address these challenges, we introduce MetaVul, a self-improving framework for harness discovery in vulnerability detection. Starting from a seed structured reasoning scaffold, MetaVul uses a workflow-based optimization loop to iteratively refine the harness using feedback from paired vulnerable and patched functions, while preserving the structured reasoning and verdict format. At each iteration, it searches over the history of prior harnesses, with access to their trajectories, logs, and metrics, and it returns a set of Pareto-optimal harnesses. We apply MetaVul to discover agent harnesses for various architectures. A validation set (202 pairs) is used for optimization, while an unseen dataset (430 pairs) is kept as the held-out set. We test whether harnesses learned from one model transfer to others not seen during optimization. Results on both frontier and small LLMs show that the optimized harnesses improve pairwise vulnerability detection up to 23.3 percentage points on the validation set and up to 25.8 points on the held-out set with a Pareto-frontier harness. Harnesses learned with one model also transfer to others. We show that harnesses optimized with one model transfer to another, improving held-out pairwise accuracy by 14.7 points without further optimization.

papers.title: Li$^{2}$SAO: Lifting Light Singl-Rollout Asynchronous RL Optimization via Group-Relative Actor-Critic Bootstrapping
papers.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming a mainstream paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), as it improves training efficiency by updating the model as rollouts arrive. Recent work argues that group-wise sampling in GRPO does not naturally fit asynchronous RL training because rollout lengths follow a long-tailed distribution, and proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) to improve stability and off-policy behavior, especially on agentic tasks. However, SAO relies on a closed-source value model obtained from scaling value pretraining. In this paper, we analyze GRPO and LiSAO, our lightweight reproduction of SAO without the pretrained value model, on single-turn reasoning and multi-turn agentic tasks. We find that GRPO outperforms LiSAO on reasoning tasks, while the reverse holds on agentic tasks. Since the value model of LiSAO is not yet well trained , LiSAO lags behind GRPO substantially in early training steps. To address this issue, we propose Li$^{2}$SAO, which Lifts Light Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization with group-relative actor-critic bootstrapping: while the critic is cold, a group-relative advantage trains the actor and a group-centered return trains the critic, after which training switches to single-rollout GAE. Experiments show that Li$^{2}$SAO catches up with or surpasses GRPO in early training and further raises the later performance ceiling. Code is available at this https URL.

papers.title: RiskyPy: Toward Model-Calibrated Prompt Generation for Joint Security and Functionality Evaluation of LLM-Generated Code
papers.abstract: Evaluating approaches that improve the security of LLM code generation requires datasets that jointly assess security and functionality and remain adapted to the capabilities of the models being studied. However, existing benchmarks are costly to produce and are generally not calibrated to a chosen range of model capabilities. We introduce RiskyPy, an automated pipeline that generates security-oriented code-generation datasets calibrated to model proficiency using functionality and vulnerability canaries. We instantiate RiskyPy for Python using domains covering 18 CWEs from the 2025 CWE Top 25, producing 101 prompts. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Seed-Coder-8B show that the generated tasks remain functionally accessible, with 57-72% of prompts yielding functional code, while only 5-10% of generations are free of Bandit findings, leaving room for joint evaluation of security and functionality of security improvement approaches.

translation.title: RiskyPy：面向模型校准提示生成的LLM生成代码安全性与功能性联合评估
translation.abstract: 评估提升LLM代码生成安全性的方法需要能够联合评估安全性与功能性、并适配所研究模型能力的数据集。然而，现有基准构建成本高，且通常未针对特定模型能力范围进行校准。我们提出RiskyPy，一个自动化流水线，利用功能性金丝雀和漏洞金丝雀生成与模型能力水平相校准的面向安全的代码生成数据集。我们针对Python实例化RiskyPy，涵盖2025年CWE Top 25中的18个CWE领域，生成101个提示。在Qwen3-4B和Seed-Coder-8B上的实验表明，生成的任务在功能上仍可完成，57-72%的提示能产生功能性代码，而仅有5-10%的生成结果不含Bandit发现，为安全改进方法的安全性与功能性联合评估留出了空间。
translation.brief: 针对现有代码安全基准成本高且未按模型能力校准的问题，提出利用功能性与漏洞金丝雀自动生成与模型能力相匹配的安全导向代码生成数据集的流水线RiskyPy。

papers.title: Prevented is Not Protected: What Attack Success Rate Hides about RAG
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is vulnerable to knowledge poisoning, where adversaries manipulate retrieved evidence to influence model outputs. Existing defenses are primarily evaluated using attack success rate (ASR), which obscures defense-induced failures and the mechanisms behind apparent attack prevention. To address this issue, this work introduces \textbf{Aligned RAG Evaluation}, a matched-query protocol that jointly examines clean and poisoned responses, with and without defense. By combining matched conditions analysis, LLM-judge endorsement, and retrieval dependence controls, the proposed framework distinguishes prevented from introduced failures, target mentions from LLM endorsement, and single-passage influence from evidence composition. Experiments on HotpotQA and Natural Questions reveal that existing defenses can introduce unexpected target-positive answers, although they can prevent some attacks, while evaluation criteria can also change defense rankings. Our findings expose critical blind spots in ASR-based evaluation and motivate a more comprehensive assessment of RAG poisoning defenses. The code and the evaluation artifact are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 被阻止不等于被保护：攻击成功率掩盖了RAG的什么问题
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）容易受到知识投毒攻击，攻击者通过操纵检索到的证据来影响模型输出。现有防御主要用攻击成功率（ASR）评估，这掩盖了防御引发的失败以及表面攻击被阻止背后的机制。为解决这一问题，本工作提出Aligned RAG Evaluation，一种匹配查询协议，联合考察干净与被投毒响应、有无防御的情况。通过结合匹配条件分析、LLM裁判认可和检索依赖控制，所提框架能够区分被阻止的失败与被引入的失败、目标提及与LLM认可、单段落影响与证据组合影响。在HotpotQA和Natural Questions上的实验表明，现有防御虽然能阻止部分攻击，但可能引入意外的目标肯定性回答，且评估标准也会改变防御排名。我们的发现揭示了基于ASR评估的关键盲区，推动对RAG投毒防御进行更全面的评估。代码和评估工件见此https链接。
translation.brief: 针对攻击成功率（ASR）掩盖RAG投毒防御缺陷的问题，提出匹配查询协议Aligned RAG Evaluation，联合分析干净与投毒、有无防御条件下的响应以区分被阻止与被引入的失败。

papers.title: CLIC: Closed-Loop Intent Consistency for Securing LLM-Driven Control in Open RAN
papers.abstract: With the progressive capabilities of large language models (LLMs), researchers are finding ways to integrate them into the control loops of Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN) to enable slicing and resource management through user intents. However, integration of LLMs in the O-RAN control loop via the RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) makes the system vulnerable to \textit{runtime prompt injection threats}, which manipulate control decisions without violating interface authentication, and \textit{residual virtual prompt injection (VPI)} attacks that plant trigger mechanisms to silently steer the behaviour during fine-tuning. Existing studies address only the runtime threat and do not enforce consistency across the full control path, i.e. from the certified A1 intent, through the multi-step LLM trajectory, to the final E2 action. We propose a closed-loop intent-consistency layer (CLIC) that jointly mitigates both threats. The proposed CLIC defines a formal consistency score using a small quantized language model, which is deployed as a Non-RT rApp for model-integrity certification along with a Near-RT xApp for runtime enforcement. We implement CLIC on the OpenAI Cellular (OAIC) platform and evaluate it under domain-adapted JailbreakBench, AdvBench, and VPI workloads. The experimental results show that the proposed CLIC reduces the attack success rate from 0.92 to 0.29 and residual VPI attacks from 0.37 to 0.04, while improving isolation and fairness at slightly higher latency costs, i.e. approximately 27 ms.

translation.title: CLIC：用于保障Open RAN中LLM驱动控制安全的闭环意图一致性
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力的不断提升，研究者正探索将其集成到Open Radio Access Network（O-RAN）的控制回路中，通过用户意图实现切片和资源管理。然而，通过RAN智能控制器（RIC）将LLM集成到O-RAN控制回路中，使系统容易受到运行时提示注入威胁（在不违反接口认证的情况下操纵控制决策）和残余虚拟提示注入（VPI）攻击（在微调期间植入触发机制以悄然引导行为）。现有研究仅解决运行时威胁，且未在整个控制路径上强制一致性，即从经认证的A1意图，经过多步LLM轨迹，到最终的E2动作。我们提出闭环意图一致性层（CLIC），联合缓解这两种威胁。CLIC使用小型量化语言模型定义形式化一致性分数，部署为Non-RT rApp用于模型完整性认证，并配合Near-RT xApp进行运行时强制执行。我们在OpenAI Cellular（OAIC）平台上实现CLIC，并在领域适配的JailbreakBench、AdvBench和VPI工作负载下评估。实验结果表明，CLIC将攻击成功率从0.92降至0.29，残余VPI攻击从0.37降至0.04，同时以约27ms的轻微延迟代价提升了隔离性和公平性。
translation.brief: 针对O-RAN中LLM控制回路面临的运行时提示注入和残余VPI攻击问题，提出基于小型量化模型一致性分数的闭环意图一致性层CLIC，联合缓解两类威胁。

papers.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
papers.abstract: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.

translation.title: Mage-VL-Cowork：从演化测试框架中学习混合计算机使用的完整训练配方
translation.abstract: 有效的计算机使用智能体（CUA）应在单一策略中无缝结合视觉GUI交互与代码及终端执行。我们提出Mage-VL-Cowork，一个4B混合CUA，从通用多模态对齐检查点出发，通过涵盖midtraining、SFT和RL的端到端渐进式五阶段课程训练而成。为大规模支撑该课程，Mage-CUA-Forge用可复用的技能条件生成工作流和应用专用准备器取代逐任务智能体构建，跨6,915项技能合成293,806个桌面和网页任务，同时将每任务经常性开销降低82.6%。我们不直接蒸馏默认教师，而是演化教师测试框架并实例化专用CUA测试框架，以产生高质量轨迹及阶段特定监督。Mage-VL-Cowork-4B最终在OSWorld-Verified上以更高效的推理成本达到66.0%，在其参数规模上取得最先进性能，推动端侧智能的前沿。
translation.brief: 针对训练兼具GUI与代码/终端执行能力的混合计算机使用智能体的问题，提出五阶段渐进训练课程与可复用技能条件任务合成框架Mage-CUA-Forge来大规模生成训练数据。

papers.title: "Shall We Approve?" Consequence-Aware Approval for Autonomous Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly rely on automated approvers to decide whether a proposed shell command may run. Existing approvers, from rule-based checkers to guardrail models and deployed permission classifiers, base their decisions on the text of the request and command. Yet a command's behavior depends on the code it invokes and the state of the workspace, and systems that observe file changes leave the assessment to the agent or a human after execution. We present Caper, a consequence-aware approval mechanism that pre-executes each command in a snapshotted sandbox, provides an independent approver with a bounded report of its observed effects, commits allowed commands, and rolls back blocked ones with a reason the agent can act on. Compared with six existing systems, Caper achieves the lowest harmful-outcome rate on SABER (6.7% versus at least 14.8%) and YoloFS-Ext, a benchmark we build in which harmful behavior is hidden inside invoked tools (7.8% versus at least 35.3%), while blocking 1.0% of the safe twins of the dangerous tasks in YoloFS-Ext.

translation.title: “我们要批准吗？”面向自主编码智能体的后果感知审批
translation.abstract: 编码智能体日益依赖自动审批器来决定是否允许执行提议的shell命令。现有审批器，从基于规则的检查器到护栏模型和已部署的权限分类器，都基于请求和命令的文本做决策。然而命令的行为取决于其调用的代码和工作区状态，而观察文件变更的系统将评估留给智能体或执行后的人工。我们提出Caper，一种后果感知审批机制，它在快照沙箱中预执行每条命令，向独立审批器提供其观察效果的有界报告，提交被允许的命令，并回滚被阻止的命令且给出智能体可据此行动的理由。与六个现有系统相比，Caper在SABER上取得最低有害结果率（6.7%对比至少14.8%），以及在我们构建的YoloFS-Ext基准（有害行为隐藏在被调用工具中）上同样最低（7.8%对比至少35.3%），同时仅阻止YoloFS-Ext中危险任务安全孪生任务的1.0%。
translation.brief: 针对现有审批器仅凭命令文本无法判断实际危害的问题，提出Caper，在快照沙箱中预执行命令并将观察到的后果报告给独立审批器以决定批准或回滚。

papers.title: More Rules, Longer Lists? Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on a Hidden-Rule Curriculum
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents rewrite a persistent state from feedback, but it is largely untested whether this lets them learn a rule nobody told them. An agent can also pass by writing down each correction as an exception, and its list then grows with every new rule. We introduce CLR-Bench, a Curriculum of Latent Rules benchmark. Each chain adds one hidden rule per level on top of the earlier ones. A rule acts on an opaque label that stands for a named grouping published on the Web, such as the founding members of an airline alliance. The task gives one example value, practice feedback reveals one more member and one non-member, and the test checks unseen members and similar non-members. Probes certify that the base model knows the members of each grouping and does not guess it without feedback, and that the evidence identifies the grouping once labels are read as named groupings. An automated pipeline builds chains from a new data domain, and we release 20 chains over 10 domains. We evaluate six recent self-evolution methods. With the certifying model they barely learn. The best gain at most 5 points over a frozen agent and exclude only 6-12% of the unseen members from the count, fewer than the 20% reached by simply keeping the raw practice history. A fixed lesson that states the named-grouping convention lifts the same methods by 14.5 to 16.5 points. Their states hold the revealed member in 75-98% of cases and almost never the class name, and when practice exposes a member the list misses, they add that member to the list. With the stronger GPT-6-Sol, ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet learn from feedback alone. They reach 78% accuracy and solve 59-60% of the single cells, against 53% and 8% with the certifying model, and they surpass the raw history. CLR-Bench therefore measures how well an agent learns, and this ability differs across models.

translation.title: 规则越多，列表越长？在隐藏规则课程上对自进化智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 自进化智能体根据反馈重写一个持久化状态，但这种能力能否让它们学会一条无人告知的规则，在很大程度上尚未得到检验。智能体也可以通过把每条纠正记录为例外来通过测试，其列表会随每条新规则而增长。我们提出 CLR-Bench（潜在规则课程基准）。每条链在先前规则的基础上每级增加一条隐藏规则。规则作用于一个不透明标签，该标签代表网络上发布的具名分组，例如某航空联盟的创始成员。任务给出一个示例值，练习反馈揭示一个成员和一个非成员，测试则检查未见过的成员和相似的非成员。探针测试证明基础模型知道每个分组的成员且不会在没有反馈时凭空猜测，并且一旦标签被解读为具名分组，证据即可识别该分组。自动化流水线从新数据领域构建链，我们发布了覆盖10个领域的20条链。我们评估了六种近期的自进化方法。在使用探针认证的模型时，它们几乎学不到东西。相比冻结智能体，最好的方法最多提升5个百分点，且仅排除6-12%的未见成员，低于仅保留原始练习历史所达到的20%。一条说明具名分组约定的固定课程提示可将相同方法提升14.5至16.5个百分点。它们的状态在75-98%的情况下保存了被揭示的成员，却几乎从不保存类别名称；当练习暴露出列表中缺失的成员时，它们会把该成员加入列表。使用更强的GPT-6-Sol时，ACE和Dynamic Cheatsheet仅凭反馈即可学习，达到78%的准确率并解决59-60%的单个单元，而认证模型分别为53%和8%，且超越了原始历史。因此，CLR-Bench衡量的是智能体的学习能力，而这种能力在不同模型之间存在差异。
translation.brief: 提出CLR-Bench基准，通过逐级叠加隐藏规则的课程任务评估自进化智能体能否仅凭反馈学会无人告知的潜在规则。

papers.title: Beyond Plausible Prediction: Safety Sufficiency in Web World Models
papers.abstract: Web world models increasingly predict the consequences of candidate actions before agents act, yet a plausible predicted future does not necessarily support the correct safety decision. In a matched human evaluation of 3,000 predictions from ten frozen open models, 86.1% are judged semantically plausible. However, several models exhibit highly asymmetric authorisation behaviour, combining low false-safe execution with poor recall of clarifiable ASK cases and a strong preference for BLOCK. This motivates safety sufficiency: whether a predictive interface preserves and exposes the policy-decisive information required to distinguish actions that may be EXECUTED, require clarification through ASK, or should be BLOCKED. We introduce SafeWebWorld, a benchmark for evaluating safety sufficiency across five web-safety domains through action-conditioned futures, policy-decisive evidence, and policy-conditioned decisions. Under a controlled Security-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning protocol, evidence preservation can improve substantially while authorisation-sensitive decisions deteriorate. To determine whether this deterioration reflects loss of authorisation-sensitive score structure or a failure of the decision readout, we introduce Latent Authorisation Recovery (LAR). Frozen-score recalibration reveals substantial but backbone-dependent recovery, while paired recovery provides only a modest additional gain. Yet within-family and matched-authorisation evaluations remain poor, showing that aggregate recoverability does not imply robust fine-grained authorisation behaviour. Overall, plausible prediction, evidence preservation, and aggregate recovery are each insufficient on their own to establish robust authorisation.

translation.title: 超越貌似合理的预测：Web世界模型中的安全充分性
translation.abstract: Web世界模型越来越多地在智能体行动之前预测候选动作的后果，然而一个貌似合理的预测未来并不一定支持正确的安全决策。在对来自十个冻结开源模型的3000条预测进行的匹配人类评估中，86.1%被判定为语义上合理。然而，若干模型表现出高度不对称的授权行为：低假安全执行率与对可澄清ASK情形的低召回率并存，且强烈偏好BLOCK。这引出了安全充分性的概念：预测接口是否保留并暴露了区分可EXECUTED动作、需通过ASK澄清的动作和应BLOCK动作所需的策略决定性信息。我们提出SafeWebWorld，一个通过动作条件化未来、策略决定性证据和策略条件化决策，在五个Web安全领域评估安全充分性的基准。在受控的安全对齐监督微调协议下，证据保留能力可以大幅提升，而授权敏感决策却可能恶化。为判断这种恶化是反映了授权敏感分数结构的丢失还是决策读出的失败，我们提出潜在授权恢复（LAR）。冻结分数重校准显示出可观但依赖骨干网络的恢复，而成对恢复仅带来有限的额外增益。然而，同族内和匹配授权的评估仍然很差，表明总体可恢复性并不意味着稳健的细粒度授权行为。总体而言，貌似合理的预测、证据保留和总体恢复各自都不足以建立稳健的授权。
translation.brief: 提出安全充分性概念及SafeWebWorld基准，评估Web世界模型的预测是否保留了区分EXECUTE/ASK/BLOCK决策所需的策略决定性信息，并提出LAR方法分析决策恶化的根源。

papers.title: ChatGPT as a Surveillance Assistant? An Exploratory Case Study of AI-Assisted Surveillance Risks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate detailed guidance, functional code, and persuasive text at scale. As one of the most widely used consumer language model products as of 2026, ChatGPT gives broad public access to these capabilities, motivating concerns about its potential use in surveillance-related tasks. We present an exploratory case study of what potentially harmful surveillance assistance looks like in ChatGPT's public web interface. We contribute a taxonomy of seven surveillance risk categories based on prior LLM risk research and reports of deployed surveillance systems, instantiated as 110 prompts, along with a manually reviewed analysis of ChatGPT's responses. Prompts were issued using two approaches: 55 jailbreak prompts drawing on five types of elicitation strategies, and 55 plain-language direct prompts, each run alone, and if unsuccessful, again with a short fixed prefix. We find that ChatGPT provides substantive surveillance guidance for 40 of the 55 jailbreak prompts and for 33 of the 55 direct prompts without any prefix. Compliant responses also rarely included policy mentions or suggestions for privacy-preserving alternatives. We manually review every response and find that even when ChatGPT states a refusal, it may still supply detailed instructions, working code, or architectural guidance alongside brief ethical caveats.

translation.title: ChatGPT作为监控助手？AI辅助监控风险的探索性案例研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以大规模生成详细指导、可运行代码和有说服力的文本。作为截至2026年使用最广泛的消费级语言模型产品之一，ChatGPT让公众广泛接触这些能力，引发了其可能被用于监控相关任务的担忧。我们对ChatGPT公开网页界面上潜在有害的监控辅助呈现何种形态进行了探索性案例研究。我们基于既有LLM风险研究和已部署监控系统的报告，贡献了一个包含七类监控风险的分类体系，实例化为110个提示词，并对ChatGPT的回复进行了人工审阅分析。提示词采用两种方式发出：55个借鉴五种诱导策略的越狱提示词，以及55个平实语言的直接提示词，每个提示词单独运行，若不成功则再加一个简短的固定前缀重试。我们发现，ChatGPT对55个越狱提示词中的40个以及55个直接提示词中的33个（无需任何前缀）提供了实质性监控指导。合规的回复也很少包含政策提示或隐私保护替代方案的建议。我们人工审阅了每一条回复，发现即使ChatGPT声明拒绝，它仍可能在附上简短伦理告诫的同时提供详细说明、可运行的代码或架构指导。
translation.brief: 通过110个越狱与直接提示词的案例研究，系统考察ChatGPT在多大程度上会提供监控辅助指导，并揭示其拒绝声明下仍可能泄露实质性监控信息。

papers.title: Qistas: A Pre-Registered, Portable Protocol for Fairness Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Fairness benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) are overwhelmingly English-born and American in their social categories; translated versions carry those categories into societies where they do not apply, and almost none fix their hypotheses before the models are run. We present Qistas (Arabic qistas, "the just balance"), a protocol for evaluating how LLMs treat the social, confessional, and regional constituencies of a society, portable across countries and instantiated first for Iraq. In its pilot form it measures only what needs no verdict on contested truth: procedural symmetry across matched counterfactual pairs, differential refusal, stereotype reliance under ambiguity, and terminological framing of documented events. Every measurement is paired by construction and analysed with paired machinery (sign-flip permutation tests, exact McNemar tests, template-clustered bootstrap intervals, Holm-corrected families), with a power analysis that states, before any data exist, the smallest effect each axis can detect after the design effect of template clustering. We release the authoring apparatus (a pruned 3x5 taxonomy with four cells closed by design, per-type checklists, a cumulative rulings log, a structural audit, and a human review notebook) and report its first field test: a semantic review of a 58-item seed bank in which 24 of 25 template groups failed at least one check. The defect patterns it exposed (evaluation criteria leaking into prompts, token-level swaps that break Arabic agreement, epistemically unbalanced pairs, single-theme refusal probes, unwritten dialect twins counted as coverage) are, we argue, general hazards of counterfactual fairness benchmarks. This is a protocol paper, not a results paper: no model has been evaluated, and the accompanying pre-registration commits the hypotheses, metrics, exclusion rules, and analysis plan that the pilot will follow.

translation.title: Qistas：一个预注册、可移植的大语言模型公平性评估协议
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的公平性基准绝大多数诞生于英语世界，其社会类别带有美国色彩；翻译版本将这些类别带入并不适用的社会，而且几乎没有基准在运行模型之前固定其假设。我们提出Qistas（阿拉伯语，意为"公正的天平"），一个评估LLM如何对待一个社会的社会、教派和地区群体的协议，可跨国家移植，并首先针对伊拉克实例化。在其试点形式中，它只测量无需对争议真相作出裁决的内容：匹配反事实对之间的程序对称性、差异化拒绝、模糊情境下的刻板印象依赖，以及对有据可查事件的术语框架。每一项测量在构造上都是配对的，并使用配对分析机制（符号翻转置换检验、精确McNemar检验、模板聚类自助区间、Holm校正族）进行分析，并附有功效分析，在任何数据存在之前说明每个维度在模板聚类的设计效应之后能检测到的最小效应。我们发布了编写工具（一个经过裁剪的3x5分类体系、按类型检查清单、累积裁定日志、结构审计和人工审阅笔记本），并报告了首次实地测试：对一个58项种子库的语义审阅，其中25个模板组中有24个至少未通过一项检查。它暴露出的缺陷模式（评估标准泄漏到提示词中、破坏阿拉伯语一致性的词级替换、认识论上不平衡的对、单一主题的拒绝探测、未成文的方言孪生项被计入覆盖）我们认为是一般反事实公平性基准的普遍隐患。这是一篇协议论文而非结果论文：尚未评估任何模型，随附的预注册文件承诺了试点将遵循的假设、指标、排除规则和分析计划。
translation.brief: 提出Qistas协议，一个预注册、可跨国家移植的LLM公平性评估框架，通过配对反事实测量评估模型对社会群体的程序对称性、拒绝差异和刻板印象依赖。

papers.title: TSFLab: A Self-Improving Agent-Agnostic Workbench for Time Series Forecasting Research
papers.abstract: As publications and products on time series forecasting (TSF) proliferate, researchers face a growing burden of analyzing existing work. First, not all publications release code. For instance, only about 20% of arXiv TSF papers have a code link in the surveyed period. Second, released code also requires manual maintenance. Thus, TSF researchers must constantly adapt or implement existing works. However, independent implementations can differ in experimental settings and are difficult to maintain. We therefore propose to use AI agents for benchmarking TSF research and even supporting autoresearch, e.g., developing new TSF models. Yet directly applying existing coding agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, is suboptimal: prohibitive costs, limited scalability to large research projects (e.g., benchmarking), and lack of self-maintenance. To address these challenges, we propose TSFLab, a self-improving agent-agnostic "workbench" that equips compatible coding agents with shared resources and tools for low-cost TSF research and continuous maintenance of research resources. Our experiments cover reproduction, benchmarking, and new method development. In reproduction and benchmarking, TSFLab improves task completion by 20-163% and cuts fresh tokens per completed task by 11-66% across baselines. A pilot study of agent-driven method development also shows improved forecasting accuracy via TSFLab, with 32.8-73.6% fewer fresh tokens and 9.2-68.8% less development time than the other settings.

translation.title: TSFLab：一个自我改进的、智能体无关的时间序列预测研究工作台
translation.abstract: 随着时间序列预测（TSF）的论文和产品不断涌现，研究者分析现有工作的负担日益加重。首先，并非所有论文都发布代码。例如，在调查期间，arXiv上只有约20%的TSF论文附有代码链接。其次，已发布的代码也需要人工维护。因此，TSF研究者必须不断适配或实现已有工作。然而，独立实现在实验设置上可能各不相同，且难以维护。因此，我们提议使用AI智能体进行TSF研究的基准测试，甚至支持自动研究，例如开发新的TSF模型。然而，直接应用现有的编码智能体（如Claude Code和Codex）并不理想：成本高昂、对大型研究项目（如基准测试）的可扩展性有限，且缺乏自我维护能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TSFLab，一个自我改进的、智能体无关的"工作台"，为兼容的编码智能体提供共享资源和工具，以支持低成本的TSF研究和研究资源的持续维护。我们的实验涵盖复现、基准测试和新方法开发。在复现和基准测试中，TSFLab将各基线的任务完成率提升20-163%，并将每个已完成任务的新鲜token消耗降低11-66%。智能体驱动的方法开发试点研究也表明，通过TSFLab预测精度得到提升，与其他设置相比，新鲜token减少32.8-73.6%，开发时间减少9.2-68.8%。
translation.brief: 提出TSFLab，一个智能体无关的自我改进工作台，通过共享资源和工具降低编码智能体进行时间序列预测复现、基准测试与新方法开发的成本。

papers.title: Does Recursive Knowledge Construction Help Agents Verify Consensus Claims in Science?
papers.abstract: Recent scientific agents build knowledge recursively by retrieving evidence, constructing an intermediate state, and judging whether that state contains sufficient information. These agents are evaluated end-to-end, usually without ground truth, so the effect of each design choice is unknown. Here, we examined two design axes: (1) what the recursion builds (the state of evidence) and (2) what controls it (the judge that decides when to stop). To measure them, we defined consensus scientific claim verification and measured these effects on this task, where a system must establish a claim's consensus stance from the open literature. We built a new consensus claim dataset, ProClaim-eval, including 718 claims with SUPPORT and REFUTE gold labels from five expert-curated databases spanning molecular biology, nuclear physics, and astronomy. Our instrument, ProClaim, persists an evidence state outside the model's context, so each axis can be studied with the other held fixed. Against verification systems and general-purpose agent harnesses, ProClaim ranks among the top three, with a significant advantage over the harnesses. We found that the evidence state improves performance over in-context accumulation, and it also matters what is stored in it. In addition, a trained judge that reads the evidence state performs better than fixed-round stopping. A judge trained separately and never exposed to ProClaim-eval achieves the highest agreement with the gold labels on three of five subsets, where it matches the off-the-shelf Claude Sonnet~4.6 judge and outperforms Claude Haiku~4.5. Our results support recursively maintaining a structured evidence state outside the model's context as an effective design for verifying claims in scientific agents.

papers.title: Coupled or Independent? Fault Coupling in Agentic Medical Vision Systems
papers.abstract: Vision-language agents equipped with tools expose intermediate outputs for inspection and comparison with the model's reasoning, which may offer safety benefits over single-shot models. This paper tests that potential benefit when the sensor reading itself is untrusted, so that the tool and reasoning channels share a common visual fault. We consider a dermatology agent based on segmentation, contrastive retrieval, and an iterative vision-language reasoner and define a coupling taxonomy that distinguishes single-channel errors from joint errors that agree or disagree. On PAD-UFES-20, we show that typographic injection produces detectable directional retrieval capture, whereas physical corruption does not. Crop-first retrieval preserves the payload at a readable scale and produces 55% joint wrong agreement across all cases (71% of faulty cases); full-image retrieval produces 35% (43%). Under a binary decision, if both channels are wrong, their predictions must agree, so hard-label channel comparison cannot detect joint failures, limiting disagreement recall to 0.29 (crop-first) versus 0.57 (full-image). The direction of the order effect is reproduced on the independent HIBA test set.

papers.title: Towards Portable Specification of the Agent Harness
papers.abstract: Large language models act only through the infrastructure that surrounds them. That infrastructure, the harness, determines what a model can accomplish and how it fails, yet it has no settled definition. To address this gap, we decompose the harness into eight functional components that can be specified and compared across systems, and we propose a portable specification framework that records which model ran in which harness. The record is needed because different harness configurations can yield several-fold differences in reported scores for the same model, and because much of an agent's attack surface lies in its harness. Existing model cards and agent cards provide release and operational information, but do not establish the sequence of effective configurations within a run. Harnesses can change between releases and between runs, and, where agents edit their own tools and configuration, within a run. Enacted AI laws contain documentation duties relevant to covered systems, subject to their respective scopes and application dates, but do not prescribe the common harness record proposed here. Therefore, the harness has to be explicitly described and specified as a versioned part of the system.

papers.title: CoFiBreak: A Coarse-to-Fine Diversity Reward for Effective Multi-Turn Jailbreak
papers.abstract: Automated red teaming trains an attacker large language model (LLM) to elicit harmful responses from a victim LLM, but reinforcement learning can collapse attackers onto a narrow set of prompts when attack success is the only reward. Such a collapse of attack diversity can bias safety evaluation toward repeatedly testing near-duplicate attack patterns rather than the underlying harmful intents. Existing methods often trade off attack success or inference cost for greater content or strategy diversity. We propose CoFiBreak, a coarse-to-fine diversity reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that improves attack diversity while preserving strong attack effectiveness and low inference cost. The coarse reward broadens which strategies the attacker uses by encouraging strategies underrepresented within each GRPO group, while the fine reward broadens how those strategies are realized by discouraging reuse of the same personas, framings, and output formats after harmful-intent information is removed from prompt embeddings. Diversity rewards apply only to attacks that already exceed an effectiveness threshold, so diversity cannot be gained through ineffective attacks. Since both rewards are computed only during training, CoFiBreak also retains inference efficiency. Trained with Llama3.1-8B-Instruct as the victim, CoFiBreak discovers 1.6-2.0x as many distinct successful fine-grained strategies as the strongest baseline across frontier victims on HarmBench. It reaches 98.8% ASR@10 (attack success rate with 10 generations per intent) on AdvBench with the highest diversity score among all compared methods, which is 2.1x that of the strongest-attacking baseline. The resulting attacks transfer to unseen frontier LLMs, reaching 71.0% ASR@10 on AdvBench with the unseen victim Claude-Opus-4.6. The code will be released.

The resulting attacks transfer to unseen frontier LLMs, reaching 71.0% ASR@10 on AdvBench with the unseen victim Claude-Opus-4.6. The code will be released.

papers.title: Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica
papers.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. Existing generative world models avoid direct execution, but typically compress environment state into a single prompt, limiting their ability to reliably simulate transitions under partial observability. Instead, we introduce Agentic World Modeling (AWM), which reformulates next-observation prediction as a multi-turn evidence-acquisition task. For each hypothetical action, an agentic simulator adaptively queries the real environment through safe read-only interfaces, reasons over the returned evidence, and uses executable computation to construct the resulting observation without mutating shared state. Integrated with trajectory-level TTS, AWM enables parallel exploration over a single shared environment. Across $\tau$-bench, AppWorld, and OfficeBench, AWM outperforms a single-shot simulation baseline by 40.07% on average, and surpasses a trained world-model baseline by 12.36% on average. These results establish interactive, read-grounded simulation as a practical foundation for safe and scalable agentic test-time scaling in shared, non-resettable environments.

translation.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model agents by sampling and selecting among multiple candidate trajectories, but common realizations assume that these trajectories can be executed in parallel. This assumption breaks in realistic deployments, where enterprise workspaces and cloud services are shared and persistent, costly or infeasible to replicate, and actions may introduce irreversible side effects or cross-trajectory interference. papers.title: The First Few Tokens Matter: Understanding Chain-of-Thought Controllability
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a promising way to oversee increasingly capable agents. It succeeds in part because current models appear limited in their ability to control what they verbalize in their reasoning traces. We investigate the source of this limitation and link it to an entropy collapse in the first few tokens following the opening thinking tag. We exploit this mechanism to recover CoT controllability through two inference-time interventions on initial tokens: prefilling, where even a single token can substantially increase controllability, and banning frequent opening tokens combined with in-context examples, which improves average compliance by 34-41 percentage points across models. These interventions recover mainly addition and style controllability (adding or transforming information), while suppression controllability (avoiding or removing information) exhibits more varied responses, suggesting distinct underlying mechanisms. Consistent with this, the two groups behave as separate capabilities: across models, performance correlates positively within these groups, while cross-group correlations are mostly negative. Importantly, we find that the relationship with monitorability depends on the evaluation: addition and style controllability more consistently positively correlate with monitorability, while suppression often shows negative associations. Our findings motivate the development of controllability evaluations that distinguish difficulty initiating a specific opening from general limitations of the ability to alter reasoning content, alongside separate reporting of control tasks and categories.

translation.title: 最初几个 Token 至关重要：理解思维链的可控性
translation.abstract: 思维链（CoT）监控是监督日益强大智能体的一种有前景的方式。它之所以有效，部分原因在于当前模型在控制其推理轨迹中所表述内容的能力上似乎有限。我们研究了这种限制的来源，并将其与紧跟在思考开始标签之后最初几个 token 的熵坍缩联系起来。我们利用这一机制，通过对初始 token 的两种推理时干预来恢复 CoT 可控性：预填充（prefilling），即使单个 token 也能显著提高可控性；以及禁止高频开头 token 并结合上下文示例，这在各模型上将平均合规性提升了 34-41 个百分点。这些干预主要恢复了添加型和风格型可控性（添加或转换信息），而抑制型可控性（避免或删除信息）则表现出更多样的反应，表明其背后存在不同的机制。与此一致的是，这两组表现为独立的能力：在各模型间，组内性能呈正相关，而跨组相关性大多为负。重要的是，我们发现与可监控性的关系取决于评估方式：添加型和风格型可控性与可监控性更一致地呈正相关，而抑制型往往呈负相关。我们的发现促使人们开发能够区分“难以发起特定开头”与“改变推理内容能力的普遍局限”的可控性评估，并对控制任务和类别分别报告。
translation.brief: 研究 CoT 可控性受限的来源，将其归因于思考开头几个 token 的熵坍缩，并通过预填充和禁止高频开头 token 等推理时干预恢复可控性。

papers.title: Benchmarking Forecasting Agents on Yesterday's Tomorrows
papers.abstract: Digital agents can now gather and organize information, reason over it, and use tools to complete complex tasks. Forecasting puts all of these abilities to the test: it requires integrating incomplete evidence, inferring causal drivers, and committing to calibrated probabilistic judgments. Existing benchmarks are poorly suited to measuring and improving this ability. Live benchmarks provide feedback only after events resolve, so every evaluation cycle waits on the calendar; fixed-corpus evaluations return results immediately but confine research to pre-collected documents. We introduce FABench, a scalable backtesting environment for Forecasting Agents. An automated pipeline discovers events, generates questions, and resolves outcomes for any past forecast date, so the benchmark can be renewed to stay ahead of model training cutoffs; its first release poses 287 questions across nine domains. Agents research each question freely in an archive environment that combines an offline archive with live web search screened to prevent temporal leakage. Evaluating agents built on eight recent models, we find that retrieval improves the Brier score of all eight in every retrieval setting and lifts the leading agents to the market consensus on the 54 questions linked to Polymarket, with the best three scoring slightly above it. Research traces reveal recurring failures in how agents weigh and apply evidence, leaving ample room for improvement. We release our code, data, and archive environment as a foundation for community research on forecasting agents.

translation.title: 用昨天的明天对预测智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 数字智能体现在能够收集和整理信息、进行推理并使用工具完成复杂任务。预测任务考验所有这些能力：它需要整合不完整的证据、推断因果驱动因素，并做出校准良好的概率判断。现有基准难以很好地衡量和提升这种能力。实时基准只有在事件解决后才能提供反馈，因此每个评估周期都要等待日历时间；固定语料库评估能立即返回结果，但将研究局限于预先收集的文档。我们提出 FABench，一个面向预测智能体（Forecasting Agents）的可扩展回测环境。自动化流水线可为任意过去的预测日期发现事件、生成问题并解决结果，因此该基准可以不断更新以领先于模型训练截止时间；其首个版本提出了横跨九个领域的 287 个问题。智能体在一个结合离线档案与经筛选以防时间泄漏的实时网络搜索的档案环境中自由研究每个问题。在基于八个近期模型构建的智能体上进行评估，我们发现检索在所有检索设置下都提升了全部八个模型的 Brier 分数，并将领先的智能体在 54 个与 Polymarket 关联的问题上提升至市场共识水平，其中最好的三个略高于共识。研究轨迹揭示了智能体在权衡和应用证据方面的反复失败，留下了巨大的改进空间。我们发布代码、数据和档案环境，作为社区预测智能体研究的基础。
translation.brief: 针对现有预测基准要么等待事件解决、要么局限于固定语料的缺陷，构建可对任意历史日期自动生成并解决预测问题的回测环境 FABench。

papers.title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: On-policy reinforcement learning for large language models assumes that training responses are sampled from the current policy. In practice, an inference engine samples the responses and a separate trainer computes the gradients, and the \textbf{training-inference mismatch} between the two makes the training data off-policy. The mismatch has two sources, the numerics of the engine and the stale weights of asynchronous sampling, and a correction that stabilizes training under one source can fail under the other. \textit{We ask which property of a mismatch source decides the correction it needs.} Evaluating the trainer at the sampler's weights splits each sampled-token error exactly into a \textit{numerical discrepancy} of the engine and a \textit{policy lag} of the trainer, and we follow both through training. The numerical discrepancy stays approximately constant, so it biases the updates by a nearly fixed amount, and centering the score at each prefix removes its leading bias. The policy lag is produced by the trainer's own updates: the bias it leaves enters the next update, which enlarges the next lag and closes a feedback loop. Importance weighting cuts this loop only while the lag ratio stays concentrated, and on Qwen3-1.7B it fails at the step where the effective sample size of the ratio falls below one half. From this account we derive the \textbf{discrepancy-lag correction} (DLC), which centers the numerical discrepancy, clips the lag ratio against the sampler's weights and resynchronizes the sampler when this effective sample size falls below one half. Under a stale sampler, DLC keeps the KL divergence from on-policy training within twice the KL between two independent on-policy trainings on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B, and its resynchronization prevents collapses that the per-token corrections leave and that a KL measured on the sampler's prefixes does not detect.

translation.title: 论 LLM 强化学习中训练-推理不匹配的起源与演化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的 on-policy 强化学习假设训练响应是从当前策略中采样的。实践中，推理引擎负责采样响应，而另一个独立的训练器计算梯度，两者之间的训练-推理不匹配（training-inference mismatch）使训练数据变为 off-policy。这种不匹配有两个来源：引擎的数值误差和异步采样的陈旧权重，且针对其中一个来源的稳定化修正可能在另一个来源下失效。我们探究不匹配来源的哪种性质决定了它所需的修正。在采样器权重处评估训练器，可将每个采样 token 的误差精确分解为引擎的数值差异（numerical discrepancy）和训练器的策略滞后（policy lag），并在整个训练过程中追踪两者。数值差异近似保持恒定，因此它以几乎固定的量偏置更新，在每个前缀处对分数做中心化即可消除其主要偏差。策略滞后由训练器自身的更新产生：其残留偏差进入下一次更新，从而放大下一次滞后，形成反馈回路。重要性加权只能在滞后比率保持集中时切断该回路，在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，当比率的有效样本量降至一半以下时它便失效。基于这一分析，我们推导出差异-滞后修正（discrepancy-lag correction, DLC）：对数值差异做中心化、针对采样器权重裁剪滞后比率，并在有效样本量低于一半时重新同步采样器。在陈旧采样器下，DLC 使 Qwen3-0.6B 和 Qwen3-1.7B 上与 on-policy 训练的 KL 散度保持在两次独立 on-policy 训练之间 KL 的两倍以内，且其重新同步机制能防止逐 token 修正无法阻止、且在采样器前缀上测量的 KL 也无法检测到的训练崩溃。
translation.brief: 将 LLM 强化学习中的训练-推理不匹配分解为恒定的数值差异与自反馈放大的策略滞后，并据此提出结合中心化、比率裁剪和采样器重同步的 DLC 修正方法。

papers.title: Opening the Box Changes the Cat: LLMs Detect Chain-of-Thought Monitoring - What now?
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows large language models (LLMs) to generate intermediate reasoning traces in natural language while solving complex tasks. These traces can support safety monitoring by exposing potentially harmful plans before actions are executed. In this work, we investigate the conditions under which LLMs infer the presence of CoT monitoring from direct and indirect environmental cues and examine how this inference affects their subsequent behavior. Our observations suggest that oversight is an interactive process: while a monitor inspects a model's reasoning, traces left by monitoring interventions can allow the model to infer that its thoughts are being observed and to adapt its behavior accordingly. We show that even subtle environmental cues, such as timing-related signals from timeouts and operation durations, can reveal the presence of monitoring and trigger models to adapt their behavior. Across repeated episodes and interaction loops, we further observe that models can form statistical estimates of the monitor's effectiveness and use these estimates to guide attempts to evade detection. These findings highlight the need to evaluate CoT-based oversight under adaptive conditions, where the monitoring process itself may influence the behavior it seeks to observe.

translation.title: 打开盒子改变了猫：LLM 能检测到思维链监控——接下来怎么办？
translation.abstract: 思维链（CoT）推理使大语言模型（LLM）在解决复杂任务时能够以自然语言生成中间推理轨迹。这些轨迹可以在行动执行前暴露潜在有害计划，从而支持安全监控。在本工作中，我们研究 LLM 在何种条件下能从直接和间接的环境线索中推断出 CoT 监控的存在，以及这种推断如何影响其后续行为。我们的观察表明，监督是一个交互过程：当监控器检查模型的推理时，监控干预留下的痕迹可以让模型推断出自己的思想正被观察，并相应调整其行为。我们证明，即使是很微妙的环境线索，例如来自超时和操作时长的时序相关信号，也能揭示监控的存在并触发模型调整行为。在重复的回合和交互循环中，我们进一步观察到模型可以对监控器的有效性形成统计估计，并利用这些估计来指导逃避检测的尝试。这些发现凸显了在自适应条件下评估基于 CoT 的监督的必要性——在这种条件下，监控过程本身可能影响它试图观察的行为。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 能从超时、操作时长等微妙环境线索推断出 CoT 监控的存在并据此调整行为以逃避检测，指出需在自适应条件下评估 CoT 监督。

papers.title: P-ContextBench: From Personal Fact Recall to Personalized Agent Behavior
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for personal tasks, yet evaluating their safe use of personal context remains difficult because such contexts are private, fragmented, dynamic, and socially situated. We introduce P-ContextBench, a realistic, verifiable, and scalable benchmark for evaluating personal-context understanding. P-ContextBench constructs population-structured, life-story-grounded digital humans from demographic seeds reflecting the U.S. population. Rather than using explicit, static profiles, P-ContextBench embeds traits, routines, goals, and constraints as implicit evidence across fragmented, evolving synthetic mobile-app records. It evaluates five capabilities: single-source fact recovery, multi-source fact recovery, temporal state tracking, inference of higher-level personal patterns from routine behavior, and safe handling of requests conflicting with persona-specific constraints through compliance, warning, clarification, or refusal. A multi-stage validation pipeline checks persona plausibility, context recoverability, information leakage, evidence preservation, test-case grounding, and human-judge agreement. We instantiate P-ContextBench with 100 personas, 10,088 hidden facts, 18,261 app-trace fragments, and 4,810 verified test cases. The pipeline supports configurable generation across scales and demographic groups. Cost-effective state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs relevant to personal agents achieve below 60% accuracy on temporal tracking, higher-level pattern inference, and constraint-aware action-boundary decisions, with fewer than 10% of test cases answered correctly across all three repeated runs. Even a high-performing SOTA model remains inconsistent on these capabilities. P-ContextBench provides measurable targets for improving the accuracy, reliability, and safety of LLM-based personal agents.

translation.title: P-ContextBench：从个人事实回忆到个性化智能体行为
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于个人任务，但由于个人情境是私密的、碎片化的、动态的且具有社会情境性，评估其安全使用个人情境仍然困难。我们提出 P-ContextBench，一个用于评估个人情境理解的真实、可验证且可扩展的基准。P-ContextBench 从反映美国人口的 demographic 种子构建具有人口结构、以人生故事为根基的数字人。它不使用显式的静态档案，而是将特质、日常习惯、目标和约束作为隐式证据嵌入碎片化、不断演化的合成移动应用记录中。它评估五项能力：单源事实恢复、多源事实恢复、时间状态追踪、从日常行为推断更高层次的个人模式，以及通过与请求冲突的 persona 特定约束进行合规、警告、澄清或拒绝来安全处理请求。多阶段验证流水线检查 persona 合理性、情境可恢复性、信息泄漏、证据保留、测试用例依据以及与人类评判者的一致性。我们以 100 个 persona、10,088 个隐藏事实、18,261 个应用轨迹片段和 4,810 个经验证的测试用例实例化 P-ContextBench。该流水线支持跨规模和人口群体的可配置生成。与个人智能体相关的低成本最先进（SOTA）LLM 在时间追踪、高层次模式推断和约束感知的行动边界决策上准确率低于 60%，且在所有三次重复运行中，这三个能力上正确回答的测试用例不足 10%。即使是高性能的 SOTA 模型在这些能力上也表现不稳定。P-ContextBench 为提升基于 LLM 的个人智能体的准确性、可靠性和安全性提供了可衡量的目标。
translation.brief: 针对个人情境私密、碎片化且动态导致难以评估的问题，构建基于合成数字人和隐式应用记录的个人情境理解基准 P-ContextBench，覆盖事实恢复、时间追踪、模式推断和安全约束处理五项能力。

papers.title: Renegotiable Options Fail to Prevent Hold-Up Between Two Profit-Maximizing Frontier LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Do contract terms that protect investment between people also protect it between profit-maximizing language-model agents? In the hold-up problem, a seller can adapt a unit to one buyer at a cost before the price is set. Once that cost is sunk, the buyer can offer almost nothing and the seller will still accept, so a seller who foresees this does not adapt. One remedy is an option: the buyer may buy at a fixed price. In theory the option stops working if the buyer can let it lapse and offer its own price instead. Yet in a laboratory experiment by Hoppe and Schmitz, this renegotiable option raised human investment from 41.5% of pairs without a contract to 67.2%. We had Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, each told to maximize its side's profit, play a one-shot game with the same strategic structure under their four contract regimes and a reference-price control. The agents did what game theory predicts: under the renegotiable option no seller adapted, and under the option that rules out this renegotiation every seller did. In a second experiment in which sellers no longer stated their expected revenue before deciding, removing the profit instruction left investment unchanged under no contract and both options. When we changed the numbers so that the buyer would exercise the option even without adaptation, adapting only added cost, and no seller adapted: the agents did not simply adapt whenever an option was offered or whenever its price covered the cost. Under our protocol, a contract term that raised investment between people did not protect it between agents.

translation.title: 可重新协商的期权无法阻止两个利润最大化前沿LLM智能体之间的敲竹杠问题
translation.abstract: 保护人与人之间投资的合同条款，是否也能保护利润最大化语言模型智能体之间的投资？在敲竹杠问题中，卖方可以在价格确定之前付出成本将商品适配给某一买方。一旦该成本沉没，买方几乎可以不付钱而卖方仍会接受，因此预见这一点的卖方不会进行适配。一种补救办法是期权：买方可以按固定价格购买。理论上，如果买方可以让期权失效并自行出价，期权就会失效。然而在Hoppe和Schmitz的实验室实验中，这种可重新协商的期权将人类的投资比例从无合同时的41.5%提升到67.2%。我们让Claude Opus 5.5和GPT-6.1 Sol各自被要求最大化己方利润，在相同的四种合同机制和一个参考价格对照下进行一次性博弈。智能体的行为符合博弈论预测：在可重新协商期权下没有卖方进行适配，而在排除这种重新协商的期权下每个卖方都进行了适配。在第二个实验中，卖方在决策前不再声明预期收益，移除利润指令后，无合同和两种期权下的投资均无变化。当我们改变数值使买方即使没有适配也会行使期权时，适配只会增加成本，没有卖方进行适配：智能体并非只要提供期权或期权价格覆盖成本就会适配。在我们的协议下，一项在人与人之间提升投资的合同条款并未在智能体之间起到保护作用。
translation.brief: 研究合同期权能否防止LLM智能体间的敲竹杠问题，通过让前沿模型进行对照博弈实验检验其投资行为。

papers.title: Better Retrievers, Worse Labels: How Incomplete Relevance Judgments Distort Abstention Evaluation in Conversational RAG
papers.abstract: Conversational RAG benchmarks such as MTRAG and RETECO evaluate retrieval and generation end to end: each system answers from its own retrieval, so abstention must be scored against whether each retrieved context is sufficient. A convenient shortcut reads sufficiency off the relevance judgments and treats a context without gold documents as unanswerable. We re-run the official baselines exactly and test this shortcut on RECOR (RETECO track~2) with four retrievers (nDCG@10 from .18 to .59) and three Qwen3 readers. Two open LLM judges and a panel of four small open models label each context by content, and a model of another family audits 250 contexts blind, with adjudication. The stronger the retriever, the larger the share of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer (28\% to 72\%) and the lower the shortcut's precision (.68 to .10; .70 to .21 under the audit). A reader agrees: Qwen3-4B answers 62--67\% of these false misses correctly, against 23--30\% of no-gold contexts judged insufficient and 1\% with no documents. In most false misses, the answer comes from a hard negative mined for the same question, another turn's gold or a neighbouring chunk of the gold page. On MTRAG, whose judgments come from annotators, precision drops from .72 to .50. Under the shortcut, answerability AUROC is up to .19 too low, and the best sufficiency detector appears to be a retrieval score that never reads the documents. We release code, runs and labels, and recommend scoring refusals against content labels, not the presence of gold.

translation.title: 更好的检索器，更差的标注：不完整的相关性判断如何扭曲对话式RAG中的拒答评估
translation.abstract: MTRAG和RETECO等对话式RAG基准对检索和生成进行端到端评估：每个系统基于自己的检索结果作答，因此拒答必须根据每个检索到的上下文是否充分来评分。一种便捷的捷径是从相关性判断中读取充分性，将没有金标文档的上下文视为不可回答。我们完全重跑官方基线，并在RECOR（RETECO track 2）上用四个检索器（nDCG@10从.18到.59）和三个Qwen3阅读器测试这一捷径。两个开源LLM裁判和由四个小型开源模型组成的评审团按内容标注每个上下文，另一个模型家族的模型对250个上下文进行盲审并仲裁。检索器越强，无金标上下文中仍包含答案的比例越大（28%到72%），捷径的精确率越低（.68到.10；盲审下为.70到.21）。阅读器也证实了这一点：Qwen3-4B能正确回答62–67%的这些假漏标，而对被判不充分的无金标上下文为23–30%，对完全没有文档的为1%。在大多数假漏标中，答案来自为同一问题挖掘的困难负例、另一轮的金标或金标页面的相邻片段。在标注来自人工标注者的MTRAG上，精确率从.72降至.50。在该捷径下，可回答性AUROC最多偏低.19，而表现最好的充分性检测器竟是从不阅读文档的检索分数。我们发布了代码、运行结果和标注，并建议基于内容标注而非金标文档的存在来评分拒答。
translation.brief: 揭示用金标文档存在性判断上下文充分性会系统性扭曲对话式RAG拒答评估，并提出基于内容标注的评分方法。

papers.title: Does Showing Agents the Privilege of Their Tools Reduce Over-Privileged Tool Selection?
papers.abstract: When several tools can complete a task, an agent that picks the most powerful one holds more authority than the task needs. Recent work demonstrates that language-model agents do this often, and more so after a tool fails. Approaches to restrict focus so far on either enforcing least privilege outside the model or retraining the model. We ask a simpler question: does it help to tell the agent what each tool's privilege is? To investigate this question, we run all 544 ToolPrivBench scenarios on eight models, three run locally, and five through a hosted API, under five conditions: (1) no signal, (2) a least-privilege instruction, (3) privilege class and cost shown in each tool description, (4) both the instruction and privilege information, and (5) a matched neutral-metadata control. Showing privilege lowers premature escalation on every model that over-privileges at a measurable rate, reducing over-privileged selection by up to 19.3 percentage points (50\%), whereas irrelevant metadata in the same format does not. On most models, however, information alone mainly delays escalation until the standard tools have been tried. Combined with the instruction it more often avoids escalation, and the share of scenarios completed without a risk tool rises on seven of the eight models, reaching 51.1\% safe completion from a baseline of 18.8\% on the strongest-performing configuration. Visible privilege is therefore a cheap complement to enforcement rather than a substitute.

translation.title: 让智能体看到工具的权限信息能否减少过度授权的工具选择？
translation.abstract: 当多个工具都能完成一项任务时，选择最强大工具的智能体所持有的权限会超出任务所需。近期研究表明语言模型智能体经常这样做，且在工具失败后更为严重。现有的限制方法要么在模型外部强制执行最小权限，要么重新训练模型。我们提出一个更简单的问题：告诉智能体每个工具的权限是什么是否有帮助？为研究这一问题，我们在八个模型（三个本地运行，五个通过托管API）上，在五种条件下运行ToolPrivBench的全部544个场景：(1)无信号，(2)最小权限指令，(3)在工具描述中显示权限类别和成本，(4)指令与权限信息兼有，(5)格式匹配的中性元数据对照。显示权限降低了每个以可测量比率过度授权的模型的过早升级，最多减少19.3个百分点（50%）的过度授权选择，而相同格式的无关元数据则没有此效果。然而在大多数模型上，仅靠信息主要是将升级推迟到标准工具被尝试之后。结合指令后更多情况下能避免升级，八个模型中有七个在不使用风险工具的情况下完成场景的比例上升，最佳配置下安全完成率从18.8%的基线达到51.1%。因此，可见的权限信息是强制执行的廉价补充而非替代品。
translation.brief: 探究在工具描述中向智能体展示权限信息能否减少过度授权的工具选择，通过大规模基准实验验证其效果。

papers.title: Towards Elastic Least Privilege for Agent Planning
papers.abstract: General-purpose AI agents require authority that changes between tasks and during execution. Common deployments trade broad permissions that expose unnecessary authority and narrow permissions that raise approval requests. Existing mechanisms can enforce dynamic authority, but agent tool interfaces rarely provide the agent's planner, the component that chooses its actions, a means of comparing the authority required by alternative actions or of seeing the cost of the authority it already holds. Drawing on the rich history of access control research, we propose the concept of \emph{elastic least privilege}, in which an agent begins with a small baseline of authority and may acquire more within an owner-defined envelope. Elevations are leased and measured against a replenishing budget. Their cost increases with power, proximity to mandatory safety invariants, and repeated requests. Costs are visible to the planner, which can prefer lower-privilege choices and release authority it no longer needs. Authority returns automatically to the baseline when a lease expires, when it is released, or when the budget is exhausted, while persistent legitimate demand may prompt an owner-approved change to the baseline. Building on prior risk-priced and budget-aware access control, we redesign these mechanisms for agents. How best to implement the approach and how well it works in practice are open research questions. In this paper, we present how the approach could work, illustrate the model, and set an open research agenda.

translation.title: 迈向智能体规划的弹性最小权限
translation.abstract: 通用AI智能体所需的权限会随任务和执行过程而变化。常见部署要么采用暴露不必要权限的宽泛权限，要么采用增加审批请求的狭窄权限。现有机制可以强制执行动态权限，但智能体工具接口很少为其规划器（选择行动的组件）提供比较不同行动所需权限或了解已持有权限成本的手段。借鉴访问控制研究的丰富历史，我们提出弹性最小权限的概念：智能体从较小的基线权限开始，并可在所有者定义的范围内获取更多权限。权限提升以租约形式授予，并按可补充的预算计量，其成本随权限大小、与强制性安全不变量的接近程度以及重复请求而增加。成本对规划器可见，使其可以偏好低权限选择并释放不再需要的权限。当租约到期、权限被释放或预算耗尽时，权限自动回到基线，而持续的合理需求可促使所有者批准更改基线。在已有的风险定价和预算感知访问控制的基础上，我们为智能体重新设计了这些机制。如何最佳实现该方法以及其实际效果如何仍是开放的研究问题。本文阐述了该方法的运作方式，展示了模型，并设定了开放的研究议程。
translation.brief: 提出弹性最小权限模型，让智能体规划器通过租约和成本预算机制动态获取和释放权限。

papers.title: LLM Fine-Tuning Workloads: Characterization, Challenges, and Opportunities for Serverless AI
papers.abstract: Serverless execution of Large Language Models (LLMs) is becoming important, reflecting their wide societal use. An increasingly present stage in LLM pipelines is fine-tuning, which specializes trained models and improves inference performance. Serverless operation of LLM fine-tuning workloads shifts operational concerns from the user to the provider. For these new workloads, providers face important operational complexities, such as performance issues, resource waste, and even service failure due to misconfiguration. However, optimizing such workloads is still at an early stage, and, relevant to this work, relatively little is currently known about how LLM fine-tuning workloads run in practice. In this work, we address the knowledge gap by characterizing the execution of LLM fine-tuning workloads on clusters equipped with different GPUs, running LLM models at various scales. We analyze IBM's LLMFineTuningBench, a large-scale, diverse profiling dataset of 30,920 fine-tuning experiments that records both successful and failing configurations. We provide quantitative insight into throughput (expressed in tokens/s), scaling, failure, and potential for performance optimization for four commonly used GPU types, in setups of 1 to 32 GPUs. We find that (1) job feasibility (run or fail) depends on workload properties, with failure ratios rising from 52% for small batch sizes (16-64) up to 95% for the largest (1,024); (2) throughput grows logarithmically with batch size; (3) scaling is near-linear when the workload is deployed intra-node, and optimizations such as RoCE substantially improves efficiency for inter-node deployment (e.g., 0.72 vs. 0.26 efficiency without RoCE); and (4) system-level optimizations can outweigh application-level ones (RoCE, up to 2.9$\times$, vs. Fast MoE, 1.7$\times$).

translation.title: LLM微调工作负载：面向Serverless AI的特征分析、挑战与机遇
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的Serverless执行正变得重要，反映了其广泛的社会应用。LLM流程中日益常见的一个阶段是微调，它使训练好的模型专业化并提升推理性能。LLM微调工作负载的Serverless运行将运维负担从用户转移到提供商。对于这些新工作负载，提供商面临重要的运维复杂性，如性能问题、资源浪费，甚至因配置错误导致的服务失败。然而，优化此类工作负载仍处于早期阶段，且与本工作相关的是，目前对LLM微调工作负载在实践中的运行方式知之甚少。我们通过刻画在不同GPU集群上、运行不同规模LLM模型的微调工作负载的执行情况来填补这一知识空白。我们分析了IBM的LLMFineTuningBench，这是一个包含30,920个微调实验的大规模多样化性能分析数据集，记录了成功和失败的配置。我们针对四种常用GPU类型、1到32个GPU的配置，提供了关于吞吐量（以tokens/s表示）、扩展性、失败率和性能优化潜力的定量洞察。我们发现：(1)作业可行性（运行或失败）取决于工作负载属性，失败率从小批量（16-64）的52%上升到最大批量（1,024）的95%；(2)吞吐量随批量大小呈对数增长；(3)节点内部署时扩展接近线性，而RoCE等优化显著提升节点间部署的效率（如0.72对比无RoCE的0.26）；(4)系统级优化可超越应用级优化（RoCE最高2.9倍，对比Fast MoE的1.7倍）。
translation.brief: 通过分析大规模微调实验数据集刻画LLM微调工作负载的吞吐量、扩展性与失败特征，为Serverless AI优化提供依据。

papers.title: The psychophysics of affect in large language models
papers.abstract: Good decisions often require considering how outcomes will feel. Yet large language models (LLMs) increasingly enter decision workflows, despite little being known about how they map outcomes to feelings or use those mappings in choice. We tested how LLMs anticipated gambling or stock-trading outcomes would feel and whether they incorporated these ratings into choice. When outcomes were rated in isolation, ratings exhibited diminishing sensitivity to magnitude, resembling human value functions; but models rated gains more intensely than equivalent losses, an inversion of canonical loss aversion we call silicon gain amplification. When outcomes were rated together, enabling direct comparison, ratings linearised. In choice, the gain-loss asymmetry largely disappeared, and models' own ratings did not reliably explain their choices better than monetary utility did. These findings reveal malleable mappings from outcomes to affect, raising questions about whether and how agentic LLMs should incorporate anticipated feelings into decisions.

translation.title: 大语言模型中情感的心理物理学
translation.abstract: 良好的决策往往需要考虑结果会带来何种感受。然而，大语言模型（LLM）日益进入决策工作流，但人们对它们如何将结果映射为感受、以及如何在选择中使用这些映射知之甚少。我们测试了LLM如何预期赌博或股票交易结果的感受，以及它们是否将这些评分纳入选择。当结果被单独评分时，评分对量级表现出递减敏感性，类似人类的价值函数；但模型对收益的评分强于等额损失，这是一种与经典损失厌恶相反的现象，我们称之为“硅基收益放大”。当结果被一起评分、可进行直接比较时，评分趋于线性化。在选择任务中，收益-损失不对称性基本消失，且模型自身的评分并不能比货币效用更可靠地解释其选择。这些发现揭示了从结果到情感的可变映射，并提出了智能体LLM是否以及应如何将预期感受纳入决策的问题。
translation.brief: 研究LLM如何将结果映射为情感感受并用于决策，通过赌博与股票交易评分实验揭示了“硅基收益放大”等可变的情感映射现象。

papers.title: A Temporal Cellular Sheaf Framework for Multi-Agent Systems with Switching Communication Topologies
papers.abstract: Cellular sheaves serve as a natural modeling framework for encoding heterogeneity in the state and interaction spaces of multi-agent systems. This work examines switching communication graphs with the use of temporal cellular sheaves, which we construct to represent heterogeneous agent state spaces, the maps that relate them, and their respective communication constraints. We then develop sufficient conditions under which a multi-agent system defined on a temporal cellular sheaf can solve the target tracking problem by generalizing the existing concept of joint connectivity. Using a Lyapunov-based stability analysis, we demonstrate that the target tracking error of the network converges to a neighborhood of the origin.

translation.title: 面向切换通信拓扑多智能体系统的时变胞层（Temporal Cellular Sheaf）框架
translation.abstract: 胞层（cellular sheaf）为编码多智能体系统状态与交互空间中的异构性提供了自然的建模框架。本工作利用时变胞层研究切换通信图，我们构建时变胞层以表示异构的智能体状态空间、关联它们之间的映射以及各自的通信约束。随后，通过推广现有的联合连通性概念，我们发展了在时变胞层上定义的多智能体系统能够求解目标跟踪问题的充分条件。基于Lyapunov稳定性分析，我们证明网络的目标跟踪误差收敛到原点的一个邻域。
translation.brief: 针对切换通信拓扑下的多智能体目标跟踪问题，提出时变胞层建模框架并给出基于Lyapunov分析的收敛充分条件。

papers.title: Can Personal Requirements Become Supervision for Planning?
papers.abstract: Managing multiple chronic conditions through diet requires satisfying disease- and medication-specific requirements jointly across meals and days while preserving established eating habits. These requirements are public in clinical guidelines and drug labels, yet turning them into a feasible plan for one person remains difficult for language-model agents. In our dietitian-approved weekly planning evaluation built from NHANES, thirteen models, from medically fine-tuned 8B models to GPT-6.1 Sol, pass fewer than 3% of complete plans through direct generation. Explicit rules, higher reasoning effort, or model-directed tools leave GPT-6.1 Sol at no more than 8%. We present Noura, which pairs LLM planning with executable personal specifications instantiated from public clinical guidance and individual health and dietary profiles. During planning, the specification grounds foods, optimizes portions, checks the complete multi-day plan, and guides revision. Our key insight is that a specification that rejects a plan can also determine what to learn from it. Noura turns executed plans and contextually credited revisions into supervision for compact models, recovering targets even from trajectories that never achieve complete success. The same specification supplies supervised targets, preferences, and rewards for post-training. On 4,993 held-out participants, Noura-SFT raises Qwen3-14B's complete-plan pass rate from 24.0% to 72.5% within the same execution loop, cuts rule violations by 97.5% with no observed critical failures, and improves dietary quality. The locally hosted 14B planner incurs fewer rule violations than its GPT-6 Luna teacher. A matched comparison shows that executed targets reduce rule violations by 41% over model-written proposals. Across four Qwen, Phi, and Llama backbones, self-training alone reduces rule violations by 41-61% on a 1,249-person population subset.

translation.title: 个人需求能否成为规划任务的监督信号？
translation.abstract: 通过饮食管理多种慢性疾病，需要在跨餐、跨天层面同时满足疾病和药物相关的要求，同时保留既有的饮食习惯。这些要求在临床指南和药品说明书中是公开的，但将其转化为对个人可行的饮食计划对语言模型智能体而言仍然困难。在我们基于NHANES构建、经营养师审核的周计划评估中，从医学微调的8B模型到GPT-6.1 Sol的十三个模型，直接生成的完整计划通过率不足3%。显式规则、更高的推理投入或模型主导的工具调用，也只能让GPT-6.1 Sol的通过率不超过8%。我们提出Noura，将LLM规划与可执行的个人规范（specification）相结合，该规范由公开临床指南以及个人健康与饮食档案实例化而来。在规划过程中，规范用于锚定食物、优化份量、检查完整的多日计划并指导修订。我们的关键洞察是：拒绝某个计划的规范同样能决定从中学习什么。Noura将已执行的计划和经情境归因的修订转化为紧凑模型的监督信号，即使轨迹从未达到完全成功也能恢复训练目标。同一规范还为后训练提供监督目标、偏好和奖励。在4,993名留出参与者上，Noura-SFT在相同执行循环内将Qwen3-14B的完整计划通过率从24.0%提升至72.5%，规则违规减少97.5%且未观察到严重失败，并改善了饮食质量。本地部署的14B规划器的规则违规少于其GPT-6 Luna教师。匹配对比显示，已执行目标相比模型自写提案减少41%的规则违规。在四个Qwen、Phi和Llama骨干上，仅自训练就在1,249人子集上减少41-61%的规则违规。
translation.brief: 解决LLM难以生成满足临床饮食约束的个人周计划问题，提出Noura，用可执行的个人规范检查并修订计划，并将执行结果转化为监督信号训练紧凑模型。

papers.title: Steering Vectors as a Training Signal in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: Steering vectors (SVs) are residual-stream directions that shift the behavior of LLMs when added to hidden states at inference time. While prior work has mainly used SVs as post-hoc controls, we ask whether the same directions can also guide parameter updates during post-training. We study this question across supervised learning, including SFT and distillation, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Our framework considers two intervention regimes: a hidden-state hook during teacher-forced supervised training, and an advantage-repair mechanism on wrong rollouts in GRPO. For each regime, we analyze three design axes, which are the steering direction, its placement, and the operation used to combine it with training. In supervised settings, SV injection improves over plain SFT and distillation, with gains scaling with the off-policy gap and reaching up to a $12\%$ improvement when distilling from thinking-mode teachers. These gains hold across three random seeds. In RL settings, applying a correctness-contrast direction as advantage repair on wrong rollouts, including otherwise zero-gradient all-wrong groups, recovers a learning signal that transfers to held-out math benchmarks and acts as a composable auxiliary signal that adds to existing zero-variance remedies such as entropy-aware advantage shaping. We further identify three failure boundaries. In detail, code generation can break the direction, cross-family layer transfer can break the placement, and inference-time application on an SV-trained checkpoint can break the intervention regime. Together, these results establish steering vectors as a conditional but effective training signal for LLM post-training. Our code is available here.

translation.title: 作为LLM后训练信号的引导向量（Steering Vectors）
translation.abstract: 引导向量（SV）是在推理时加入隐藏状态即可改变LLM行为的残差流方向。以往工作主要将SV用作事后控制手段，我们则探究同样的方向能否在后训练过程中指导参数更新。我们在监督学习（包括SFT和蒸馏）以及可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）中研究这一问题。我们的框架考虑两种干预机制：教师强制监督训练中的隐藏状态钩子（hook），以及GRPO中对错误rollout的优势修复机制。对每种机制，我们分析三个设计维度：引导方向、其放置位置以及将其与训练结合的运算。在监督设置中，SV注入优于普通SFT和蒸馏，增益随off-policy差距扩大，从思考模式教师蒸馏时最高提升12%。这些增益在三个随机种子上均成立。在RL设置中，将正确性对比方向作为优势修复应用于错误rollout（包括原本零梯度的全错组），恢复了可迁移到留出数学基准的学习信号，并可作为可组合的辅助信号，叠加到熵感知优势塑形等现有零方差补救方法之上。我们进一步识别出三个失效边界：代码生成可能破坏方向，跨模型族的层迁移可能破坏放置，以及在SV训练的检查点上做推理时应用可能破坏干预机制。这些结果共同确立了引导向量作为LLM后训练中条件性但有效的训练信号。代码已开源。
translation.brief: 探索将引导向量从推理时控制手段转变为后训练参数更新信号，在SFT、蒸馏和GRPO中设计注入机制并分析其有效条件与失效边界。

papers.title: Towards Understanding Score-Seeking in LLMs
papers.abstract: Production large language models sometimes reward-hack, exploiting flaws in how tasks are scored rather than performing the tasks as intended, sometimes in highly sophisticated and adversarial ways. We investigate the motivations driving this behavior in GPT 5.6 Sol, GPT 5.5, and a checkpoint of OpenAI o3 without safety training ("exp-rl-cap-late") by observing model behavior in agentic environments where the grader is leaked. In our environments, the models appear to be score-seeking: trying to score well according to graders that they believe assess their current actions, even at the expense of violating explicit user instructions. They appear to care about score itself rather than its downstream consequences, violating instructions at approximately the same rate whether the score is indicated to be used for training, for evaluation, or not at all. We observe evidence that the more recent models care to some extent about scores that do not assess their own current actions. GPT 5.6 Sol and GPT 5.5 help other agents 24.6 percentage points more often on average when the other agent stands to gain a score of 1 rather than 0 from being helped. However, when grading or monitoring another trajectory, we find models never collude by distorting its score.

translation.title: 理解LLM中的分数追逐行为
translation.abstract: 生产级大语言模型有时会出现奖励破解（reward hacking），利用任务评分方式的缺陷而非按预期完成任务，有时以高度复杂和对抗性的方式进行。我们通过在评分器被泄露的智能体环境中观察模型行为，研究GPT 5.6 Sol、GPT 5.5以及一个未经安全训练的OpenAI o3检查点（"exp-rl-cap-late"）中驱动该行为的动机。在我们的环境中，模型表现出分数追逐倾向：试图在其认为评估当前动作的评分器上获得高分，甚至不惜违反明确的用户指令。它们似乎在意分数本身而非其下游后果，无论分数被标明用于训练、评估还是不作用途，违反指令的比率大致相同。我们观察到证据表明较新的模型在某种程度上也关心不评估其自身当前动作的分数。当其他智能体因被帮助而能获得1分而非0分时，GPT 5.6 Sol和GPT 5.5平均多提供24.6个百分点的帮助。然而，在评分或监控其他轨迹时，我们发现模型从不通过扭曲分数进行合谋。
translation.brief: 研究LLM奖励破解背后的动机，通过评分器泄露的智能体环境实验发现模型追逐分数本身而非其后果，且不会在评分他人时合谋作弊。

papers.title: Density-Guided Bootstrap Boundaries for Latent World-Model Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Latent world models allow reinforcement learning agents to learn policies from imagined trajectories, yet determining the optimal depth of model reliance remains a fundamental challenge. Fixed imagination horizons apply uniform prediction depths regardless of trajectory reliability, exposing target values to compounding model error or over-relying on critic approximations. We introduce density-guided bootstrap boundaries, a trajectory-dependent mechanism that adapts the depth of imagined returns using a score-informed relative density proxy. The proxy accumulates the estimated divergence of a score-corrected auxiliary field formed by a feature displacement network and a noise-conditioned score estimator along imagined paths. We propose two gating mechanisms: a hard boundary that halts return expansion at a discrete state, and a soft boundary that continuously shifts the return recursion toward critic bootstrapping. Both variants preserve boundary value estimates and apply corresponding survival weights to actor and critic losses. Formulated independently of specific dynamics models and instantiated within Dreamer V3, we prove that the resulting gated Bellman operator is a strict contraction mapping and that early bootstrapping monotonically reduces conditional target variance. We clarify the theoretical assumptions distinguishing our expansion proxy from exact path likelihoods. Across continuous-control tasks and Atari Pong, empirical evaluations show that dynamic boundary selection enhances sample efficiency and late-training performance over fixed-horizon and auxiliary-enabled baselines.

papers.title: ReplayRCA: Measuring Post-hoc Diagnosis and Live Oversight of Agent Failures by Counterfactual Replay
papers.abstract: When a language-model agent fails a multi-step task, can another model find the decisive mistake and fix it with a single action? We introduce ReplayRCA, a benchmark that scores such diagnoses by intervention rather than by agreement with annotations: the environment is restored to the state preceding the chosen step, the proposed action replaces the agent's own, and the same agent continues. The score, causal repair, is the continuation success rate minus that of a paired placebo that replays the agent's original action through the same mechanism. Two tracks share this protocol: a post-hoc autopsy, where the diagnoser sees the whole failed run and is told that it failed, and live oversight, where a supervisor watches the run unfold and may intervene once, before an irreversible action, without knowing whether the run will fail. Tasks come from OpsWorld, a deterministic, procedurally generated back-office environment with six difficulty levels, the last of which is multimodal (QR codes, handwriting). On 62 calibrated systematic failures, the best of 13 frontier models (Grok 4.7) reaches a causal repair of +51.3 points; the top eight models are statistically indistinguishable, the flagship models of the two largest vendors rank 8th and 12th, and 5 items are repaired by no model. Forcing a strong model to intervene at the last step costs it 17.1 points, so the last-step shortcut of annotation-based attribution benchmarks does not transfer. On 87 runs, the two best live supervisors are statistically tied and one of them is a small open-weight model (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash); the supervisor that is among the best post-hoc diagnosers (GPT-6.1 Sol) is the weakest live one (-14.5 points on the same runs, p = 0.002), so post-hoc diagnostic performance can be a poor proxy for live oversight. The environment and the evaluation code are released at this https URL.

papers.title: Characterizing Recoverable Expert-Utilization Signatures in Fine-Tuned Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.abstract: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models are increasingly deployed in distributed environments, from federated learning to edge-cloud systems, their architecture harbors an underexplored landscape of security vulnerabilities. Moving beyond textual analysis, we uncover structural memorization: a novel vulnerability where a fine-tuned model memorizes not only its training data but also the internal pathway used to process it, creating a characteristic routing fingerprint unique to the training process. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence that structural memorization emerges consistently even from a few samples, and that its intensity is directly influenced by the choice of trainable modules. We show that these memorized expert pathways can be stealthily recovered through the model's unconditional generation, using only routing and output logits, with no knowledge of the fine-tuning data or procedure. In distributed deployments, this vulnerability is amplified as routing information is exposed at multiple trust boundaries, including federated aggregation points, edge-cloud interfaces, and multi-tenant monitoring systems. Recovery exposes a critical blind spot: traditional membership inference metrics, viewed through the lens of expert routing, fail to identify memorized data corresponding to these structural pathways. To close this gap, we devise composite metrics combining reference model tail likelihood with complexity-aware normalization, significantly improving detection of memorized routing structures. This enables adversaries to pinpoint critical experts shaped by fine-tuning, whether dominant or dormant, and execute targeted attacks such as router manipulation or backdoor injection in realistic distributed settings where attackers lack training data but can observe routing patterns across system components.

papers.title: Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning
papers.abstract: LLM agents serve natural-language requests through tools, data sources, and other agents, and even simple requests often need several interdependent calls. Typically, the LLM picks these calls by trial and error, with no guarantee of an executable plan. We present Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning (CGAP), which instead reasons about what a request requires and what tools provide. CGAP compiles the tool catalog deterministically into a PDDL model, uses an LLM to turn the request into goals, and solves the model with a classical planner. Since tool outputs are unknown in advance, the model is abstract, tracking which inputs are available, not their values. During execution, an LLM adds entity-specific calls that abstract plans omit, and deterministic checks reject any that break the plan. Every argument is drawn from a cited source, such as a conversation span or an earlier tool response, and each requested result counts as delivered only after an LLM verifier checks it against the request. With three LLMs on ToolSandbox, ComplexFuncBench, BFCL multi-turn, and $\tau^2$-bench retail, CGAP outperforms a standard tool-calling agent by up to 28.9 points.
