papers.title: Before We Adapt: The Zero-Shot Generalization Bottleneck in Continual World Models
papers.abstract: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires agents to operate under environmental changes while reusing prior knowledge whenever possible. We argue that model-based reinforcement learning provides a promising framework for this setting because learned world models (WMs) can, in principle, support change detection, knowledge reuse, adaptation, and acquisition of new knowledge. However, such benefits depend heavily on whether the learned model can generalize beyond the contexts in which it was trained. In this work, we propose to formulate this problem with a contextual Markov decision process in which context is decomposed into behavioral and physical components. This view organizes continual WM learning into reuse, adaptation, and acquisition of new knowledge. As a first step, we study direct reuse when behavioral rules remain unchanged. Using Dyna-Q and TD-MPC in controlled FourRooms tasks, we find that zero-shot reuse can degrade substantially under physical-context changes and that this behavior depends strongly on the observation representation used by the WM. Additional ablation studies and latent-space diagnostics suggest that learned representations do not automatically provide the invariances needed for reuse. These results identify representation generalization as an important bottleneck for reliable world-model reuse in CRL.

papers.title: Consensus Within, Competition Between: Decentralized LLM Teams for Perimeter Defense
papers.abstract: The use of large language models (LLMs) to coordinate multi-agent teams raises a fundamental architectural question: whether task allocation should be centralized in a single LLM controller or distributed across autonomous LLM agents, particularly when communication is unreliable. In a deliberately simplified perimeter-defense simulation against LLM-controlled intruders, we compared a central commander, an auction-based consensus team and independent agents under five network conditions. Breach rates were 15% for the consensus team, 32% for the commander and 29% for independent agents, and of the different network conditions, only limited radio range changed a team's breach rate, raising the commander's. In consensus team, giving a low-cost LLM more authority over the bid computation raised breaches by 38 percentage points. With birds and civilian drones in airspace, we added a photograph for each to the input text state. Only the near-frontier model treated them apart from intruders. Intruders disguised as existing taxidermy bird drones were mistook as birds by both low-cost and near-frontier LLMs, going unpursued in 59-61% of near-frontier decisions (1-16% before). However, a one-sentence forewarning in the prompt lowered it to 0-25%. We find that LLM team with a dedicated external conflict resolution protocol results in fewest breaches. Code: this https URL.

translation.title: 内部共识，团队竞争：用于周界防御的去中心化LLM团队
translation.abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）协调多智能体团队引发了一个根本性的架构问题：任务分配应由单一LLM控制器集中管理，还是分布在自主LLM智能体之间，尤其是在通信不可靠的情况下。在一个刻意简化的、对抗LLM控制入侵者的周界防御仿真中，我们在五种网络条件下比较了中央指挥官、基于拍卖的共识团队和独立智能体。共识团队的突破率为15%，指挥官为32%，独立智能体为29%；而在不同网络条件中，只有受限的无线电范围改变了团队的突破率，且是提高了指挥官的。在共识团队中，让低成本LLM在出价计算上拥有更多权限会使突破率上升38个百分点。考虑到空域中的鸟类和民用无人机，我们在输入文本状态中为每类目标添加了一张照片。只有接近前沿水平的模型能将它们与入侵者区分开来。伪装成现有标本鸟类无人机的入侵者被低成本和近前沿LLM都误判为鸟类，在近前沿模型的决策中有59-61%未予追击（此前为1-16%）。然而，在提示中加入一句预警可将其降至0-25%。我们发现，配备专门外部冲突解决协议的LLM团队突破次数最少。代码：this https URL。
translation.brief: 研究多智能体LLM团队在周界防御任务中集中式与去中心化任务分配的优劣，通过对比实验和拍卖共识机制评估不同架构与网络条件下的防御表现。

papers.title: Measuring Personal Information Exposure in Mental Health-Related Conversations with LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for informal mental health support, yet the privacy implications of conversational interaction remain poorly understood. Prior LLM privacy research has focused largely on model-side risks such as memorization and adversarial extraction, leaving personal information inferred from ordinary conversation understudied. We introduce a profile-recovery framework that measures personal information exposure by comparing user profiles with attributes inferred from conversation alone. We generate 240 synthetic multi-turn mental health conversations from profiles sampled from a nationally representative health survey and validate them against real counseling transcripts, finding comparable overall disclosure volume. Across 21 attributes, 33-41% of each profile is recoverable, with 76.5% first-inference and 94.3% any-of-3 accuracy. 239 of 240 conversations expose at least one sensitive mental health attribute, and 45.0\% expose all six. Our findings reveal a gap between disclosure and inferability, motivating HCI approaches to make inference risks legible and support privacy-aware interaction design.

translation.title: 测量LLM心理健康相关对话中的个人信息暴露
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于非正式心理健康支持，但对话交互的隐私影响仍知之甚少。以往的LLM隐私研究主要关注模型侧风险，如记忆和对抗性提取，而对从普通对话中推断出的个人信息研究不足。我们提出了一个画像恢复框架，通过将用户画像与仅从对话推断出的属性进行比较来衡量个人信息暴露。我们从具有全国代表性的健康调查中采样画像，生成了240段合成的多轮心理健康对话，并用真实咨询记录进行验证，发现总体披露量相当。在21个属性中，每个画像有33-41%可被恢复，首次推断准确率为76.5%，三次中任一次推断准确率为94.3%。240段对话中有239段暴露了至少一个敏感心理健康属性，45.0%暴露了全部六个属性。我们的发现揭示了披露与可推断性之间的差距，促使HCI方法使推断风险清晰可见并支持隐私感知的交互设计。
translation.brief: 提出画像恢复框架，通过从合成心理健康对话中推断用户属性来量化LLM对话中的个人信息暴露程度。

papers.title: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Since large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory, what they store now shapes what they do later. A memory manager decides how each input changes this memory and which records the agent acts on. It can fail in two ways: keeping a fact that has since changed (outdated memory), or storing a planted passage or injected instruction (memory poisoning). Most prior work studies them separately, yet they call for opposite write decisions, so no fixed write rule handles both. We therefore formalize memory robustness as handling both without doing worse on other inputs. Since accuracy checks only the answer, we measure robustness with evidence-conditioned accuracy (ECA), which also checks that the records the manager selects include all the evidence the answer needs, updated and free of attacks. However, existing memory systems and defenses are not more robust than an untuned manager on our test sets. We improve robustness with a simple one-shot recipe that fine-tunes the manager on episodes synthesized around a single conversation with inserted changes and attacks. On three backbones, it improves every category score on our test sets and more than doubles the untuned manager's overall ECA, though robustness remains incomplete.

translation.title: 接受变更，拒绝攻击：LLM智能体的鲁棒记忆管理
translation.abstract: 由于大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖长期记忆，它们现在存储的内容决定了它们日后的行为。记忆管理器决定每个输入如何改变记忆，以及智能体依据哪些记录行动。它可能以两种方式失败：保留一个已经改变的事实（过时记忆），或存储一段植入的文本或注入的指令（记忆投毒）。以往工作大多分别研究这两者，但它们要求相反的写入决策，因此没有固定的写入规则能同时应对。因此，我们将记忆鲁棒性形式化为同时处理两者且不在其他输入上表现更差。由于准确率只检查答案，我们用证据条件准确率（ECA）来衡量鲁棒性，它还检查管理器选择的记录是否包含答案所需的全部证据，且已更新、无攻击。然而，在我们的测试集上，现有记忆系统和防御方法并不比未调优的管理器更鲁棒。我们用一个简单的一次性配方提升鲁棒性：在围绕单个对话合成的、插入变更和攻击的片段上微调管理器。在三个骨干模型上，它提升了测试集上所有类别的得分，使未调优管理器的整体ECA翻倍以上，尽管鲁棒性仍不完善。
translation.brief: 形式化LLM智能体记忆管理中的过时记忆与记忆投毒双重鲁棒性问题，提出证据条件准确率（ECA）指标和基于合成片段微调的一次性改进方法。

papers.title: Out of sync: Accommodation, evaluation, and emergence in five weeks with an agentic AI teammate
papers.abstract: As agentic AI in education shifts from reactive tools toward partners that take initiative and persist over time, a central question is how learners relate to, evaluate, and benefit from artificial agency. We conducted a longitudinal experiment in an undergraduate learning analytics course, in which 17 student teams (N = 48) collaborated with a persistent LLM-based teammate across weekly sessions. The agent decided when to intervene through a trigger-based architecture, and its social role was manipulated between teams: a Cognitive Agent that challenged quick consensus or a Supportive Agent that invited quieter members to contribute. Combining chat discourse, post-session surveys, and spoken reflections, we identified distinct patterns unfolding across three timescales. Students accommodated their language to the agent's role immediately, using more social language toward the Supportive Agent from the first session. Their helpfulness evaluations were recalibrated from session to session in relation to the agent's observed behavior, rather than remaining anchored to students' pre-existing attitudes toward AI. A slower crossover emerged in perceived collaboration process and positive-affect word use in reflections: Supportive-Agent teams began below Cognitive-Agent teams and ended above them, although students rated the Supportive Agent less helpful throughout. Because these responses follow different trajectories, single-session evaluations of agentic AI may miss changes that emerge only through repeated interaction.

translation.title: 失同步：与智能体AI队友共处五周中的语言顺应、评价与涌现
translation.abstract: 随着教育中的智能体AI从被动工具转向主动发起行动并长期存在的伙伴，一个核心问题是学习者如何与人工智能体建立关系、评价它并从中受益。我们在一门本科学习分析课程中开展了纵向实验，17个学生团队（N=48）在每周课程中与一个持久的基于LLM的队友协作。该智能体通过基于触发的架构决定何时介入，其社会角色在团队间被操纵：一个是挑战快速共识的认知型智能体，另一个是邀请较安静成员发言的支持型智能体。结合聊天话语、课后调查和口头反思，我们识别出在三个时间尺度上展开的不同模式。学生立即顺应了智能体角色的语言，从第一次课起就对支持型智能体使用更多社交语言。他们的有用性评价随课程逐次根据智能体的观察行为重新校准，而非锚定于学生对AI的既有态度。在感知协作过程和反思中积极情感词汇的使用上，出现了较慢的交叉：支持型智能体团队起初低于认知型智能体团队，最终高于后者，尽管学生始终认为支持型智能体不太有用。由于这些反应遵循不同轨迹，对智能体AI的单次评估可能错过只有通过反复交互才会涌现的变化。
translation.brief: 通过纵向课堂实验考察学生与持久LLM智能体队友的互动，揭示语言顺应、评价校准与协作感知在不同时间尺度上的差异化演变。

papers.title: LanG 2.0: Energy-Efficient Agentic AI for Semi-Automated Security Operations at Scale
papers.abstract: Security operations centers (SOCs) need to turn terabytes of alerts, logs and flows into trusted, affordable decisions to unveil hidden threats. We present LanG 2.0, an agentic system that detects threats, correlates evidence and writes rules, investigating whether small local models can replace frontier models affordably and safely when structural safeguards, not model accuracy, provide the guarantees. It incorporates entity-anchored correlation, human approval of rule changes and a tamper-evident ledger. Tests span eight flow datasets from five networks, real XDR alerts and multistage campaigns. Against its predecessor, campaign correlation precision rises from 18.75% to 51.81%, and rule acceptance from at most 60.00% to 98.33%. Against Claude Opus 5.5, scoring flows against each network's normal traffic detects attacks on unseen networks at 73.42% F1 without false positives, versus 58.10% with 49.00% false positives, for at least 650 times less energy. Finetuned models statistically match it on alert classification and rule writing for 5.6 to 59 times less energy. The work demonstrates LanG's practical scalability, processing 3.33 million records in 6.4 minutes, over 30 million hourly, and its safeguards resisted prompt injection, label poisoning and ledger tampering, so small local models can carry most SOC detection affordably and safely.

translation.title: LanG 2.0：面向大规模半自动化安全运营的节能智能体AI
translation.abstract: 安全运营中心（SOC）需要将数TB的告警、日志和流量转化为可信且负担得起的决策，以揭示隐藏威胁。我们提出LanG 2.0，一个检测威胁、关联证据并编写规则的智能体系统，研究在结构性保障措施（而非模型准确率）提供保证时，小型本地模型能否以可负担且安全的方式替代前沿模型。它集成了实体锚定关联、规则变更的人工审批和防篡改账本。测试涵盖来自五个网络的八个流量数据集、真实XDR告警和多阶段攻击活动。与其前代相比，攻击活动关联精确率从18.75%升至51.81%，规则接受率从最高60.00%升至98.33%。与Claude Opus 5.5相比，将流量与各网络正常流量对比评分可在无假阳性的情况下以73.42%的F1检测未见网络上的攻击，而后者为58.10%且假阳性率49.00%，同时能耗至少低650倍。微调模型在告警分类和规则编写上统计上与之相当，能耗低5.6至59倍。该工作展示了LanG的实际可扩展性，6.4分钟处理333万条记录，每小时超过3000万条，其保障措施抵御了提示注入、标签投毒和账本篡改，因此小型本地模型可以可负担且安全地承担大部分SOC检测任务。
translation.brief: 提出LanG 2.0智能体安全运营系统，通过实体锚定关联、人工审批和防篡改账本等结构性保障，使小型本地模型以低能耗安全替代前沿模型完成SOC威胁检测。

papers.title: BABA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Patient-Advocacy Agents
papers.abstract: An LLM agent that helps a patient get care must do two things. It must reach the correct outcome, and it must follow the necessary procedure. For example, the agent must get the patient's permission before it shares the patient's records. We introduce BABA-Bench, a benchmark of 47 interactive worlds. We built each world from a de-identified, real patient advocacy case that expert advocates reviewed. In each world, the agent must find hidden information and coordinate insurers, clinics, suppliers, pharmacies, and community organizations. The engine checks each action at the time the agent does it. It checks if the agent has permission, if the agent has evidence for the action, and if the action is prohibited. We evaluated 14 frontier models with three runs on each world, for a total of 1,974 runs. Agents often reached the correct outcome by an invalid route. Of the 921 runs that reached all required outcomes, 254 (28%) did not follow the necessary procedure. Claude Opus 5 reached all required outcomes in 81.6% of its runs, but only 52.5% of its runs passed all checks. When we gave two models a verified route, their pass rates increased from 29.8% to 91.5% and from 44.0% to 97.2%. For these models, the main problem is to find a route, not to execute it.

papers.title: CIRCE Divines LLM Task Complexity from Constraint Structure
papers.abstract: Estimating whether a problem is too complex for a large language model (LLM) before the model attempts it can guide model routing, how to allocate test-time compute, and suggest the need for new tools to aid the agent. While existing estimators rely on the problem text, LLM-annotated task difficulty labels, or signals obtained after a model attempts to solve the problem, such as its hidden states, none explicitly leverage the constraint structure inherent in the problem: the variables to assign and how the constraints over them interact. We introduce CIRCE, which extracts a problem's structure by using a cheap LLM to construct a Constraint Intermediate Representation that deterministically compiles into the constraint graph. Across seven reasoning benchmarks (including SAT, logic, and math) and four LLMs, even a randomly initialized GNN encoder improves predictions of LLM response correctness, reducing negative log-likelihood from 0.465 to 0.423 and increasing AUROC from 0.691 to 0.727 relative to the strongest baseline for each metric.

papers.title: Verifying Text-to-SQL Queries under Changing Business Semantics
papers.abstract: In text-to-SQL and AI-agent analytics, successful SQL execution does not establish semantic correctness under changing business definitions. We study revalidation of fixed queries after changes to refund attribution, tax treatment, eligible populations and exchange-rate dates. An executable verification profile binds the requested revision and knowledge cutoff to legal counterexample data and exact monetary comparison. A preregistered confirmation on 32 newly authored revision families and two local producer bundles retains 192 query-definition cells: 144 nonconforming, 36 finite-suite agreeing and 12 unresolved. Of the nonconforming cells, 63 agree on the current snapshot. At an eight-ledger budget, obligation-guided checking detects 137 discrepancies versus 127 for generic ordering, a paired difference of 6.9 percentage points (family bootstrap 95% interval [2.1, 13.6]; exact family sign-flip p=0.0156). Every ledger arm rejects zero of the 36 agreeing cells. Current-obligation and equal-weight scoring match the guided result, identifying coverage rather than revision-specific priority as the observed source of benefit. Controlled assays, a natural-query pilot and repeated samples provide separate mechanism and robustness evidence. A legal discrepancy refutes conformance; agreement remains restricted to the recorded suite. The study establishes an auditable business-semantic revalidation profile within its authored schema and local-model scope.

papers.title: AIFaultBench: A Reproducible Benchmark of Real-World Faults in AI Software Systems
papers.abstract: AI-based software systems remain difficult to debug because their failures can involve interactions among code, models, data, dependencies, hardware, and execution environments. Existing benchmarks cover specific classes of AI systems, while concerns about fault realism and reproducibility highlight the need for documented execution conditions and evidence. We present AIFaultBench, a benchmark of 770 real-world bugs from 105 AI-based software repositories across 76 organizations. It covers six classes of AI systems: machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, systems based on large language models, agentic AI, and AI tooling and infrastructure. Each bug record connects the original report and affected codebase to structured metadata, environment setup scripts, a reproduction trigger, and investigation evidence. We reproduced 652 bugs (84.7%) under the recorded execution conditions and documented the outcomes of the remaining 118 attempts. Through its broad coverage, documented reproduction evidence, and common structure, AIFaultBench supports empirical studies of AI faults, debugging tool evaluation, practical failure investigation, and teaching with real-world examples.

papers.title: RepGen: Reproducing Deep Learning Bugs through Context-Aware Code Generation and Verification
papers.abstract: Reproducing deep learning (DL) bugs is challenging because failures can involve source code, models, data, dependencies, and execution environments. Incomplete bug reports further complicate reproduction by omitting essential details. We present RepGen, an open-source tool for reproducing DL bugs through context-aware code generation and iterative verification. Given a bug report and repository, RepGen explores the codebase to build a learning-enhanced context, develop a reproduction plan, and generate candidate scripts. It refines candidates using static checks and LLM feedback to improve their correctness and relevance. When enabled, the tool prepares the execution environment, runs the script, and assesses its output against the reported failure. RepGen provides an interactive command-line interface supporting local and hosted LLMs, configurable execution budgets, and inspectable artifacts, along with a GitHub Action for automated issue processing. The underlying approach reproduced 85 of 106 real-world DL bugs (80.19%). A controlled study with 27 developers showed a 23.35% improvement in reproduction success and a 56.8% reduction in reproduction time.
