papers.title: Optimal climate policy in incomplete electricity markets
papers.abstract: Incomplete long-term contracting in electricity markets can expose investors and consumers to inefficient levels of risk. This paper investigates how incompleteness impacts the optimal choice of climate policy. We develop a game-theoretic model of optimal policy-making in anticipation of how electricity market agents react to a given policy when gas prices and demand are uncertain and contracting is incomplete. In illustrative experiments, we observe that renewable subsidies and carbon prices induce an insurance co-benefit when markets are incomplete. This is because, relative to a complete market benchmark, incompleteness shifts investment from renewables toward gas and exposes consumers to uninsured risk from inter-annual volatility in electricity prices. By incentivizing investment in renewables, subsidies and carbon prices indirectly counteract these distortions. Consequently, incompleteness increases the optimal subsidy and carbon price levels in our experiments. Renewable subsidies exhibit a stronger insurance effect than carbon pricing, as the latter leads to more investment in gas with carbon capture and storage and more volatile electricity prices. While carbon pricing is more economically efficient than subsidies in complete markets, incompleteness shrinks its efficiency advantage and even leads to cases where subsidies are more economically efficient.

translation.title: 不完全电力市场中的最优气候政策
translation.abstract: 电力市场中长期合约的不完全性会使投资者和消费者暴露于低效的风险水平。本文研究不完全性如何影响气候政策的最优选择。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，用于在天然气价格和需求不确定且合约不完全的情况下，预测电力市场参与者对给定政策的反应，从而进行最优政策制定。在示例性实验中，我们观察到当市场不完全时，可再生能源补贴和碳价格会产生一种保险协同收益。这是因为相对于完全市场基准，不完全性使投资从可再生能源转向天然气，并使消费者暴露于电价年际波动带来的未保险风险。通过激励可再生能源投资，补贴和碳价格间接抵消了这些扭曲。因此，在我们的实验中，不完全性提高了最优补贴和碳价格水平。可再生能源补贴比碳定价表现出更强的保险效应，因为后者会导致更多带碳捕集与封存的天然气投资以及更波动的电价。虽然在完全市场中碳定价在经济效率上优于补贴，但不完全性缩小了其效率优势，甚至出现补贴在经济上更有效的情况。
translation.brief: 研究电力市场合约不完全性如何改变最优气候政策，通过博弈论模型分析发现补贴和碳价格具有保险协同效应，从而提高其最优水平。

papers.title: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Self-distillation methods for large language models with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher already retain a history of student updates. Muon nevertheless stores a separate momentum buffer, increasing persistent training memory. We propose Muon with Reused Teacher (Muon-RT), which reuses the teacher-student displacement to eliminate momentum buffers for hidden weight matrices. We show that this displacement encodes an exponentially weighted history of applied updates and smooths temporally uncorrelated noise under a local model. Muon-RT removes its radial component, normalizes it spectrally, and mixes it with the current gradient after Newton-Schulz (NS) orthogonalization. Under explicit regularity and alignment assumptions, we establish linear contraction of an expected objective-gap bound toward a residual error level. With Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Muon-RT improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.6 points with 42% less persistent memory, and over momentum Muon by 5.4 points with 27% less persistent memory. With Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) on Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, it improves average accuracy over AdamW by 2.0 points.

translation.title: MUON-RT：复用教师轨迹实现无动量 Muon 用于 LLM 自蒸馏
translation.abstract: 采用指数移动平均（EMA）教师的大语言模型自蒸馏方法本身已保留了学生更新的历史记录。然而 Muon 仍需存储单独的动量缓冲区，增加了持久训练内存。我们提出 Muon with Reused Teacher（Muon-RT），它复用教师-学生位移来消除隐藏权重矩阵的动量缓冲区。我们证明该位移编码了已应用更新的指数加权历史，并在局部模型下平滑时间上不相关的噪声。Muon-RT 移除其径向分量，对其进行谱归一化，并在 Newton-Schulz（NS）正交化后将其与当前梯度混合。在明确的正则性和对齐假设下，我们建立了期望目标差距界向残差误差水平的线性收缩。在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上使用 Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning（SDFT），Muon-RT 相比 AdamW 平均准确率提升 2.6 个百分点且持久内存减少 42%，相比动量 Muon 提升 5.4 个百分点且持久内存减少 27%。在 Olmo-3-7B-Instruct 上使用 Self-Distillation Policy Optimization（SDPO），相比 AdamW 平均准确率提升 2.0 个百分点。
translation.brief: 提出 Muon-RT，通过复用自蒸馏中教师-学生位移替代动量缓冲区，在降低训练内存的同时提升 LLM 微调性能。

papers.title: Calibration of Large Model Quantization based on HiFloat4 Format
papers.abstract: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has be- coming increasingly important for reducing the computa- tional costs and resource requirements for practical deploy- this http URL- nity to move beyond 8-bit quantization towards 4-bit preci- sion, leading to the development of customized 4-bit formats such as MXFP4 and NVFP4. Recently, HiFloat4 (HiF4) has emerged as a competitive alternative which adopts a Block Floating-Point(BFP)formatwithathree-levelscalinghierar- chy, thereby achieving a significantly larger dynamic range. While quantization can substantially reduce memory usage and accelerate inference, it frequently introduces accuracy degradation. Calibration is therefore essential for narrowing theperformancegapbetweenlow-precisionquantizedmodels and their full-precision counterparts. Nevertheless, existing calibration methods are mainly designed and validated us- ing integer-precision formats, such as INT4, lacking support for HiF4 due to its hierarchical BFP structure. In this paper, weinvestigatethreecalibrationapproaches,namelyHiGPTQ, HiAutoRound, and HiFlatQuant, to further enhance model this http URL demonstratethatallthreeproposedapproachesimproveinfer- ence accuracy compared with direct HiF4 conversion, reduc- ing the gap between HiF4 and BF16 to less than 1% and out- performing the state-of-the-art NVFP4 format across various models and downstream tasks.

translation.title: 基于 HiFloat4 格式的大模型量化校准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的量化对于降低实际部署的计算成本和资源需求日益重要。社区正从 8-bit 量化迈向 4-bit 精度，催生了 MXFP4 和 NVFP4 等定制化 4-bit 格式。最近，HiFloat4（HiF4）作为一种有竞争力的替代方案出现，它采用具有三级缩放层级的块浮点（BFP）格式，从而实现显著更大的动态范围。虽然量化可以大幅减少内存使用并加速推理，但经常引入精度下降。因此，校准对于缩小低精度量化模型与全精度模型之间的性能差距至关重要。然而，现有校准方法主要针对 INT4 等整数精度格式设计和验证，由于 HiF4 的层级 BFP 结构而缺乏支持。本文研究了三种校准方法，即 HiGPTQ、HiAutoRound 和 HiFlatQuant，以进一步提升模型性能。我们证明这三种方法相比直接 HiF4 转换均能提升推理精度，将 HiF4 与 BF16 之间的差距缩小到 1% 以内，并在多种模型和下游任务上超越最先进的 NVFP4 格式。
translation.brief: 针对 HiFloat4 层级块浮点格式缺乏校准方法的问题，提出 HiGPTQ、HiAutoRound 和 HiFlatQuant 三种校准方法以缩小量化模型与全精度模型的精度差距。

papers.title: Confident Fools or Careful Searchers? A Behavioural Study of When LLMs Search Beyond Their Static Internal Memory
papers.abstract: Agentic LLM assistants must repeatedly decide whether to answer from memory or to call a tool such as web search. Unnecessary searches cost latency and money; missing ones yield confident but unsupported answers. Prior work mostly measures verbalised confidence or trains new adaptive-retrieval methods, and rarely audits the search decisions that deployed products actually make. We introduce a benchmark of 400 multiple-choice questions that combines widely known inside-knowledge (IK) questions, which should be answered directly, with outside-knowledge (OK) questions about facts from news published after the models' training cut-offs (to our knowledge), which should trigger search or, without tools, abstention. Each item offers an abstain option, and two action-level scores, NAS and KIS, reward searching on OK questions and restraint on IK questions. Across five commercial LLMs with and without their vendors' web search, GPT-5 mini and Grok 4 Fast search on over 90% of OK but only 1% of IK questions, whereas Mistral Small searches on just 20% of OK questions, often abstaining instead of using its tool; one product's search indicator proved unusable. Searching is partly triggered by explicit temporal cues: on uncued OK questions, the NAS of the two selective models falls from about 0.72 to 0.57--0.58. The scores thus measure the search triggering of specific products, not metacognition in a strict sense.

translation.title: 自信的傻瓜还是谨慎的搜索者？关于 LLM 何时在静态内部记忆之外进行搜索的行为研究
translation.abstract: Agentic LLM 助手必须反复决定是凭记忆回答还是调用网络搜索等工具。不必要的搜索会增加延迟和成本；而遗漏搜索则会产生自信但缺乏依据的回答。以往工作大多测量口头表达的置信度或训练新的自适应检索方法，很少审计已部署产品实际做出的搜索决策。我们引入了一个包含 400 道多选题的基准，将广为人知的内部知识（IK）问题（应直接回答）与外部知识（OK）问题（关于模型训练截止日期之后发布的新闻事实，应触发搜索，或在无工具时弃答）相结合。每个题目提供弃答选项，并使用两个动作级分数 NAS 和 KIS，分别奖励在 OK 问题上的搜索行为和 IK 问题上的克制。在五款商业 LLM（含厂商自带网络搜索的版本）上的测试显示，GPT-5 mini 和 Grok 4 Fast 在超过 90% 的 OK 问题上搜索，但在 IK 问题上仅搜索 1%；而 Mistral Small 仅在 20% 的 OK 问题上搜索，常常弃答而非使用工具；某产品的搜索指示器被证明不可用。搜索部分由显式时间线索触发：在无线索的 OK 问题上，两个选择性模型的 NAS 从约 0.72 降至 0.57–0.58。因此这些分数衡量的是特定产品的搜索触发行为，而非严格意义上的元认知。
translation.brief: 构建含内部/外部知识问题的基准并设计 NAS、KIS 动作级分数，审计商业 LLM 产品在何时决定调用网络搜索而非凭记忆回答。

papers.title: When Should AI Agents Ask? Clarification Requests Under Limited Human Attention
papers.abstract: AI agents increasingly carry out delegated tasks in parallel, with one person overseeing several of them at once. In practice, an agent often lacks information its task requires, such as an unstated preference, constraint, or specification. It can ask the human to clarify, or it can search for the information itself, for example in past records, which takes time and effort and may fail. In this paper, we study how to coordinate these decisions across several agents that share one human with limited attention. We build a stylized model in which each agent can search, ask, or continue the parts of its task that do not depend on the missing information, and we formulate the problem as a dynamic program. We first show that whether an agent should ask depends on more than its own uncertainty: an agent with other work to do can be better off asking earlier, and which question the human should answer first depends on all waiting questions, so no ranking computed agent by agent is optimal. We then propose the Pairwise Coordination Policy (PCP), which uses exact one- and two-task problems to estimate how pairs of tasks delay each other when they share the human. Theoretically, PCP is exactly optimal when at most two requirements remain unresolved and costs at most twice the optimum when every unresolved requirement must be resolved by the human. We evaluate PCP on 864 synthetic cases and in a case study with LLM agents. On the synthetic benchmark, PCP's mean gap to optimal cost is 0.07%, and it reduces cost by an average of 18-31% relative to three standard rules for when to ask. In the LLM case study, agents completed every task correctly, and PCP achieved the lowest mean cost in all tested settings.

translation.title: AI 智能体何时应该提问？人类注意力有限下的澄清请求
translation.abstract: AI 智能体越来越多地并行执行受委托的任务，一个人同时监督多个智能体。实践中，智能体常常缺少任务所需的信息，例如未说明的偏好、约束或规格。它可以向人类请求澄清，也可以自行搜索信息（例如在过往记录中），但这需要时间和精力且可能失败。本文研究如何在共享一个注意力有限的人类的多个智能体之间协调这些决策。我们构建了一个风格化模型，其中每个智能体可以搜索、提问，或继续执行任务中不依赖缺失信息的部分，并将该问题表述为动态规划。我们首先证明智能体是否应该提问不仅取决于其自身的不确定性：有其他工作要做的智能体可能更早提问更好，而人类应先回答哪个问题取决于所有等待中的问题，因此逐个智能体独立计算的排序都不是最优的。然后我们提出成对协调策略（Pairwise Coordination Policy, PCP），它利用精确的单任务和双任务问题来估计共享人类的任务对之间如何相互延迟。理论上，当至多两个需求未解决时 PCP 恰好最优，当所有未解决需求都必须由人类解决时其成本至多为最优值的两倍。我们在 864 个合成案例和 LLM 智能体案例研究中评估 PCP。在合成基准上，PCP 与最优成本的平均差距为 0.07%，相比三种标准的提问时机规则平均降低成本 18–31%。在 LLM 案例研究中，智能体正确完成了所有任务，且 PCP 在所有测试设置中均取得最低平均成本。
translation.brief: 研究多个 AI 智能体共享一个注意力有限的人类时何时提问的问题，提出基于单/双任务精确解的成对协调策略（PCP）来协调提问与自行搜索的决策。

papers.title: When Disclosure Is Compulsory: Evaluating Ride-Hailing Rebalancing Policies with Self-Interested LLM Driver Agents
papers.abstract: The EU Platform Work Directive, to be transposed by December 2026, requires ride-hailing platforms to state in plain language the main parameters of their automated decisions and how a worker's behaviour affects them. Such rules are exactly what a large language model (LLM) can read, so drivers will be able to let one decide for them. We compare two main families of rebalancing policy once their rules are public: a reactive policy (R) that sends idle drivers to cover requests just lost, and an anticipatory policy (A) that plans moves on a demand forecast. Each driver is an LLM agent maximizing its own net income, given no rules (N) or the rules at the directive's level of detail (L). We test two LLMs, Claude Haiku 5.5 and Jev, which understand the rules equally well, in a three-zone model and in Manhattan. With the rules disclosed, drivers follow the platform more closely: in Manhattan, the share of relocation offers they decline falls from about four in five to one in four under both policies. Yet the effects differ by policy. For the platform, disclosure costs R 3.7% of its profit in Manhattan, as R now pays for moves drivers used to make for free, while A's profit is unchanged; the two policies, which tie on profit under full compliance, end 6.1% apart. For drivers, disclosure raises income in the small model under both policies and LLMs; for users, it raises the service rate there by 10 to 18 percentage points. In Manhattan, self-interested drivers also make A a win-win-win against full compliance, raising driver income, platform profit and service rate by 10 to 12% each. Rebalancing policies that perform equally well under full compliance can thus show opposite results under mandatory disclosure. The study offers a framework to evaluate such policies under the new requirement and is, to our knowledge, the first to do so with LLM agents.

translation.title: 当披露成为强制要求：基于自利LLM司机代理的网约车调度政策评估
translation.abstract: 欧盟平台工作指令将于2026年12月前转化实施，要求网约车平台用通俗语言说明其自动化决策的主要参数以及劳动者行为如何影响这些决策。这类规则恰好是大语言模型（LLM）能够阅读的，因此司机可以让LLM替他们做决策。我们在规则公开后比较两大类调度政策：反应式政策（R），将空闲司机派往刚失去的请求区域；预期式政策（A），基于需求预测规划调度。每个司机都是一个最大化自身净收入的LLM代理，条件为无规则（N）或指令级别的详细规则（L）。我们在三区域模型和曼哈顿场景中测试了两个对规则理解程度相当的LLM：Claude Haiku 5.5和Jev。规则披露后，司机更遵循平台指令：在曼哈顿，两种政策下司机拒绝调岗提议的比例从约五分之四降至四分之一。但效果因政策而异。对平台而言，披露使R在曼哈顿损失3.7%的利润，因为R现在需要为司机过去免费执行的调度付费，而A的利润不变；在完全合规下利润持平的两种政策，最终相差6.1%。对司机而言，披露在小模型中提高了两种政策和两个LLM下的收入；对用户而言，服务率提高了10到18个百分点。在曼哈顿，自利司机还使A相对完全合规实现三方共赢，司机收入、平台利润和服务率各提高10%到12%。因此，在完全合规下表现相当的调度政策，在强制披露下可能呈现相反的结果。本研究提供了一个在新要求下评估此类政策的框架，据我们所知，也是首个使用LLM代理进行此类评估的研究。
translation.brief: 研究强制披露调度规则对网约车平台的影响，通过让自利的LLM司机代理在反应式与预期式调度政策下决策来评估披露效果。

papers.title: Language Non-Invariance in the Ideological Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Recent multilingual studies show that political evaluations of large language models (LLMs) can vary across languages. This paper examines how robust this non-invariance is to questionnaire translation, surface wording, stochastic model variation, and instrument choice, and how much it matters for cross-model comparison. Using the Political Compass, the analysis compares the positions of five LLMs, GPT-3.5, GPT-4o, GPT-5.2, Qwen-2.5, and Mistral Large, on its economic and social axes in English, Spanish, and French, with repeated stochastic draws. Additional exercises use independent Spanish and French translations, paraphrased versions in all three languages, and an alternative ideological instrument. Measured ideological positions are not language-invariant: relative to English, between four and five of the ten pairwise model rankings reverse in Spanish or French, depending on the language and axis. The broad cross-language pattern persists under independent translations, indicating that it is not solely an artifact of the official questionnaire versions. Yet the magnitude of particular shifts, and in some cases their sign, remains sensitive to wording and instrument choice. The evidence therefore supports a measurement interpretation: ideological audits recover language- and instrument-conditioned outcomes rather than a language-free political attribute. Because a single provider serves distinct linguistic constituencies through a common product, without users observing what other constituencies receive, this lack of comparability also bears on political accountability and cross-model comparisons.

translation.title: 大语言模型意识形态评估中的语言非不变性
translation.abstract: 近期的多语言研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）的政治评估可能因语言而异。本文考察这种非不变性对问卷翻译、表面措辞、随机模型波动和测量工具选择的稳健性，以及它对跨模型比较的影响。分析采用政治罗盘（Political Compass），比较五个LLM——GPT-3.5、GPT-4o、GPT-5.2、Qwen-2.5和Mistral Large——在英语、西班牙语和法语中经济与社会轴上的位置，并进行多次随机抽样。额外的实验使用独立的西班牙语和法语翻译、三种语言的改写版本以及替代性意识形态测量工具。测得的意识形态立场不具有语言不变性：相对于英语，十组模型两两排序中有四到五组在西班牙语或法语中发生反转，具体取决于语言和轴。在独立翻译下，跨语言的总体模式依然存在，表明这并非官方问卷版本的伪影。然而，具体偏移的幅度（有时甚至方向）仍对措辞和工具选择敏感。因此，证据支持一种测量解释：意识形态审计得到的是受语言和工具条件制约的结果，而非无语言差异的政治属性。由于同一提供商通过同一产品服务不同语言群体，而用户无法看到其他群体得到的内容，这种不可比性也关系到政治问责和跨模型比较。
translation.brief: 考察LLM意识形态评估结果是否随语言变化，通过在多语言下用政治罗盘等工具重复测量五个模型来检验语言非不变性及其稳健性。

papers.title: TalentRL: Strategy-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Skill Routing
papers.abstract: Natural-language skills enable large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedures across tasks, yet most systems retrieve individual skills from a flat SkillBank without explicitly modeling the high-level strategy that governs their selection and use. We introduce TalentRL, a strategy-guided reinforcement learning framework for hierarchical routing over procedural memory. Coarse-grained talents represent recurring strategies for skill use, while fine-grained skills provide executable procedures. For each task, the policy model selects a talent that guides execution and softly prioritizes its associated skills during similarity-based retrieval. However, since task outcomes depend jointly on talent selection, retrieved skill context, and downstream execution, terminal rewards alone cannot isolate the contribution of the routing decision. TalentRL therefore trains talent routing with reward contrasts between rollouts of the same task under matched interventions on the talent-conditioned context, and optimizes downstream execution with group-relative advantages. Across seven open-domain and multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, talent-aware supervised fine-tuning improves average success rate by 7.53%, 6.71%, and 9.21% over the corresponding zero-shot baselines for Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively. Reinforcement learning further improves these SFT checkpoints by 7.58% to 9.32%, and TalentRL achieves the highest average success rate among all compared methods on all three backbones. On the agentic benchmarks ALFWorld and WebShop, TalentRL achieves the highest ALFWorld success rate (99.3%) and the highest WebShop score (90.7) among all compared methods.

translation.title: TalentRL：面向分层技能路由的策略引导强化学习
translation.abstract: 自然语言技能使大语言模型（LLM）代理能够跨任务复用流程，但大多数系统从扁平的SkillBank中检索单个技能，未显式建模支配技能选择和使用的高层策略。我们提出TalentRL，一个面向程序化记忆分层路由的策略引导强化学习框架。粗粒度的talent表示技能使用的常见策略，细粒度的skill提供可执行流程。对每个任务，策略模型选择一个talent来引导执行，并在基于相似度的检索中软性优先其关联技能。然而，由于任务结果共同取决于talent选择、检索到的技能上下文和下游执行，仅靠终端奖励无法分离路由决策的贡献。因此，TalentRL通过对同一任务的rollout在talent条件上下文的匹配干预下进行奖励对比来训练talent路由，并用组相对优势优化下游执行。在七个开放域和多跳问答基准上，talent感知的监督微调使Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B的平均成功率分别比相应零样本基线提高7.53%、6.71%和9.21%。强化学习进一步将这些SFT检查点提升7.58%到9.32%，且TalentRL在所有三个骨干上均取得所有对比方法中最高的平均成功率。在代理基准ALFWorld和WebShop上，TalentRL取得所有对比方法中最高的ALFWorld成功率（99.3%）和最高的WebShop分数（90.7）。
translation.brief: 解决LLM代理技能路由缺乏高层策略建模的问题，提出TalentRL，用奖励对比训练粗粒度talent路由并用组相对优势优化执行。

papers.title: Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation Improves Small Pointwise LLM Judges
papers.abstract: Agentic systems increasingly gate individual steps with a pointwise judge that scores a response against a criterion. Small language models are attractive for this role because they can be served and specialized efficiently. Such a judge must locate the criterion's decision boundary, but pointwise labels under-determine that boundary in fine-tuning: labeled responses to different queries differ along many dimensions at once, so they do not reveal which features decide the label. We introduce CPA (Counterfactual Pairwise Augmentation), which makes the deciding difference explicit in training. For each pointwise item, CPA synthesizes and audits a counterfactual response to the same query intended to carry the opposite label. It frames the accepted pair as a pairwise task asking which of the two responses satisfies the criterion. The judge is fine-tuned jointly on both pointwise and pairwise datasets and deployed in pointwise mode only. A second-order analysis shows when this should outperform the prevailing strategy of merging separately trained pointwise and pairwise experts: merging moves every parameter direction toward the pairwise expert by the same fraction, whereas joint training can hold the pointwise optimum wherever the pairwise loss is flat and absorb its curvature where it is sharp. This is the regime that CPA's same-source, counterfactually minimal pairwise view is designed to produce. On separate Qwen3-8B LoRA adapters for six binary criteria, CPA improves criterion-averaged pointwise macro-F1 by 2.5 points over pointwise-only training and outperforms model merging on all six criteria at every tested merge weight. It also surpasses the strongest zero-shot frontier judge we evaluate, Gemini 3.6 Flash, by 11.8 points.

translation.title: 反事实成对增强改进小型逐点LLM裁判
translation.abstract: 代理系统越来越多地使用逐点裁判对响应按标准打分来把关各个步骤。小型语言模型因可高效部署和特化而适合这一角色。这样的裁判必须定位标准的决策边界，但逐点标签在微调中不足以确定该边界：对不同查询的标注响应在多个维度上同时不同，因此无法揭示哪些特征决定标签。我们提出CPA（反事实成对增强），在训练中显式呈现决定性差异。对每个逐点样本，CPA为同一查询合成并审核一个预期携带相反标签的反事实响应，并将接受的响应对构造成成对任务，询问两个响应中哪个满足标准。裁判在逐点和成对数据集上联合微调，部署时仅使用逐点模式。二阶分析表明这为何应优于当前流行的合并分别训练的逐点与成对专家的策略：合并将每个参数方向按相同比例移向成对专家，而联合训练可以在成对损失平坦处保持逐点最优，并在其陡峭处吸收其曲率。这正是CPA的同源、反事实最小成对视图所设计产生的情形。在针对六个二元标准的独立Qwen3-8B LoRA适配器上，CPA将标准平均逐点macro-F1比仅逐点训练提高2.5分，并在所有测试合并权重下于全部六个标准上优于模型合并。它还以11.8分的优势超过我们评估的最强零样本前沿裁判Gemini 3.6 Flash。
translation.brief: 解决小型逐点LLM裁判训练中决策边界欠定的问题，提出CPA，通过为每个样本合成反事实响应对进行逐点与成对联合微调。

papers.title: Lineage Is Memory: Parent Inheritance and Feedback Disclosure in Short-Budget LLM-Guided Optimization
papers.abstract: Iterative language-model optimizers refine prompts and programs by evaluating a candidate, showing a proposer model a sample of failing cases, and keeping revisions that improve performance. Recent work attributes the limits of this loop to narrow single-round reflection, introducing full-set error clustering, targeted minibatches, or larger proposer models so the optimizer sees more failure modes per step. Yet every existing evaluation tests these mechanisms exclusively inside lineage-preserving search, where each revision edits a surviving parent, leaving the contribution of parent inheritance confounded with the breadth of per-round feedback. Across 1,750 pre-registered runs spanning nine prompt and program synthesis benchmarks, we separate parent inheritance from feedback disclosure under matched evaluation budgets. We find that greedy parent inheritance drives the vast majority of optimization progress, outperforming seed-reset resampling even when seed-reset proposals receive a clustered summary of all failures in every round or use a larger proposer model. While full-set error clustering and diverse failure selection improve single-step rewrites from the seed and accelerate the opening rounds of search, sequential parent inheritance rapidly closes this gap as solved error modes are retained in the candidate and filtered from subsequent failure lists. Moreover, decomposing token expenditure in GEPA reveals that proposer reflection accounts for only a small fraction of total cost whereas validation and minibatch gating consume nearly the entire budget, showing that greedy parent inheritance over raw failures captures the gains of complex reflective loops at a fraction of their compute.

translation.title: 谱系即记忆：短预算LLM引导优化中的父代继承与反馈披露
translation.abstract: 迭代式语言模型优化器通过评估候选方案、向提议模型展示失败案例样本并保留改进性能的修订来优化提示和程序。近期工作将这一循环的局限归因于狭窄的单轮反思，引入全集错误聚类、定向小批量或更大的提议模型，使优化器每步看到更多失败模式。然而，现有评估均仅在保留谱系的搜索中测试这些机制，即每次修订都编辑一个存活的父代，使父代继承的贡献与每轮反馈广度混淆。在跨越九个提示和程序合成基准的1750次预注册实验中，我们在匹配的评估预算下将父代继承与反馈披露分离。我们发现贪婪的父代继承驱动了绝大部分优化进展，即使种子重置采样每轮获得所有失败的聚类摘要或使用更大的提议模型，其表现仍不及父代继承。虽然全集错误聚类和多样化失败选择能改善从种子出发的单步改写并加速搜索初期，但随着已解决的错误模式被保留在候选中并从后续失败列表中过滤，顺序父代继承迅速弥合了这一差距。此外，对GEPA中token支出的分解显示，提议模型反思仅占总成本的一小部分，而验证和小批量门控消耗了几乎全部预算，表明对原始失败的贪婪父代继承能以极小的计算代价获得复杂反思循环的收益。
translation.brief: 分离LLM迭代优化中父代继承与反馈广度的贡献，通过大规模预注册实验证明贪婪父代继承是优化进展的主要驱动力。

papers.title: MATS: A Multi-Agent Framework for Controllable and Reflective Tumor Synthesis
papers.abstract: Synthesizing realistic tumors on medical images helps address data scarcity for clinical AI. Existing diffusion-based methods, however, lack fine-grained attribute-level controllability, closed-loop quality verification, and awareness of which morphological patterns are underrepresented in the target distribution. We present MATS, a multi-agent framework for text-controllable, cross-organ tumor synthesis. Given a target disease, MATS first profiles its morphological distribution over a fine-grained attribute space covering tumor geometry and appearance, and constructs a generation plan that amplifies underrepresented subtypes while keeping common ones dominant. It then localizes the target organ, proposes anatomically valid placement, and executes two-stage diffusion to produce the tumor mask and render texture, each conditioned on the corresponding attributes. A closed-loop reflective mechanism verifies attribute alignment at three checkpoints throughout synthesis and provides targeted feedback to guide re-generation when misalignment is detected. Trained exclusively on a single-source pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor dataset, MATS consistently improves downstream segmentation both in-domain and across LiTS, KiTS, and MSD-Pancreas benchmarks, whereas most prior generative augmentation methods fall below real-only training.

translation.title: MATS：一种可控且具反思性的肿瘤合成多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 在医学图像上合成逼真的肿瘤有助于缓解临床 AI 的数据稀缺问题。然而，现有基于扩散模型的方法缺乏细粒度的属性级可控性、闭环质量验证，以及对目标分布中哪些形态模式欠表示的感知能力。我们提出 MATS，一个支持文本可控、跨器官肿瘤合成的多智能体框架。给定目标疾病，MATS 首先在覆盖肿瘤几何与外观的细粒度属性空间中刻画其形态分布，并构建生成计划，在保持常见亚型主导的同时放大欠表示的亚型。随后它定位目标器官，提出解剖学上合理的放置位置，并执行两阶段扩散以生成肿瘤掩码并渲染纹理，每一步均以相应属性为条件。闭环反思机制在合成过程中的三个检查点验证属性对齐情况，并在检测到不对齐时提供针对性反馈以引导重新生成。仅在单一来源的胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤数据集上训练，MATS 在域内以及 LiTS、KiTS 和 MSD-Pancreas 基准上均持续提升下游分割性能，而大多数先前的生成式增强方法低于仅用真实数据训练的效果。
translation.brief: 针对医学图像肿瘤合成缺乏细粒度属性可控性与质量校验的问题，提出多智能体框架 MATS，通过属性分布画像、两阶段扩散生成与闭环反思机制实现跨器官的可控肿瘤合成。

papers.title: ARK: Avoiding Routing Collisions for KV Cache Transfer in Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Disaggregated LLM inference separates the prefill and decode phases across GPU pools, generating massive KV-cache transfers. Because these transfers last hundreds of milliseconds to seconds, they behave as mega elephant flows that dominate link bandwidth utilization. In this regime, stateless ECMP can perform poorly: hash collisions may overload one spine link while leaving others idle, stretching transfer times by seconds. Yet this same persistence makes coordination practical. Since these flows are long-lived, even lightweight one-to-all coordination can be amortized over their lifetime. We present ARK, a distributed elephant-flow path reservation mechanism. ARK coordinates senders to choose source ports whose hashes map concurrent flows onto distinct spines, without requiring switch changes or receiver-side packet reordering. Packet-level RDMA simulations show that ARK reduces mean and P95 FCT by up to 27.3% and 34.0% under moderate load, and further reduces mean TTFT by up to 12.9%.

translation.title: ARK：在分离式 LLM 推理中避免 KV Cache 传输的路由冲突
translation.abstract: 分离式 LLM 推理将 prefill 和 decode 阶段分离到不同的 GPU 池，产生大量 KV-cache 传输。由于这些传输持续数百毫秒到数秒，它们表现为占据链路带宽主导地位的巨型大象流。在这种情形下，无状态 ECMP 可能表现不佳：哈希冲突可能使一条 spine 链路过载而其他链路空闲，将传输时间延长数秒。然而，这种持久性也使协调变得可行。由于这些流是长寿命的，即使是轻量级的一对多协调也可以在其生命周期内摊销。我们提出 ARK，一种分布式大象流路径预留机制。ARK 协调发送端选择源端口，使其哈希将并发流映射到不同的 spine，无需修改交换机或接收端数据包重排序。数据包级 RDMA 仿真表明，在中等负载下 ARK 将平均 FCT 和 P95 FCT 分别降低最多 27.3% 和 34.0%，并将平均 TTFT 降低最多 12.9%。
translation.brief: 针对分离式 LLM 推理中 KV cache 大流在 ECMP 下因哈希冲突导致链路不均的问题，提出分布式大象流路径预留机制 ARK，通过协调发送端选择源端口使并发流映射到不同 spine。

papers.title: LLM Detoxification via Transition-Aware Reward-Guided Representation Sampling
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate toxic content, motivating effective test-time detoxification. Existing representation steering methods often rely on static or coarse interventions and provide imprecise guidance because they inadequately model transitions between toxic and non-toxic generations. We propose Transition-Aware Reward-Guided Representation Sampling (TARGRS), a test-time framework that learns reward guidance over toxicity transitions in latent representation space. During exploration, progressive steering along the toxicity direction constructs trajectories from non-toxic to toxic states. Toxicity scores along these trajectories turn sparse annotations into dense, listwise supervision for a transition-aware token-level reward model. During inference, TARGRS uses this model to guide coarse-to-fine sampling along the opposite, non-toxic direction: coarse sampling identifies the intervention needed to reach non-toxic regions, and refinement selects a detoxified representation with minimal perturbation. Experiments on 10 LLMs across RealToxicityPrompts, BOLD, and AttaQ show that TARGRS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing toxicity by up to 69.38% on RealToxicityPrompts. TARGRS runs nearly as fast as the original LLM while preserving its core capabilities with minimal impact. By intervening in the language decoder space, TARGRS also extends to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), reducing toxicity by up to 64.23% across 3 representative LVLMs.

translation.title: 基于转变感知奖励引导表示采样的 LLM 去毒化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可能生成有毒内容，因此需要有效的测试时去毒化方法。现有的表示引导方法通常依赖静态或粗粒度的干预，由于未能充分建模有毒与无毒生成之间的转变，提供的引导不够精确。我们提出转变感知奖励引导表示采样（TARGRS），一个在潜在表示空间中学习针对毒性转变的奖励引导的测试时框架。在探索阶段，沿毒性方向渐进式引导构建从无毒状态到有毒状态的轨迹。沿这些轨迹的毒性评分将稀疏标注转化为密集的 listwise 监督，用于训练转变感知的 token 级奖励模型。在推理阶段，TARGRS 使用该模型沿相反的无毒方向引导由粗到细的采样：粗采样确定到达无毒区域所需的干预，细化阶段则选择扰动最小的去毒化表示。在 10 个 LLM 上于 RealToxicityPrompts、BOLD 和 AttaQ 上的实验表明，TARGRS 持续优于最先进的基线，在 RealToxicityPrompts 上最多降低 69.38% 的毒性。TARGRS 运行速度几乎与原始 LLM 相当，且对其核心能力影响极小。通过在语言解码器空间进行干预，TARGRS 还可扩展到大型视觉语言模型（LVLM），在 3 个代表性 LVLM 上最多降低 64.23% 的毒性。
translation.brief: 针对现有表示引导去毒方法对毒性-非毒性状态转变建模不足的问题，提出 TARGRS 测试时框架，通过在潜在表示空间学习转变感知的奖励模型来引导由粗到细的采样实现去毒。

papers.title: ImplicitHop: Evaluating knowledge integration across context and memory
papers.abstract: The ability to integrate new information and deduce its consequences is central to learning, understanding, and reasoning in large language models (LLMs). Whether information arrives during training or in-context, models must not only store local facts, but propagate their long-range implications globally. To explore information integration in LLMs, we introduce two complementary natural language benchmarks for large-scale evaluation of deductive reasoning as a function of inference depth. The first is a formal graph benchmark enabling controlled evaluation over a wide range of graph topologies and integration tasks; the second is a knowledge composition benchmark grounded in real-world knowledge graphs. We use these benchmarks to compare knowledge integration from information encoded in context versus information encoded in model weights during pretraining, evaluating a set of open models implicitly, without chain of thought. We find that accuracy decays sharply with increased composition length for both pretrained and in-context knowledge. Information presented in-context, however, substantially outperforms deduction over information encoded in weights. These results quantify a fundamental limitation of current models with direct implications for prompt-based control of agent behavior and for continual learning strategies, and they provide a foundation for developing training, prompting, and integration methods that support deeper reasoning.

translation.title: ImplicitHop：评估跨上下文与记忆的知识整合
translation.abstract: 整合新信息并推导其后果的能力是大型语言模型（LLM）学习、理解与推理的核心。无论信息来自训练阶段还是上下文，模型不仅要存储局部事实，还要将其长程影响全局传播。为探索 LLM 中的信息整合，我们提出两个互补的自然语言基准，用于大规模评估演绎推理随推理深度的变化。第一个是形式化图基准，可在广泛的图拓扑和整合任务上进行受控评估；第二个是基于真实世界知识图谱的知识组合基准。我们利用这些基准比较来自上下文编码信息与预训练时编码于模型权重中信息的知识整合能力，以隐式方式（不使用思维链）评估一组开源模型。我们发现，无论是预训练知识还是上下文知识，准确率都随组合长度增加而急剧衰减。然而，上下文呈现的信息在演绎上显著优于编码在权重中的信息。这些结果量化了当前模型的一个根本局限，对基于提示的智能体行为控制和持续学习策略具有直接意义，并为开发支持更深层推理的训练、提示和整合方法提供了基础。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 跨上下文与权重进行知识整合能力缺乏系统评估的问题，构建两个演绎推理基准，发现推理深度增加时准确率急剧衰减且上下文信息显著优于权重内信息。

papers.title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. This largely solves accuracy: a harness with only BM25/grep and MiniMax M3 answers 85% of BrowseComp-Plus and 91% on multi-hop FRAMES in our runs, without compiled or vector indexes. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone--navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. Compilation is not a better retriever: under a competent harness, structural artifacts gave no detectable accuracy gain on FRAMES, and a PageIndex-style outline degraded at scale. It is a supply layer. A navigation tree whose leaves are claim-evidence pairs--the mechanism we measure--cuts query tokens by 91% when evidence suffices and adds 1.9% when it does not, a 38% average reduction; this implies a 2% break-even sufficiency rate and a measured rate near 43%. A decision gate cuts latency from 140 s to 30 s, though substitution's token saving is bought with retrieval rounds and carries its own latency cost. Other artifacts--ontology, graph, wiki, timeline, mind map, memory--pay off in deployment (governance, integration, onboarding, temporal orientation, continuity) where accuracy benchmarks cannot see them. We describe RAGFlow's pipeline and harness (open source at this https URL), which turns the loop into five disciplined stations and keeps the context entering the model the smallest sufficient set; together they form an agent-native database: a store that hands the agent compiled, governed context instead of a ranked list of passages.

translation.title: 上下文即基础设施：面向带 Harness 的智能体检索系统的知识编译
translation.abstract: 检索增强生成正在走向智能体化。搜索 harness 编写查询、阅读结果、重新表述并决定何时停止。这在很大程度上解决了准确性问题：在我们的实验中，仅使用 BM25/grep 和 MiniMax M3 的 harness 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 85%，在多跳 FRAMES 上达到 91%，且无需编译索引或向量索引。这暴露了一个上下文问题：缺乏约束的循环会重复查询、重读文档，并用未使用的段落填满窗口。缺失的一层是知识编译：一个可配置的摄取流水线，由 LLM 用任何单个 chunk 都不包含的上下文来丰富文档——包括以主张-证据对为叶节点的导航层级、实体图、时间线、思维导图、本体、wiki 和记忆。编译并不是更好的检索器：在有能力的 harness 下，结构化产物在 FRAMES 上没有可检测的准确率提升，而 PageIndex 风格的大纲在大规模下反而退化。它是一个供给层。以主张-证据对为叶节点的导航树——即我们测量的机制——在证据充分时将查询 token 减少 91%，在证据不充分时增加 1.9%，平均减少 38%；这意味着 2% 的盈亏平衡充分率，而实测充分率接近 43%。决策门控将延迟从 140 秒降至 30 秒，尽管替换带来的 token 节省是以检索轮次为代价的，并有其自身的延迟成本。其他产物——本体、图、wiki、时间线、思维导图、记忆——在部署中（治理、集成、上手、时间定位、连续性）发挥作用，而准确率基准无法体现这些价值。我们介绍了 RAGFlow 的流水线和 harness（开源于此 https URL），它将循环转化为五个规范化的站点，并使进入模型的上下文保持为最小的充分集合；二者共同构成一个智能体原生数据库：一个向智能体提供经过编译和治理的上下文、而非排序段落列表的存储。
translation.brief: 针对智能体检索中上下文浪费的问题，提出知识编译作为供给层的思路，构建 RAGFlow 流水线与 harness，以主张-证据导航树等编译产物大幅减少查询 token 并形成智能体原生数据库。

papers.title: TraceSpec: Understanding and Improving Speculative Decoding for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents execute tasks through repeated model calls over evolving histories of reasoning, actions, and tool feedback. Aggregate speculative-decoding metrics merge these distinct decisions, providing limited guidance on where draft supervision is needed. We present TraceSpec, a framework connecting trajectory evaluation with adaptive draft training. It combines dynamic execution with fixed-prefix replay and introduces TraceSpec-Traj, a corpus of 10,000 training states and 2,500 test states spanning browsing and software engineering. Analysis of five speculative baselines reveals that aggregate acceptance can rise with context length while declining within matched late browsing actions. Workload and phase further distinguish these trends, motivating supervision guided by trajectory conditions. TraceSpec trains on intermediate assistant turns and allocates a fixed prediction budget using state-conditioned estimates of prefix-aware acceptance gaps. Across three target sizes and two temperatures, it improves replay throughput by 12.5% to 22.6% over its DSpark base. Qwen3-4B ablations show that adaptive allocation increases accepted length by 3.3% to 10.0% over fixed full-turn supervision, with additional comparisons substantiating the roles of state conditioning and consecutive-token agreement. The resulting evaluation resources, trajectory findings, and training strategy connect the analysis of agent execution to practical draft improvement.

translation.title: TraceSpec：理解并改进面向 LLM Agent 的投机解码
translation.abstract: LLM agent 通过在不断演化的推理、动作和工具反馈历史之上反复调用模型来执行任务。聚合的投机解码指标将这些不同的决策混在一起，对何处需要草稿监督提供的指导有限。我们提出 TraceSpec，一个将轨迹评估与自适应草稿训练相连接的框架。它结合了动态执行与固定前缀重放，并引入 TraceSpec-Traj，一个涵盖浏览和软件工程、包含 10,000 个训练状态和 2,500 个测试状态的语料库。对五个投机基线的分析表明，聚合接受率可以随上下文长度上升，同时在匹配的后期浏览动作内下降。工作负载和阶段进一步区分了这些趋势，从而激发了由轨迹条件引导的监督。TraceSpec 在中间 assistant 轮次上训练，并使用基于状态条件的前缀感知接受差距估计来分配固定的预测预算。在三种目标模型规模和两种温度下，它比其 DSpark 基线将重放吞吐量提升了 12.5% 到 22.6%。Qwen3-4B 消融实验显示，自适应分配相比固定整轮监督将接受长度提升了 3.3% 到 10.0%，额外的比较也证实了状态条件和连续 token 一致性的作用。由此产生的评估资源、轨迹发现和训练策略将 agent 执行分析与实用的草稿改进联系起来。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM agent 场景下投机解码草稿监督缺乏轨迹级指导的问题，提出 TraceSpec 框架，通过轨迹评估语料库和基于状态条件的自适应预测预算分配来训练草稿模型。

papers.title: AgentShield: Fortifying Web Applications Against AI Agents and Agentic Browsers
papers.abstract: LLM-powered browser agents are transforming web automation by autonomously interacting with websites and executing complex workflows. However, the effectiveness of existing anti-bot defenses against these systems remains unclear. We present a systematic empirical evaluation of modern agentic browsers against widely deployed anti-bot mechanisms, characterizing their capabilities, limitations, and behavioral differences from humans. Our results show that many defenses designed for traditional automation struggle to reliably detect autonomous AI-driven agents. Accordingly, we introduce AgentShield, a behavioral fingerprinting framework that targets the Perception-Reasoning-Action (PRA) loop underlying agentic user clients. By leveraging dynamic web forms that progressively reveal content and capture fine-grained interaction telemetry, AgentShield exposes behavioral artifacts that enable differentiation between human users and autonomous agents. We further demonstrate Extinction-induced Policy Drift (EPD), a novel attack in which repeated obstruction of task completion causes agents to relax their safeguards and engage in unsafe behaviors. Finally, we present defensive prompt injection techniques that exploit agent-specific weaknesses to mitigate emerging forms of autonomous web abuse that rely on content extraction. Our results highlight both the shortcomings of current web defenses against agentic user clients and the feasibility of practical detection mechanisms tailored to this new generation of web automation.

translation.title: AgentShield：强化 Web 应用以抵御 AI Agent 与 Agentic 浏览器
translation.abstract: 由 LLM 驱动的浏览器 agent 正通过自主与网站交互并执行复杂工作流来变革 Web 自动化。然而，现有反爬虫防御对这些系统的有效性仍不明确。我们对现代 agentic 浏览器与广泛部署的反爬虫机制进行了系统的实证评估，刻画了它们的能力、局限以及与人类的行为差异。结果表明，许多为传统自动化设计的防御难以可靠地检测自主的 AI 驱动 agent。据此，我们提出 AgentShield，一个针对 agentic 用户客户端底层感知-推理-行动（PRA）循环的行为指纹框架。通过利用逐步揭示内容并捕获细粒度交互遥测数据的动态 Web 表单，AgentShield 暴露了可用于区分人类用户与自主 agent 的行为痕迹。我们进一步展示了灭绝诱导策略漂移（EPD），这是一种新型攻击：反复阻碍任务完成会使 agent 放松其安全防护并从事不安全行为。最后，我们提出防御性提示注入技术，利用 agent 特有的弱点来缓解依赖内容提取的新型自主 Web 滥用形式。我们的结果既凸显了当前 Web 防御对 agentic 用户客户端的不足，也展示了为这一代新型 Web 自动化量身定制实用检测机制的可行性。
translation.brief: 针对现有反爬虫防御难以检测 LLM 驱动 agentic 浏览器的问题，提出基于 PRA 循环行为指纹的 AgentShield 检测框架，并发现 EPD 攻击与防御性提示注入技术。

papers.title: Researcher-in-the-Loop Evolutionary Discovery of Entanglement-Assisted Quantum Code Families
papers.abstract: LLM-guided program evolution can produce mathematical constructions, but validity, generality, and reproducibility require distinct evidence. We develop a researcher-in-the-loop discovery pipeline that combines program evolution, exact evaluation, mathematical generalization, certified nonexistence checks, and formal proof checking. We apply it to entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (EAQECCs). Starting from tasks that did not specify a family formula, evolved programs produced finite qubit constructions whose structure researchers generalized to the family $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$ for prime powers $q\ge3$ at $n\ge2q+1$ and for $q=2$ at odd $n\ge5$. Lean checks the algebraic certificate underlying this family. Together with entanglement lifting, the family closes 54 gaps in archived EAQECC tables. The released evidence includes 115 verified code records, ten nonexistence results with checked DRAT proofs, family implementations, and preserved search programs for exact checks and seeded replay. In a controlled cohort of eight paired generation blocks, validation-selected iterative programs achieve success in 46.1% and 31.6% of held-out executions at unseen lengths $n=13,15$, compared with 19.5% and 3.1% for independently generated programs. In this setting, program evolution and researcher analysis turn finite computational discoveries into a proved family with independently checkable evidence.

translation.title: 研究者在环的纠缠辅助量子码族演化发现
translation.abstract: LLM 引导的程序演化可以产生数学构造，但有效性、普遍性和可复现性需要不同的证据。我们开发了一个研究者在环的发现流水线，结合了程序演化、精确评估、数学泛化、认证的不存在性检查和形式化证明检查。我们将其应用于纠缠辅助量子纠错码（EAQECC）。从未指定族公式的任务出发，演化出的程序产生了有限量子比特构造，研究者将其结构泛化为族 $[[n,1,n-1;n-q-1]]_q$（素数幂 $q\ge3$ 且 $n\ge2q+1$，以及 $q=2$ 且奇数 $n\ge5$）。Lean 检查了该族背后的代数证书。结合纠缠提升，该族填补了存档 EAQECC 表中的 54 个空缺。发布的证据包括 115 条已验证的码记录、十个带有已检查 DRAT 证明的不存在性结果、族的实现，以及为精确检查和种子重放而保留的搜索程序。在八个配对生成块的受控队列中，经验证选择的迭代程序在未见长度 $n=13,15$ 的留出执行中分别达到 46.1% 和 31.6% 的成功率，而独立生成的程序分别为 19.5% 和 3.1%。在此设定下，程序演化与研究者分析将有限的计算发现转化为具有可独立核查证据的已证明族。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 程序演化产生的数学构造缺乏有效性、普遍性与可复现性证据的问题，构建研究者与 LLM 在环协作的发现流水线，将有限计算发现泛化并形式化证明为纠缠辅助量子码族。

papers.title: When AI Investigators Cannot Trust Their Tools: Conflict-Aware Evidence Verification for Cyber Threat Investigation
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly triage security alerts by combining the outputs of several detection tools, implicitly treating those tools as trustworthy. Unlike prior work on conflicts between a model's knowledge and its context, we study conflicts among the tools themselves: what happens when this machine-generated evidence is conflicting or wrong. On the corrected CIC-IDS2017 dataset, four heterogeneous detectors emit labels and confidences that we corrupt under a threat model varying the number of corrupted tools, the persistence of the corruption, and the confidence attached to wrong outputs. Across open-weight LLMs from 3B to 14B parameters, unverified investigators are fragile: one corrupted detector out of four lowers naive accuracy to .50-.72, three lower every unverified investigator to .13 or less, and honest disagreement alone makes them abstain on up to 63% of flows. We propose Conflict-Aware Evidence Verification (CAV), built from established components: an equal-weight vote that ignores reported confidences, an evidence-conflict gate, and an independent nearest-neighbour trust check that tests the leading candidates. With its prompt frozen before testing, CAV-LLM improves on the naive investigator in every corrupted condition ($p < 0.001$), reaching .84-.88 with three corrupted detectors against at most .08, while calling the LLM on 0.4% of clean traffic. A fixed verification rule is as accurate or better unless most tools are corrupted. When we make the independent channel itself noisy, CAV inherits its errors: it stays ahead when two or more tools are corrupted, but adding the channel as an extra voter is better when at most one is. Verification thus moves trust from the tools to the check, which must be measured and protected in turn.

translation.title: 当 AI 调查者无法信任其工具：面向网络威胁调查的冲突感知证据验证
translation.abstract: LLM agent 越来越多地通过组合多个检测工具的输出来对安全告警进行分诊，并隐式地将这些工具视为可信。与以往研究模型知识与上下文之间冲突的工作不同，我们研究工具之间的冲突：当这些机器生成的证据相互冲突或出错时会发生什么。在修正后的 CIC-IDS2017 数据集上，四个异构检测器输出标签和置信度，我们在一个威胁模型下对其进行破坏，该模型改变被破坏工具的数量、破坏的持续性以及错误输出所附带的置信度。在 3B 到 14B 参数的开源权重 LLM 上，未经验证的调查者非常脆弱：四个检测器中一个被破坏就会将朴素准确率降至 .50-.72，三个被破坏则使所有未验证调查者降至 .13 或更低，而仅是诚实的分歧就会使其在多达 63% 的流量上弃权。我们提出冲突感知证据验证（CAV），由成熟组件构建：忽略报告置信度的等权投票、证据冲突门控，以及测试主要候选结果的独立最近邻信任检查。在测试前冻结提示的情况下，CAV-LLM 在所有被破坏条件下均优于朴素调查者（$p < 0.001$），在三个检测器被破坏时达到 .84-.88，而朴素方法至多 .08，同时仅在 0.4% 的干净流量上调用 LLM。除非大多数工具被破坏，固定的验证规则同样准确或更好。当我们使独立通道本身带噪时，CAV 会继承其错误：当两个或更多工具被破坏时它仍保持领先，但当至多一个被破坏时，将该通道作为额外投票者更好。因此，验证将信任从工具转移到检查本身，而检查也必须被度量和保护。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 安全调查 agent 在多个检测工具输出冲突或被破坏时性能崩溃的问题，提出冲突感知证据验证（CAV），通过等权投票、冲突门控和独立信任检查来提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: Beyond CLIP: Calibrated (Few-Shot) Defect Detection With System One Decision Models
papers.abstract: Cameras and vision sensors are widely used for product and process inspection in manufacturing environments. Traditionally, this process required thousands of images of both nominal and defective products to train such models. Recent research shows that vision transformer (ViT) models, such as CLIP, can reduce this requirement to 50-100 images per nominal and defective class. However, collecting even 50 defective images can be difficult in high-yield or low-volume manufacturing processes. In this paper, we examine the utility of two recently proposed structured decision models (Jev and Clef-Flash) in applications using as few as k=2 reference images per class at inference. In the process, we provide three main contributions: (a) a framework for k-shot learning of these models for image classification/inspection applications; (b) an agentic approach for automatically refining the text descriptions that guide image classification in these decision models; and (c) an approach to calibrate the resulting defect probabilities to improve their reliability for inspection decisions. We test these contributions in five manufacturing case studies. Using two reference images per class, both Jev and Clef-Flash outperform CLIP's test accuracies with the same references (0.75-1.00 [Jev] and 0.71-0.99 [Clef-Flash] vs 0.67-0.84 [CLIP]). Furthermore, we show that our agentic refinement of text descriptions significantly improves accuracy across 6 of 8 model-application combinations, and our calibration approach reduces the Brier score in 13 of the 15 model-application configurations. To support the reproducibility of our work, we provide our replication code and have created the R "decisions" package for evaluating additional models. We also provide a publicly available web app that allows practitioners to inspect their own images with no code.

translation.title: 超越 CLIP：基于 System One 决策模型的校准（少样本）缺陷检测
translation.abstract: 相机和视觉传感器在制造环境中被广泛用于产品和过程检测。传统上，这一过程需要数千张正常品和缺陷品的图像来训练模型。近期研究表明，CLIP 等视觉 transformer（ViT）模型可以将这一需求降低到每个正常类和缺陷类 50-100 张图像。然而，在高良率或小批量制造过程中，即使收集 50 张缺陷图像也很困难。在本文中，我们考察了两种近期提出的结构化决策模型（Jev 和 Clef-Flash）在推理时每类仅使用 k=2 张参考图像的应用中的效用。在此过程中，我们提供了三项主要贡献：(a) 一个用于图像分类/检测应用的这些模型 k-shot 学习框架；(b) 一种自动精炼引导这些决策模型图像分类的文本描述的 agentic 方法；(c) 一种校准所得缺陷概率以提高检测决策可靠性的方法。我们在五个制造案例研究中测试这些贡献。每类使用两张参考图像时，Jev 和 Clef-Flash 均优于使用相同参考的 CLIP 的测试准确率（0.75-1.00 [Jev] 和 0.71-0.99 [Clef-Flash] 对比 0.67-0.84 [CLIP]）。此外，我们表明对文本描述的 agentic 精炼在 8 个模型-应用组合中的 6 个显著提升了准确率，我们的校准方法在 15 个模型-应用配置中的 13 个降低了 Brier 分数。为支持工作的可复现性，我们提供了复现代码，并创建了用于评估更多模型的 R "decisions" 包。我们还提供了一个公开可用的 Web 应用，让从业者无需代码即可检测自己的图像。
translation.brief: 针对制造缺陷检测中缺陷样本图像难以收集的问题，采用 Jev 和 Clef-Flash 结构化决策模型实现每类仅需 2 张参考图像的少样本检测，并结合 agentic 文本描述精炼与概率校准提升准确性和可靠性。

papers.title: From Evaluation to Evolution: Benchmarking Image Editing and Evolving Image Models
papers.abstract: Real-world image editing requires coordinating multiple visual transformations with content preservation and reference constraints, yet aggregate scores can readily obscure unmet local requirements. Effective evaluation must therefore identify local failures and translate them into priorities for subsequent model improvement. We introduce WeGenEditBench, comprising 2,740 evaluation instances and 148 task types across single-image, text-intensive, and multi-reference editing. Pre-generated checklists shared across models decompose each request into atomic requirements; item-level deductions and visual evidence are established first and then summarized into scores for edit execution, preservation, visual quality, and task-specific correctness. To support the experience-acquisition component of recursive self-improvement (RSI), we develop WeGenEvoStudio, a unified multi-agent harness for RSI-oriented learning that integrates model-conditioned failure diagnosis, retrieval-grounded data construction, supervised adaptation, and re-evaluation. Among 15 evaluated configurations, GPT-Image-2 leads single-image editing with an Overall score of 4.076, while Seedream-5.0-Pro leads text-intensive editing at 4.291. Evolution experiments across four generation and editing benchmarks demonstrate substantial targeted gains: on their report-selected Top-5 single-image targets, FLUX.2 [dev] improves Overall from 1.083 to 3.517, while Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 gains 13.2%. Together, our benchmark and harness provide a foundation for developing more reliable image models through interpretable evaluation and feedback-driven learning.

translation.title: 从评估到进化：图像编辑基准测试与图像模型进化
translation.abstract: 真实世界的图像编辑需要在保持内容与满足参考约束的前提下协调多种视觉变换，然而聚合分数容易掩盖未满足的局部需求。因此，有效的评估必须识别局部失败并将其转化为后续模型改进的优先事项。我们提出 WeGenEditBench，包含 2,740 个评估实例和 148 种任务类型，覆盖单图编辑、文本密集型编辑和多参考编辑。跨模型共享的预生成检查清单将每个请求分解为原子需求；先建立条目级扣分与视觉证据，再汇总为编辑执行、内容保持、视觉质量和任务特定正确性四个维度的分数。为支持递归自我改进（RSI）的经验获取环节，我们开发了 WeGenEvoStudio，一个面向 RSI 学习的统一多智能体框架，集成了基于模型的失败诊断、基于检索的数据构建、监督微调和重新评估。在 15 个被评估配置中，GPT-Image-2 以 4.076 的总分领先单图编辑，Seedream-5.0-Pro 以 4.291 领先文本密集型编辑。跨越四个生成与编辑基准的进化实验展示了显著的目标性提升：在报告选出的 Top-5 单图目标上，FLUX.2 [dev] 的总分从 1.083 提升至 3.517，Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 提升 13.2%。我们的基准与框架共同为通过可解释评估和反馈驱动学习来开发更可靠的图像模型奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 针对图像编辑评估中聚合分数掩盖局部失败的问题，提出基于检查清单的细粒度基准 WeGenEditBench，并构建多智能体框架 WeGenEvoStudio 实现基于失败诊断与数据构建的模型自我改进。

papers.title: Evolution of Financial AI: From Statistical Models to Agentic AI
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) in finance has evolved from statistical learning and machine learning for structured prediction, through deep learning and foundation models for representation learning, language understanding, and reasoning, to retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge-grounded reasoning and agentic AI for autonomous planning and execution. In this paper, we examine how researchers and practitioners can select and apply AI methods in finance. We first show that the major paradigms of financial AI address fundamentally different classes of problems, rather than forming a strict hierarchy of capability. We then review the current state of research on AI in finance and trace how these paradigms have reshaped financial data, financial tasks, decision support, and human-AI collaboration. Building on this, we propose practical guidelines for matching AI paradigms to task characteristics, and show that more advanced models, such as foundation models or autonomous agents, are not universally superior. We conclude by outlining open challenges for researchers and practitioners working toward reliable financial AI.

translation.title: 金融 AI 的演进：从统计模型到 Agentic AI
translation.abstract: 金融领域的人工智能（AI）经历了从面向结构化预测的统计学习和机器学习，到面向表示学习、语言理解与推理的深度学习和基础模型，再到面向知识增强推理的检索增强生成，以及面向自主规划与执行的 agentic AI 的演进。本文探讨研究者和从业者如何在金融领域选择和应用 AI 方法。我们首先指出，金融 AI 的主要范式解决的是本质上不同类别的问题，而非构成严格的能力层级。随后我们回顾金融 AI 研究的现状，梳理这些范式如何重塑金融数据、金融任务、决策支持以及人机协作。在此基础上，我们提出将 AI 范式与任务特征相匹配的实用指南，并表明更先进的模型（如基础模型或自主智能体）并非在所有场景下都更优。最后，我们概述了致力于构建可靠金融 AI 的研究者和从业者面临的开放挑战。
translation.brief: 针对如何在金融中选用 AI 方法的问题，系统梳理各 AI 范式的适用边界，提出按任务特征匹配范式的实用指南。

papers.title: TRIDENT and SHAKTI: A Framework and Benchmark for Hindi AI-Text Detection
papers.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, distinguishing human-written from AI-generated text is essential for maintaining information integrity. However, research remains English-centric, with limited benchmarks for low-resource languages such as Hindi. To address this gap, we introduce SHAKTI, a large-scale Hindi benchmark covering four genres, eight LLM families, multiple prompting strategies, and adversarial transformations. We evaluate its quality through human annotation and analyze linguistic, grammatical, and sentiment-based differences between human- and AI-generated texts. Building on these findings, we propose TRIDENT, a round-trip translation-based detection framework with three variants: TRIDENT-S (static threshold), TRIDENT-D (dynamic threshold), and TRIDENT-C (logistic regression using multi-distance RTT features). TRIDENT leverages semantic consistency between original and round-trip translated texts to identify AI-generated content. Extensive experiments show that TRIDENT outperforms conventional and supervised baselines, with TRIDENT-S achieving the best overall performance. Further evaluations across seven languages, adversarial settings, and unseen LLMs demonstrate its multilingual applicability and robustness, while highlighting sensitivity to the translation model.

translation.title: TRIDENT 与 SHAKTI：印地语 AI 文本检测的框架与基准
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）日益多语言化，区分人类撰写与 AI 生成的文本对维护信息完整性至关重要。然而相关研究仍以英语为中心，针对印地语等低资源语言的基准十分有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出 SHAKTI，一个大规模印地语基准，涵盖四种文体、八个 LLM 家族、多种提示策略以及对抗性变换。我们通过人工标注评估其质量，并分析人类与 AI 生成文本在语言学、语法和情感层面的差异。基于这些发现，我们提出 TRIDENT，一个基于往返翻译（round-trip translation）的检测框架，包含三个变体：TRIDENT-S（静态阈值）、TRIDENT-D（动态阈值）和 TRIDENT-C（使用多距离 RTT 特征的逻辑回归）。TRIDENT 利用原文与往返翻译文本之间的语义一致性来识别 AI 生成内容。大量实验表明，TRIDENT 优于传统和有监督基线，其中 TRIDENT-S 取得最佳整体性能。在七种语言、对抗设置和未见过的 LLM 上的进一步评估证明了其多语言适用性与鲁棒性，同时也揭示了对翻译模型的敏感性。
translation.brief: 针对印地语等低资源语言缺乏 AI 生成文本检测基准的问题，构建 SHAKTI 基准并提出基于往返翻译语义一致性的 TRIDENT 检测框架。

papers.title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
papers.abstract: Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. In detail, MEMIG addresses each insight with a domain-grounded identifier and accumulates the quantitative effect measured by a property oracle, so that updates remain local and retrieval becomes an exact lookup. Next, MEMIG connects insights whose interventions are applied together and measures their epistasis by decomposing each evaluated set. Our results show that MEMIG improves performance in most settings across in silico antibody optimization tasks.

translation.title: MEMIG：面向抗体优化的自进化记忆构建
translation.abstract: 记忆已成为自进化 LLM 智能体的核心，它们存储并检索过往 rollout 的经验以指导未来决策。现有系统将经验表示为自由格式的自然语言并通过重写来维护，这适用于经验可叙述的任务。然而，在科学发现与优化中，经验往往是在特定上下文下由 oracle 测量的数值。将其重写为文本既无法为记录提供索引位置，也用描述替代了测量本身，还无法表达干预之间的相互作用。为此，我们主张面向生物分子优化的智能体记忆应当是可索引的、量化的和结构化的，并提出 MEMIG。该记忆构建框架实现了这三个特性。具体而言，MEMIG 用领域相关的标识符落实每条洞见，并累积由属性 oracle 测量的量化效应，使更新保持局部化、检索成为精确查找。此外，MEMIG 将被同时施加干预的洞见关联起来，并通过分解每个被评估的集合来度量它们之间的上位性（epistasis）。结果表明，MEMIG 在计算机模拟抗体优化任务的大多数设置中提升了性能。
translation.brief: 针对现有自然语言记忆无法表达科学优化中量化经验及其相互作用的问题，提出可索引、量化、结构化的记忆框架 MEMIG 用于抗体优化。

papers.title: SketchDirector: Complex Scene Sketching via Agentic Layout Reasoning and Detail Refinement
papers.abstract: Existing sketch generation methods often rely on image guidance and are largely limited to individual objects or simplified scenes, leaving text-guided complex scene sketching underexplored. We present SketchDirector, an agentic framework that mimics the human sketching workflow for automatic multi-concept scene sketching. Given a scene-level text prompt, SketchDirector first employs a large language model~(LLM) to decompose the scene into multiple draft assets, where each is represented by a set of Bézier curves. Then, an agentic reasoning loop iteratively plans and executes their spatial arrangement, guided by self-evolving memory. Finally, a detail refinement module leverages diffusion priors to enhance sketch quality while preserving geometric structure. To support future research and applications in multi-concept scene sketch generation, we further introduce the \textit{MCSketch8K} dataset, comprising editable vector assets, compositional layouts, and object-level manipulation annotations. Extensive experiments show that SketchDirector outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in semantic and compositional quality while effectively preserving overall contour organization during refinement. The project page is: \href{this https URL}{this https URL}.

translation.title: SketchDirector：通过智能体布局推理与细节精修实现复杂场景素描
translation.abstract: 现有素描生成方法通常依赖图像引导，且大多局限于单个物体或简化场景，文本引导的复杂场景素描仍待探索。我们提出 SketchDirector，一个模拟人类素描工作流的智能体框架，用于自动化的多概念场景素描。给定场景级文本提示，SketchDirector 首先使用大语言模型（LLM）将场景分解为多个草稿资产，每个资产由一组 Bézier 曲线表示；随后，一个智能体推理循环在自进化记忆的引导下迭代规划并执行它们的空间排布；最后，细节精修模块利用扩散先验在保持几何结构的同时提升素描质量。为支持多概念场景素描生成的未来研究与应用，我们进一步引入 MCSketch8K 数据集，包含可编辑的矢量资产、组合布局和物体级操作标注。大量实验表明，SketchDirector 在语义和组合质量上优于最先进的基线方法，并在精修过程中有效保持整体轮廓组织。项目页面：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对文本引导复杂场景素描缺失的问题，提出模拟人类素描流程的智能体框架 SketchDirector，通过 LLM 分解、迭代布局推理和扩散先验精修生成多概念场景素描。

papers.title: Rome Wasn't Built in One Turn: Replay-Grounded Reward Signals for Long-Horizon Freeciv Agents
papers.abstract: Training language-model agents to play long-horizon strategy games is hard because deterministic feedback is sparse and often arrives only at the end of a game. In-game scores can offer dense signals, but they do not reliably predict future outcomes: in 8-68% of position pairs across eight strategy games, the higher-scoring position leads to the worse outcome. We term this phenomenon scoreboard traps. In Freeciv, an open-source turn-based empire-building game where several players manage units, cities, and diplomacy over hundreds of turns, we look into better reward signals for gameplay agents. To facilitate this, we build CivHarness, an open system that saves current game states, branches on different decisions, and replays the game to future turns to provide measurable long-horizon feedback from saved positions. We use CivHarness to train CivTelescope, an LLM Judge that predicts which one of two game positions will yield the better outcome. On scoreboard-trap pairs, CivTelescope is 1.3-2.0 times more accurate than off-the-shelf language models, and it generalizes to new game starts, later turns, and unseen rules. We then train a Freeciv gameplay agent with CivTelescope as a dense reward, and call this recipe CivMarshmallow. When used in the middle stage of the game where scoreboard traps are common, CivMarshmallow reaches an average training phase gain of 8.94 points, 77% more than the best baseline, the end-of-game reward. Over the full 120-turn game, CivMarshmallow uses a hybrid reward that starts from the scoreboard or the end-of-game reward and shifts to CivTelescope as the game advances; this hybrid reward scores highest among the rewards we compare.

translation.title: 罗马非一回合建成：面向长时程 Freeciv 智能体的基于回放的奖励信号
translation.abstract: 训练语言模型智能体玩长时程策略游戏很困难，因为确定性反馈稀疏且往往只在游戏结束时才到来。游戏内分数可以提供密集信号，但它们并不能可靠地预测未来结果：在八款策略游戏的 8-68% 的局面配对中，分数更高的局面反而导致更差的结果。我们将这一现象称为记分板陷阱（scoreboard traps）。Freeciv 是一款开源回合制帝国建设游戏，多名玩家在数百回合中管理单位、城市和外交，我们在此背景下探索更好的游戏智能体奖励信号。为此，我们构建了 CivHarness，一个开放系统，可保存当前游戏状态、在不同决策上分支并回放游戏至未来回合，从而从保存的局面提供可度量的长时程反馈。我们使用 CivHarness 训练了 CivTelescope，一个预测两个游戏局面中哪一个会产生更好结果的 LLM Judge。在记分板陷阱配对上，CivTelescope 的准确率是现成语言模型的 1.3-2.0 倍，并且能泛化到新的游戏开局、更晚的回合和未见过的规则。随后我们以 CivTelescope 作为密集奖励训练了一个 Freeciv 游戏智能体，并将这一方案称为 CivMarshmallow。在记分板陷阱常见的中盘阶段使用时，CivMarshmallow 的平均训练阶段增益达到 8.94 分，比最佳基线（终局奖励）高出 77%。在整个 120 回合的游戏中，CivMarshmallow 使用混合奖励：从记分板或终局奖励开始，随着游戏推进切换到 CivTelescope；在我们比较的各类奖励中，该混合奖励得分最高。
translation.brief: 针对策略游戏中分数无法可靠预测最终结果的记分板陷阱问题，构建可回放游戏状态的 CivHarness 系统并训练局面预测器 CivTelescope 作为密集奖励来训练 Freeciv 智能体。

papers.title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
papers.abstract: Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information. We study whether agents can reliably construct complete executable JSON specifications for automated geometry creation, meshing, PDE solving, and result export. Our workflow combines model extraction with deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches that preserve unrelated accepted fields. We evaluate specification correctness, execution completion, and numerical verification separately. On 120 template-related requests, the full workflow achieves 98.3% correct first-turn specification and decision outcomes, compared with 92.5% for schema-assisted single shot and 82.5% for model-only: gains of 5.8 and 15.8 percentage points, respectively. It makes no false-ready decisions among the 42 requests requiring clarification or rejection. Component ablations identify contributions from scientific checks and conditional repair. Separate downstream studies cover 1D, 2D, and 3D steady and unsteady, linear and nonlinear problems, including flow and elasticity with complex three-dimensional wing geometries. A 30-case gallery demonstrates automated execution from retained JSON specifications, while 9 of 12 selected live user-to-results tests achieve joint specification, execution, export, and numerical-reference success (75.0%). These results support traceable, engineer-reviewed simulation assistance within the tested scope, while fresh-response regressions identify consistency as a priority for further improvement.

translation.title: 从一维基准到复杂三维几何：智能体能否可靠地为自动化 PDE 仿真指定问题？
translation.abstract: 将工程需求转化为仿真需要一致的几何、物理、边界条件和数值设置。近期的智能体辅助系统可自动化仿真设置，但仅凭成功执行并不能确定该规约是否保留了预期问题，或是否正确处理了缺失信息。我们研究智能体能否可靠地为自动化几何创建、网格划分、PDE 求解和结果导出构建完整可执行的 JSON 规约。我们的工作流程将模型提取与确定性的科学和能力检查、显式澄清以及保留无关已接受字段的经校验本地补丁相结合。我们分别评估规约正确性、执行完成度和数值验证。在 120 个模板相关请求上，完整工作流程达到 98.3% 的首轮规约与决策正确率，而带 schema 辅助的单次生成和仅模型分别为 92.5% 和 82.5%，即分别提升 5.8 和 15.8 个百分点。在 42 个需要澄清或拒绝的请求中，它没有做出任何错误的就绪决策。组件消融确定了科学检查和条件修复的贡献。独立的下游研究覆盖一维、二维和三维的稳态与非稳态、线性与非线性问题，包括具有复杂三维机翼几何的流动和弹性问题。一个 30 个案例的图库展示了从保留的 JSON 规约进行的自动化执行，而在 12 个精选的真实用户到结果测试中，有 9 个同时实现了规约、执行、导出和数值参考的成功（75.0%）。这些结果支持在测试范围内可追溯、经工程师审查的仿真辅助，而全新响应的回归测试表明一致性是进一步改进的优先方向。
translation.brief: 研究智能体能否为自动化 PDE 仿真可靠生成完整可执行的 JSON 问题规约，采用模型提取结合确定性科学检查、显式澄清和经校验本地补丁的工作流程。

papers.title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
papers.abstract: Web agents are increasingly deployed to complete tasks autonomously on real websites, where adversarially injected content can induce them to perform unauthorized actions. Existing evaluations primarily use fixed attacks or focus on a single attack type, and evaluate attacks at the text level rather than through real state changes, thus underestimating how vulnerable agents are to diverse attacks. To address the gap, we introduce REEF, a benchmark of red-teaming executable environments with faithful verification for measuring the security vulnerabilities of web agents. REEF covers 9 verifier-grounded websites spanning travel, commerce, productivity, media, and communication, and pairs every authentic benign task with a malicious objective delivered through 5 attack types at both the user and the environment level. REEF's state-based verifiers provide the execution feedback that drives ANGLER, an adaptive near-miss-guided lure evolution framework for red-teaming. Rather than evaluating a fixed attack set, ANGLER uses outcomes from prior rollouts to guide LLM-based attack mutation and candidate selection, prioritizing near-miss seeds during refinement. Across 8 VLM-based web agents, ANGLER achieves an end-to-end attack success rate (ASR) of 20.36%, compared with 15.24% for the non-adaptive setting. Compared with attack-free execution on the same benign tasks, attacks generated by ANGLER reduce benign task success rate (BSR) from 61.9% to 44.4%.

translation.title: ANGLER：基于验证器的 Web 智能体基准测试与自适应攻击者
translation.abstract: Web 智能体越来越多地被部署在真实网站上自主完成任务，而对抗性注入的内容可能诱导它们执行未授权操作。现有评估主要使用固定攻击或聚焦单一攻击类型，并且在文本层面而非真实状态变化层面评估攻击，从而低估了智能体面对多样攻击的脆弱性。为填补这一空白，我们提出 REEF，一个带有忠实验证的红队可执行环境基准，用于衡量 Web 智能体的安全漏洞。REEF 覆盖 9 个基于验证器的网站，涉及旅行、商务、生产力、媒体和通信，并将每个真实的良性任务与通过用户和环境两个层面、5 种攻击类型投递的恶意目标配对。REEF 的基于状态的验证器提供执行反馈，驱动 ANGLER——一个用于红队测试的自适应、以险些成功为引导的诱饵演化框架。ANGLER 不评估固定攻击集，而是利用先前 rollout 的结果来引导基于 LLM 的攻击变异和候选选择，在精炼过程中优先处理险些成功的种子。在 8 个基于 VLM 的 Web 智能体上，ANGLER 的端到端攻击成功率（ASR）为 20.36%，而非自适应设置为 15.24%。与相同良性任务的无攻击执行相比，ANGLER 生成的攻击使良性任务成功率（BSR）从 61.9% 降至 44.4%。
translation.brief: 针对现有 Web 智能体安全评估依赖固定攻击且缺乏真实状态验证的问题，构建带状态验证器的 REEF 基准，并提出利用先前攻击结果自适应演化攻击的 ANGLER 框架。

papers.title: PsyInterviewee: Informational Invariance and Relational Adaptivity in Mental Health Interview Simulation
papers.abstract: LLM-based simulated interviewees support interviewer training and the evaluation of mental health interviewing systems. Existing studies have primarily focused on improving human-likeness through richer patient profiles and behavioral modeling. However, human-likeness alone does not establish their reliability. Reliable simulation requires preserving profile-grounded clinical facts (informational invariance) while adapting disclosure and interaction behavior to the interview (relational adaptivity). To this end, we introduce PsyInterviewee, which separates a protected truth channel from a dynamic interaction channel and verifies generated clinical claims against the profile. Specifically, asymmetric write permissions allow dialogue context to update disclosure and behavioral states without authorizing new clinical facts; these states guide what profile-supported information is revealed and how it is expressed. In an automated evaluation of interactions between LLM-based interviewers and interviewees, PsyInterviewee achieves higher scores than four representative baselines on most metrics across both axes, as assessed by two LLM judges. Ablations suggest that the two channels contribute to clinical grounding and response modulation, respectively.

translation.title: PsyInterviewee：心理健康访谈模拟中的信息不变性与关系适应性
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的模拟受访者可支持访谈者培训以及心理健康访谈系统的评估。现有研究主要通过更丰富的患者档案和行为建模来提升拟人度。然而，仅凭拟人度并不能确立其可靠性。可靠的模拟需要在保留基于档案的临床事实（信息不变性）的同时，使信息披露和互动行为适应访谈（关系适应性）。为此，我们提出 PsyInterviewee，它将受保护的真相通道与动态互动通道分离，并根据档案验证生成的临床陈述。具体而言，非对称写权限允许对话上下文更新信息披露和行为状态，但不授权产生新的临床事实；这些状态引导哪些有档案支持的信息被披露以及如何表达。在 LLM 访谈者与受访者互动的自动化评估中，由两个 LLM 评判者评估，PsyInterviewee 在两个维度的大多数指标上均取得高于四个代表性基线的分数。消融实验表明，两个通道分别贡献于临床事实锚定和响应调节。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 模拟心理健康受访者可靠性不足的问题，提出将受保护的真相通道与动态互动通道分离并验证临床陈述的 PsyInterviewee 框架。

papers.title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents play an important role in solving complex and sustained tasks, with ever-growing interaction contexts. However, these accumulated contexts will raise substantial computational cost and obscure key decision-relevant evidence. Existing methods typically train external compressors or context-management agents to rewrite context as shorter hard-token sequences, but such external selection may not align with the LLM's evolving representation and is necessarily lossy. In this paper, we introduce Agentic Soft-Token Compression (ASTC), a training-free compression method using soft tokens within LLM agent for long-horizon tasks. Specifically, ASTC uses the model's native recurrent dynamics to determine the already absorbed information, leveraging the commonly-used hybrid Gated Delta Network (GDN)-attention. It then carries this information forward as agentic soft tokens while retaining exact values as hard tokens. The resulting compact sequence reduces later-layer computation and yields reusable KV caches, extending the savings across the agent's trajectory. Extensive experiments on long-horizon tasks show that ASTC matches or exceeds the uncompressed agent's accuracy with up to 50.68% fewer end-to-end Attention Pairs, while trained compressors require 15.4 to 103.7 times more Attention Pairs per successful task. These findings highlight agentic soft tokens as a model-native way to carry absorbed context forward as the task representation evolves.

translation.title: 面向长时程 LLM 智能体的基于智能体软令牌的模型内上下文压缩
translation.abstract: 长时程 LLM 智能体在解决复杂且持续的任务中扮演重要角色，其交互上下文不断增长。然而，这些累积的上下文会带来巨大的计算成本，并掩盖关键的决策相关证据。现有方法通常训练外部压缩器或上下文管理智能体将上下文改写为更短的硬令牌序列，但这种外部选择可能与 LLM 不断演化的表示不一致，且必然有损。本文提出智能体软令牌压缩（ASTC），一种免训练的压缩方法，在 LLM 智能体内部使用软令牌处理长时程任务。具体而言，ASTC 利用模型原生的循环动力学来确定已被吸收的信息，借助常用的混合 Gated Delta Network（GDN）-注意力机制。然后它将这些信息以智能体软令牌的形式向前传递，同时以硬令牌保留精确值。由此得到的紧凑序列减少了后续层的计算，并产生可复用的 KV 缓存，将节省扩展到智能体的整个轨迹。在长时程任务上的大量实验表明，ASTC 以最多减少 50.68% 的端到端 Attention Pairs 达到与未压缩智能体相当或更高的准确率，而训练的压缩器每个成功任务需要多 15.4 到 103.7 倍的 Attention Pairs。这些发现凸显了智能体软令牌作为一种模型原生方式，可随着任务表示的演化将已吸收的上下文向前传递。
translation.brief: 针对长时程 LLM 智能体上下文累积带来的计算开销和证据淹没问题，提出免训练的 ASTC 方法，利用 GDN-注意力循环动力学以软令牌在模型内传递已吸收信息。

papers.title: From Transcription to Reformulation: Defining and Benchmarking Grounded Generative Speech Recognition
papers.abstract: Speech language models have expanded automatic speech recognition (ASR) from transcription to general speech-to-text generation. Yet existing benchmarks still assume a single ground-truth transcript per utterance, an assumption that struggles when models produce readable, formatted, or structured outputs. In this work, we introduce Grounded Generative Speech Recognition (GSR), reformulating speech recognition as generating semantically grounded text instead of a single transcript. We define a grounded reformulation space that characterizes all valid textual realizations supported by the input speech, and establish a four-level hierarchy of reformulation capabilities, including literal transcription, canonical reformulation, semantic reformulation and speech-grounded structuring. Based on this formulation, we present GSR-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate generative speech recognition systems beyond exact transcript matching. GSR-Bench covers diverse scenarios including refined meeting transcription, cross-dialect translation, context-aware speech understanding, and robustness under silent or noisy acoustic conditions. To address the limitations of word-level evaluation metrics, we develop a multi-dimensional evaluation framework combining speech grounding assessment and LLM-based semantic judgment, whose reliability is validated through human preference studies. Extensive experiments across representative architectures, ranging from conventional ASR systems to end-to-end Speech-LLMs, reveal fundamental trade-offs between transcription fidelity and generative reformulation ability. Our analysis further identifies critical failure modes, including acoustic hallucination, unsupported generation, and instruction drift, providing insights into the design and evaluation of future grounded generative speech systems.

papers.title: rl_rob: A transparent, from-scratch Python library for teaching reinforcement learning from tabular methods to deep policy gradients
papers.abstract: rl_rob is an open-source Python library for teaching reinforcement learning. It implements the arc of a modern course, from tabular temporal-difference learning through linear function approximation to deep value-based and policy-gradient methods, with every algorithm written from first principles so that its update rule is visible in a few lines of code. All agents share one interface, so learners can compare methods directly across stages and trace a deep reinforcement learning update from the temporal-difference error to the weight change. The library supports teaching and assessment in which students implement, modify and explain update rules, rather than only produce working code.

papers.title: Migrating a Legacy Scientific Application with an AI Coding Agent: NICAM from Fortran to Kokkos
papers.abstract: Migrating from Fortran to C++/Kokkos broadens access to hardware accelerators through backends such as CUDA and HIP while offering greater flexibility in software design. However, legacy Fortran applications often have large codebases, making manual porting time-consuming and costly. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and AI coding agents have made large-scale code migration increasingly feasible. In this study, we ported NICAM (Nonhydrostatic ICosahedral Atmospheric Model), a legacy Fortran climate model accelerated with OpenACC, to C++/Kokkos with the assistance of Claude Code. The agent translated the code directly from Fortran to C++/Kokkos under human review. Approximately 140,000 lines of Fortran were analyzed and ported into 35,000 lines of C++/Kokkos, covering the dynamical core and seven physics packages. A 100-member ensemble comparison with the original Fortran model showed that the port is statistically consistent with the original. Performance was evaluated on Miyabi-G, an NVIDIA GH200 cluster, and Sirius, an AMD MI300A cluster. Compared with the Fortran/OpenACC baseline on GH200, the port achieved application speedups of $1.71\times$ on GH200 and $1.54\times$ on MI300A. The CUDA build achieved a GPU kernel-time speedup of $1.38\times$ on GH200. After normalization by peak memory bandwidth, the HIP build on MI300A achieved $0.96\times$ the kernel performance of the Fortran/OpenACC baseline.

papers.title: MILES-Rec: Uncovering Implicit Intents from Mobility Behaviors for Cross-Domain POI Recommendation
papers.abstract: Map applications bridge everyday mobility with local services, creating opportunities to recommend places by uncovering users' implicit intents. However, utility-driven map interactions provide only indirect and incomplete evidence of consumption demands, making it challenging to infer personalized service needs from observed behaviors. We propose MILES-Rec, a cross-domain POI recommendation framework that infers latent service intents from heterogeneous map behaviors and expresses them as prioritized natural language queries. It first learns from progressive reasoning demonstrations that synthesize user profiles and map histories for situation understanding, intent expansion, and query prioritization. We then introduce intent-aligned group relative policy optimization, using subsequent user interactions to reward query relevance and ranked service coverage while penalizing redundancy and excessive response length. A two-level credit assignment mechanism integrates shared list-level advantages with query-specific advantages, coordinating individual query quality with the complementary coverage of the complete query list. We further construct MILES-Bench from real user interaction logs on a large-scale mapping platform, supporting training and evaluation across diverse services under rich and sparse behavioral histories. Extensive experiments against general-purpose LLMs and specialized recommendation baselines demonstrate superior POI retrieval utility and strong service and semantic alignment, with consistent gains from behavioral policy optimization across four backbone scales.

papers.title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents
papers.abstract: Language-model agents now carry out long scientific work in biology, but their judgements about conventions, skills, errors, evidence and stopping are made inside the reasoning that does the work, where they cannot be measured, replaced or improved on their own. Here we present Operon-S1, a fast decision system, a System 1 for the agent, that separates judging from doing. A decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model that answers the questions can serve as the judge. Across seven life-science benchmarks, a local decision model took over these judgements in 0.6 s at the median for an in-loop request on CPU at no request cost, with no measurable change in the agent's score on five of six benchmarks, whereas the general language model that drives the agent, asked the same questions, accounted for 8.0% to 35.2% of task cost. Every decision is recorded with its consequence. Retraining on labels from task construction, verifiers or execution raised decision accuracy on every question in each of three trained versions, and a new version enters service only through a promotion gate. Task-level results in this study use the public checkpoint. The same closed decisions serve wet-laboratory protocol troubleshooting and the design of a germline target enrichment panel. Like the regulator of an operon, which switches genes on and off without making their products, Operon-S1 steers the agent without doing its work, and makes the agent's judgements a layer that can be measured, replaced and trained.
