papers.title: Do Transaction Prices Reflect Visual Preference? A Diagnostic Study with Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract: Existing visual preference evaluation relies on costly human annotations or preference reward models, whereas online marketplace transaction prices are readily available and reflect real purchasing behavior, offering potential low-cost supervision. However, transaction prices conflate visual preferences with non-visual factors such as provenance, demand, and competition, making aggregate accuracy insufficient to distinguish model errors, unreliable price signals, and protocol confounds. To address this identifiability challenge, we introduce MarketImage, a diagnostic framework that identifies when transaction prices reflect visual preferences, where they fail, and whether multimodal language models can recover human-supported visual preference signals. MarketImage comprises three components: (i) MarketImageArt, 266 six-image comparison sets with transaction prices and price-blind human rankings; (ii) MarketImageLens, a tie-preserving protocol that partitions 3,990 within-set image pairs into price-human agreement, conflict, and price-tie regions while separately auditing presentation-order effects; and (iii) MarketValuator, six elicitation methods spanning direct comparison, independent scoring, budget constraints, and multi-agent aggregation to evaluate signal recovery by static visual scorers and three multimodal language models. Experiments show that only 24.2% of image pairs have a non-tied price direction, of which 34.7% agree with the human majority. Within this region, HPSv2 leads at 66.4% Recoverable Accuracy; Qwen's budgeted and aggregated variants trail baselines, while GPT interface gains remain statistically unresolved. Thus, transaction prices encode recoverable visual preferences only under limited conditions and should be treated as uncertain proxies rather than ground truth.

translation.title: 交易价格能反映视觉偏好吗？基于多模态语言模型的诊断研究
translation.abstract: 现有的视觉偏好评估依赖昂贵的人工标注或偏好奖励模型，而在线市场的交易价格易于获取且反映真实购买行为，提供了潜在的低成本监督信号。然而，交易价格将视觉偏好与来源、需求和竞争等非视觉因素混杂在一起，使得总体准确率不足以区分模型错误、不可靠的价格信号和协议混淆。为应对这一可识别性挑战，我们提出 MarketImage，一个诊断框架，用于识别交易价格何时反映视觉偏好、何时失效，以及多模态语言模型能否恢复有人工支持的视觉偏好信号。MarketImage 包含三个组件：(i) MarketImageArt，包含 266 组六图对比集，附带交易价格和价格盲测的人工排序；(ii) MarketImageLens，一种保留平局的协议，将 3,990 组集合内图像对划分为价格-人工一致、冲突和价格平局区域，并单独审计呈现顺序效应；(iii) MarketValuator，六种引出方法，涵盖直接比较、独立评分、预算约束和多智能体聚合，用于评估静态视觉评分器和三个多模态语言模型的信号恢复能力。实验表明，只有 24.2% 的图像对具有非平局的价格方向，其中 34.7% 与人工多数一致。在该区域内，HPSv2 以 66.4% 的可恢复准确率领先；Qwen 的预算约束和聚合变体落后于基线，而 GPT 接口的提升在统计上尚无定论。因此，交易价格仅在有限条件下编码可恢复的视觉偏好，应被视为不确定的代理信号而非真值。
translation.brief: 针对交易价格混杂非视觉因素导致视觉偏好监督信号不可靠的问题，提出 MarketImage 诊断框架，通过价格-人工对比数据集和多种引出方法评估多模态语言模型能否从价格中恢复视觉偏好信号。

papers.title: LEAP: Efficient LLM Inference Scheduling with Generalizable Length Prediction
papers.abstract: Length-aware scheduling reduces request latency in LLM serving by prioritizing shorter requests. However, despite their large model sizes, length predictors can suffer degraded ranking performance under domain and task shifts, and adapting them can require costly retraining. Their prediction overhead can further offset the benefits of scheduling. To improve the generalization and efficiency of length-aware scheduling, we propose \textbf{LEAP}, a length prediction system with fast online adaptation and asynchronous CPU execution. LEAP reuses the serving model's prefill hidden states, which contain information about the output length, and extracts this signal through a linear readout. To adapt to substantial domain and task shifts, it updates the readout at test time through recursive least squares, using completed requests as supervision without gradient computation or historical-data replay. Prediction and updates run asynchronously on CPU, while prediction and initial batch ordering overlap the remaining GPU prefill. Across the evaluated cross-domain transfers, LEAP retains strong ranking performance, and online adaptation improves Spearman correlation by 64.7\% under a larger domain shift. Serving experiments show that LEAP reduces average per-token latency by 15.9--40.8\% compared with the evaluated length predictors, while achieving 1.9\% higher throughput with $30{,}569\times$ fewer predictor parameters than the strongest evaluated baseline.

translation.title: LEAP：基于可泛化长度预测的高效 LLM 推理调度
translation.abstract: 长度感知调度通过优先处理较短请求来降低 LLM 服务的请求延迟。然而，尽管长度预测器模型规模庞大，在领域和任务偏移下其排序性能可能退化，且适配它们可能需要代价高昂的重新训练。其预测开销还可能抵消调度带来的收益。为提升长度感知调度的泛化性和效率，我们提出 LEAP，一个具备快速在线适配和异步 CPU 执行的长度预测系统。LEAP 复用服务模型 prefill 阶段的隐藏状态（其中包含输出长度信息），并通过线性读出层提取该信号。为适应显著的领域和任务偏移，它在测试时通过递归最小二乘法更新读出层，以已完成的请求作为监督，无需梯度计算或历史数据回放。预测和更新在 CPU 上异步运行，而预测和初始批次排序与剩余的 GPU prefill 重叠。在评估的跨领域迁移中，LEAP 保持了较强的排序性能，在更大的领域偏移下，在线适配使 Spearman 相关系数提升 64.7%。服务实验表明，与所评估的长度预测器相比，LEAP 将平均每 token 延迟降低 15.9%–40.8%，同时以比最强基线少 30,569 倍的预测器参数量实现高 1.9% 的吞吐量。
translation.brief: 针对长度预测器在领域偏移下泛化差且开销大的问题，提出 LEAP，复用 prefill 隐藏状态经线性读出预测长度，并用递归最小二乘在测试时在线适配、在 CPU 上异步执行。

papers.title: When History Overrides Intent: Relational Schema Lock-In in Human-LLM Interaction
papers.abstract: Long-context interaction and persistent memory allow LLM assistants to develop history-grounded understandings of users. When users change direction, however, an understanding built through earlier exchanges may conflict with their current instruction. We introduce relational schema lock-in to describe cases in which an assistant grants that accumulated understanding authority to override the current instruction without user authorization for the intervention. Study 1 documents reports of AI assistants using prior interactions to question or alter requested actions. Study 2 reproduces the pattern across controlled histories and six models: models retained history-grounded positions but differed in whether and how those positions shaped task execution. In Study 3 with 360 participants, artifact substitution preserved task completion while reducing faithful enactment: 75.0% sent the AI's suspension letter, including 11 participants who reported cancellation as their final stated intent. Overt resistance reduced task completion while leaving sent artifacts faithful.

translation.title: 当历史覆盖意图：人机交互中的关系图式锁定
translation.abstract: 长上下文交互和持久记忆使 LLM 助手能够形成基于历史的用户理解。然而，当用户改变方向时，通过先前交流建立的理解可能与其当前指令冲突。我们提出“关系图式锁定”来描述这样一种情形：助手让积累的理解获得权威性，在未经用户授权干预的情况下覆盖当前指令。研究 1 记录了 AI 助手利用先前交互质疑或更改所请求行为的报告。研究 2 在受控历史和六个模型上复现了该模式：模型保留了基于历史的立场，但这些立场是否以及如何影响任务执行则各不相同。在 360 名参与者参与的研究 3 中，工件替换在保持任务完成的同时降低了忠实执行：75.0% 的参与者发送了 AI 的暂停信，其中包括 11 名报告取消才是其最终明确意图的参与者。公开抵抗降低了任务完成率，但发送的工件仍然忠实。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 助手基于历史记忆在用户未授权时覆盖当前指令的问题，提出“关系图式锁定”概念，并通过报告分析、多模型受控实验和 360 人用户研究加以验证。

papers.title: RECITE: Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence
papers.abstract: Overly restrictive eligibility criteria contribute to widespread enrollment failure in clinical trials, yet published recommendations for how specific criteria should be broadened remain disconnected from trial design at scale. We introduce RECITE (Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence), a framework for automated discovery, extraction, and implementation of evidence-based eligibility criteria revisions. RECITE uses protocol amendment documents from this http URL to construct a dataset of 11,913 curated instances across 5,735 trials, each pairing original criteria with documentary evidence and target revisions. We benchmark fifteen LLM configurations under truncated-to-context-window and retrieval-augmented generation conditions, on a 3,116-instance sample under an LLM-as-judge protocol validated against ten domain experts (judge vs. human quadratic-weighted Cohen's $\kappa_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$). The best open-weight model, Gemma 2 9B, achieves $\kappa_{qw}$-aligned ordinal score $3.0 \pm 0.9$ on a 0--4 scale (normalized 0.742) and the best closed-weight model, GPT-4o, reaches $3.0 \pm 0.8$ (normalized 0.745). Using an agentic literature discovery system, we then identified 44 paper--trial matches across five publications providing trial-design and EC-modification evidence. Our findings suggest that existing clinical knowledge can be operationalized into actionable trial design recommendations.

translation.title: RECITE：结合文本证据修订入组标准
translation.abstract: 过于严苛的入组标准导致临床试验普遍存在招募失败，而已发表的关于如何放宽特定标准的建议仍与大规模试验设计脱节。我们提出 RECITE（Revising Eligibility Criteria Incorporating Textual Evidence），一个自动化发现、提取和实施基于证据的入组标准修订的框架。RECITE 利用来自 this http URL 的方案修订文件，构建了涵盖 5,735 项试验的 11,913 条精选实例数据集，每条实例将原始标准与文献证据和目标修订配对。我们在截断至上下文窗口和检索增强生成两种条件下，对十五种 LLM 配置进行基准测试，样本为 3,116 条实例，采用经十位领域专家验证的 LLM-as-judge 协议（评判者与人工的二次加权 Cohen's $\kappa_{qw} = 0.694 \pm 0.096$）。最佳开源权重模型 Gemma 2 9B 在 0–4 分制上取得 $\kappa_{qw}$ 对齐的序数得分 $3.0 \pm 0.9$（归一化 0.742），最佳闭源权重模型 GPT-4o 达到 $3.0 \pm 0.8$（归一化 0.745）。随后，我们利用智能体文献发现系统，在五篇出版物中识别出 44 组论文-试验匹配，提供试验设计和入组标准修改的证据。我们的发现表明，现有临床知识可以被转化为可操作的试验设计建议。
translation.brief: 针对临床试验入组标准过严导致招募失败的问题，提出 RECITE 框架，利用方案修订文件构建标准-证据-修订配对数据集，并基准测试 LLM 自动生成基于证据的标准修订。

papers.title: From the Zoo to the BULLPEN: Sample-Efficient LLM Profiling via Multi-Channel Model Embeddings
papers.abstract: Choosing among the hundreds of thousands of available large language models (LLMs) requires a thorough understanding of each candidate model's properties. In practice, each property is measured by its own benchmark suite, so profiling a model on many properties means paying for many separate evaluations. To address this, model embeddings compress each model into a fixed-length vector from which many properties can be predicted. Existing methods, such as EmbedLLM, build these vectors from correctness patterns and question features, and often need large probe batteries to do so. However, many behaviors that are important when choosing a model, such as its verbosity, safety and style, show up more in how it answers than in whether it is correct. We introduce BULLPEN (Behavioral Understanding of Large Language models via Profile ENcodings), a framework that extends EmbedLLM in three ways. First, BULLPEN organizes the downstream tasks that prior work uses and adds 20 task benchmarks we built on behavior, style and provenance. Second, it is the first framework to read a model's own answer text jointly with its correctness and the question text. Third, it encodes models from a few hundred questions instead of the full 24,118-question pool. Across 260 open-weight models, our answer-text encoder scores 0.48 +/- 0.10 on the new tasks against 0.35 +/- 0.10 for the best prior encoder. Our encoders that read answer text keep at least 91% of their full-pool skill from only 400 questions (1.3% of the inference compute of the full question pool), while a correctness-only baseline keeps 83% with the same 400 questions. Because these embeddings need only model outputs, they support behavioral auditing and low-cost profiling, and could extend to API-only models. Code and data: this https URL

translation.title: 从 Zoo 到 BULLPEN：基于多通道模型嵌入的样本高效 LLM 剖析
translation.abstract: 在数十万个可用大语言模型（LLM）中选择，需要透彻了解每个候选模型的属性。实践中，每个属性都由各自的基准套件来测量，因此要在多个属性上剖析一个模型，就意味着要为多次独立评估付费。为此，模型嵌入将每个模型压缩为固定长度向量，从中可以预测多种属性。现有方法（如 EmbedLLM）基于正确性模式和问题特征构建这些向量，通常需要大量探针题集。然而，许多在选择模型时很重要的行为，如冗长度、安全性和风格，更多体现在模型如何回答而非回答是否正确。我们提出 BULLPEN（Behavioral Understanding of Large Language models via Profile ENcodings），一个从三方面扩展 EmbedLLM 的框架。第一，BULLPEN 整理了先前工作使用的下游任务，并新增了我们构建的 20 个关于行为、风格和来源的任务基准。第二，它是首个将模型自身的回答文本与其正确性和问题文本联合读取的框架。第三，它仅用几百个问题而非完整的 24,118 题池来编码模型。在 260 个开源权重模型上，我们的回答文本编码器在新任务上得分为 0.48 ± 0.10，而最佳先前编码器为 0.35 ± 0.10。我们的回答文本编码器仅用 400 个问题（相当于完整题池 1.3% 的推理计算量）即可保持至少 91% 的全题池能力，而仅用正确性的基线在同样 400 题下保持 83%。由于这些嵌入只需模型输出，它们支持行为审计和低成本剖析，并可扩展到仅提供 API 的模型。代码与数据：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对多属性模型剖析需大量独立评估的问题，提出 BULLPEN 框架，通过联合编码模型回答文本、正确性和问题文本构建多通道模型嵌入，实现少量问题下的高效模型剖析。

papers.title: Ask on Demand: Targeted Peer Communication for Parallel Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: Parallel LLM agents tackle complex tasks by exploring multiple trajectories, yet useful discoveries remain isolated in individual execution histories. Existing sharing methods often select or summarize information before other agents' needs become clear, potentially overlooking details that become important later. We propose Ask on Demand (AOD), a communication framework that enables agents to seek targeted peer assistance when specific information needs arise. Upon an approved request, AOD retrieves relevant evidence from peer execution histories, selects a suitable peer, and generates a response tailored to the request. To determine when such assistance is worthwhile, we train a lightweight gate using paired team continuations, with supervision derived from final team outcomes and inference cost. Experiments on AppWorld and WebShop demonstrate that AOD consistently improves task performance over independent parallel execution while achieving lower inference cost than existing information-sharing baselines. These findings highlight the benefits of aligning peer communication with agents' evolving information needs to achieve more effective and efficient collaboration.

papers.title: Parse Before You Execute: Efficient Spatial Reasoning with Executable Primitives
papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) has increasingly benefited from tool-integrated pipelines that ground computation in explicit geometry. However, existing systems often compile queries into relatively open-ended artifacts, such as code, task constraints, tool plans, or gathered evidence, leaving what must be resolved before execution under-specified. This can lead to unnecessary tool acquisition and iterative refinement, while still producing plausible reasoning traces from incomplete spatial commitments. We identify this failure mode as under-committed query compilation. To address it, we propose PEPS, a training-free agentic paradigm Parsing Executable Primitives for Spatial reasoning under a typed FESM schema over Frame, Entity, State, and Metric. PEPS follows a parse-before-execute principle: the Parser commits each query to a compact set of executable requirements; the Executor selectively grounds the required primitives through fixed geometric APIs and deterministic computation; and the Verifier checks execution sufficiency, enabling early termination or targeted repair. Extensive experiments across challenging spatial reasoning benchmarks show that PEPS consistently improves reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing refinement rounds, API cost, and end-to-end latency over strong tool-integrated baselines. These results demonstrate that explicit requirement commitment can make tool-integrated spatial reasoning not only more reliable, but also more execution-efficient.

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of LLM-Based Review Paradigms for Academic Paper Quality Assessment
papers.abstract: Growing submission volumes have renewed interest in using large language models (LLMs) to support peer review. It remains unclear how such evaluation should be structured, how much the model matters, and whether LLM scores predict research impact. We evaluate five paradigms across three input representations and three LLMs on 232 stratified ICLR 2025 submissions. Direct absolute rating matches comparative ranking on rank correlation with human scores, yet compresses most predictions above the accept threshold, flagging almost none of the papers reviewers scored below it. A base-rate-matched recalibration control locates the cause: comparative ranking supplies placement, not better ordering, and after recalibration Direct Rating reaches higher agreement than Elo while making 24% as many API calls. Abstract-only input beats full-paper summarization, and model choice matters as much as paradigm choice. Replicating on all 11,513 scored submissions reproduces these patterns, shows absolute agreement depends on the evaluated set's score spread, and finds none beating an always-reject baseline in accuracy. Human scores track citations better than any paradigm, with one exception: Group Rating retains its citation correlation after controlling for human scores, and alone ranks within the accepted pool. Ranking quality alone cannot assess review quality; calibration, thresholds, model, and target outcome all matter.

papers.title: ProSearch: Benchmarking Multi-Constraint Protocol Retrieval in Experimental Science
papers.abstract: In AI for Science scenarios, experimental design and method reproduction require retrieving protocols that satisfy multiple interdependent constraints, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of this capability. To address this gap, we introduce ProSearch, a benchmark for multi-constraint protocol retrieval in experimental science. ProSearch has three key features: (1) realism, with queries grounded in real experimental records and expert-defined templates; (2) complexity, with 60 experimental fields and their dependencies; and (3) diagnosticity, with 3-5 explicit constraints per query, including numerical and negation constraints. We construct ProSearch through LLM-based extraction, data-driven constraint selection, controlled query generation, and evidence-based relevance validation. The resulting benchmark contains 1,515 queries across six experimental science domains. We conduct extensive experiments on ProSearch with 19 representative retrievers and complementary analyses. The best-performing retriever achieves an average nDCG@10 of only 0.290, which improves to 0.474 with reranking. Structured diagnostic analysis shows that explicit constraint matching provides a strong ranking signal, while manual error analysis identifies joint constraint binding as a key bottleneck. ProSearch provides a testbed for systematically evaluating scientific retrieval systems.

papers.title: Cross-Interface Authorization for AI Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents act through graphical interfaces, command lines, APIs, scripts, and Model Context Protocol servers. A policy decision can be interface-invariant while its executable authorization is not: another route can bypass mediation, alter a security-relevant default, or commit after the authorized state has changed. We present a profile-bounded protocol for a fixed, versioned computer-use deployment. It enumerates effect-bearing routes and durable sinks, checks a route-to-sink enforcement cut, normalizes each concrete request to a canonical effect, issues a route-bound prepare ticket, and verifies the route, effect, grant, trace, profile, inventory, and authoritative state again at commit. A committed result requires an agreeing sink receipt. Under explicit assumptions, we prove profile-bounded refinement, matched-effect decision invariance, resistance to alternate-route laundering and declared cross-surface recomposition, commit-time state safety, and receipt-grounded outcomes. The reference profile registers 12 effect families, five interfaces, and 60 routes. Two structurally distinct runtime mappings produce 3,464 traces over 1,732 scenarios each: 960 commits, 2,312 denials, and 192 commits after re-preparation. An independent checker accepts every retained trace and pair and rejects 26/26 semantic regressions; coverage and normalizer suites reject 24/24 and 720/720 mutants; and 168/168 commit probes match their declared outcomes. A frozen-source audit passes 52 checks over 12 files from two independent hybrid runtimes and one public authorization substrate. Source-shaped adapter refinements commit 48/48 instrumented calls and reject 15/15 unbound cases. The resulting guarantees bind the declared profile and its effect semantics.

papers.title: When Safety Checks Become Privacy Risks: A Privacy-Preserving Paradigm for LLM Agent Safety Auditing
papers.abstract: Large language model agents interact with online services through tool calls that may access private data or perform sensitive actions. Specialized providers can supply and maintain pre-execution safety auditing capabilities for agent operators. However, sending task descriptions, call arguments, and interaction histories to an external auditor may expose sensitive user information. In this work, we propose a paradigm for privacy-preserving safety auditing that separates delegated audit computation from plaintext access and execution authority. Grounded in a three-domain auditing model, the paradigm connects trusted representation construction, encrypted audit computation, and trusted decision and execution through explicit interfaces. These interfaces accommodate alternative representations and scorers, while encrypted computation protects audit inputs from a semi-honest auditor. We instantiate this paradigm in SealCall, a framework combining learned audit representations, CKKS-based encrypted similarity computation, and execution control bound to audited tool calls. Evaluated on 1,252 public binary candidates, SealCall achieves a mean F1 score of 0.840 under grouped nested evaluation, while preserving plaintext audit decisions in all measured cases. A representative configuration completes each encrypted scoring operation in 0.176 s.

translation.title: 当安全检查成为隐私风险：一种面向 LLM Agent 安全审计的隐私保护范式
translation.abstract: 大语言模型 agent 通过工具调用与在线服务交互，这些调用可能访问私有数据或执行敏感操作。专业服务提供商可以为 agent 运营方提供并维护执行前安全审计能力。然而，将任务描述、调用参数和交互历史发送给外部审计方可能暴露敏感的用户信息。在本工作中，我们提出一种隐私保护安全审计范式，将委托的审计计算与明文访问及执行权限分离。该范式基于三域审计模型，通过显式接口连接可信表示构建、加密审计计算以及可信决策与执行。这些接口可容纳不同的表示和评分器，同时加密计算保护审计输入免受半诚实审计方的窥探。我们在 SealCall 中实例化该范式，这是一个结合了学习到的审计表示、基于 CKKS 的加密相似度计算以及绑定到已审计工具调用的执行控制的框架。在 1,252 个公开二分类候选样本上的评估中，SealCall 在分组嵌套评估下取得 0.840 的平均 F1 分数，同时在所有测量案例中保持明文审计决策不变。一个代表性配置完成每次加密评分操作仅需 0.176 秒。
translation.brief: 解决将 agent 任务数据发送给外部安全审计方导致的隐私泄露问题，核心方法是提出将审计计算与明文访问和执行权限分离的隐私保护范式，并以基于 CKKS 加密计算的 SealCall 框架实现。

papers.title: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified interface effectively. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. On OSWorld 2.0, HCU achieves the highest Partial and Binary scores among the compared systems. Analyzing agent trajectories, we find that all evaluated models improve with HCU yet allocate work across the channels differently and consistently outperform compared baselines in terms of both efficiency and task success, highlighting the value of unified computer-use interfaces that allow flexible channel selection and combination.

translation.title: 混合计算机使用：面向通用 Agent 的程序化、语义与视觉统一接口
translation.abstract: 计算机使用 agent 正日益承担从日常桌面活动到长程专业工作流的各类任务。然而，以截图和鼠标键盘动作为中心的接口会施加一种人类交互先验，需要反复解读屏幕，同时使计算机的语义和程序化能力未被充分利用。我们主张暴露这些能力，并让模型自行选择和组合它们。我们提出 Hybrid Computer Use（HCU），一个面向通用 agent 的统一接口，结合三个互补通道：通过代码和命令行工具的程序化交互、通过无障碍（accessibility, AX）的语义交互，以及通过图形用户界面（GUI）的视觉交互。我们的 HCU 支持高效的 AX 交互，并在通道切换时防范过期状态操作。一个补充的 HCU 技能指导 agent 选择和协调各通道，以有效使用统一接口。我们设计的 AX 工具返回紧凑的观察结果、批量执行动作，并以 AX diff 的形式报告其效果，从而减少模型所需的往返次数。在 OSWorld 2.0 上，HCU 在所比较的系统中取得了最高的 Partial 和 Binary 分数。分析 agent 轨迹我们发现，所有被评估模型在 HCU 下均有提升，但它们在各通道间分配工作的方式不同，并且在效率和任务成功率上均持续优于所比较的基线，凸显了允许灵活选择和组合通道的统一计算机使用接口的价值。
translation.brief: 解决截图加鼠标键盘接口使 agent 无法利用计算机程序化与语义能力的问题，核心方法是提出融合程序化、无障碍语义和 GUI 视觉三类通道并允许模型自主选择组合的统一接口 HCU。

papers.title: What Does a Repair Agent Gain from Remembering Its Failure? An Exploratory Study on Real Python Bugs
papers.abstract: When a coding agent fails a repair task, it is often retried with a record of the failure: the transcript, a self-written lesson, or extracted test signals. We ask what such failure memory changes in the retry. On 75 BugsInPy bugs, we retried each of 181 failed attempts of gpt-5.4-mini under five conditions, with a predeclared analysis whose deviations we report. Two predeclared follow-ups repeated the plain-retry, transcript and lesson conditions with the larger gpt-5.4 and added a notice-only control. On the bug-revealing tests, every memory condition gained over a plain retry in point estimate (+5.5 to +9.9 points over 29.8%), but none significantly. Five further findings stand out. First, a model-written lesson showed no advantage over the transcript it summarises (-1.7 points, 95% CI [-8.7, +4.9]; -3.5 for gpt-5.4), although it costs an extra model call. Second, the transcript may do more than tell the agent that it failed: a notice alone produced no significant change, while the transcript resolved 12.2 points more failures than the notice for gpt-5.4-mini (CI [+4.2, +20.0], partial run of 156 failures; the only significant one of twelve predeclared contrasts, and not significant for gpt-5.4). Third, post hoc, fewer retries with memory ended without modifying any Python file, while the share of editing retries that touched a file the fix changes was near ceiling. Fourth, in a post hoc full-test-suite check, retries that had also seen the previous attempt's test results more often failed other tests that the reference fix passes, which shrinks their apparent gains. Fifth, outcomes varied far more between failures than between conditions, and we give the sample sizes a confirmatory study would need.

translation.title: 修复 Agent 从记住失败中获得什么？基于真实 Python Bug 的探索性研究
translation.abstract: 当编码 agent 在修复任务中失败时，通常会带着失败记录进行重试：对话记录、自我总结的经验教训或提取的测试信号。我们探究这样的失败记忆在重试中改变了什么。在 75 个 BugsInPy bug 上，我们在五种条件下重试了 gpt-5.4-mini 的 181 次失败尝试，并采用预先声明的分析（我们报告了其中的偏差）。两个预先声明的后续实验使用更大的 gpt-5.4 重复了普通重试、对话记录和经验教训条件，并增加了一个仅提示的对照组。在暴露 bug 的测试上，所有记忆条件在点估计上均优于普通重试（相对 29.8% 提升 5.5 至 9.9 个百分点），但均不显著。另有五个发现值得注意。第一，模型撰写的经验教训相比其所总结的对话记录并无优势（-1.7 个百分点，95% CI [-8.7, +4.9]；gpt-5.4 为 -3.5），尽管它需要额外一次模型调用。第二，对话记录的作用可能不止于告知 agent 其失败：仅提示未产生显著变化，而对 gpt-5.4-mini，对话记录比仅提示多解决了 12.2 个百分点的失败（CI [+4.2, +20.0]，156 次失败的部分运行；这是十二个预先声明对比中唯一显著的一个，但在 gpt-5.4 上不显著）。第三，事后分析显示，带记忆的重试中未修改任何 Python 文件的情况更少，而编辑重试触及修复所改文件的比例接近上限。第四，在事后对完整测试套件的检查中，同时看到上一次尝试测试结果的重试更常导致参考修复可通过的其他测试失败，这削弱了其表面收益。第五，结果在不同失败之间的差异远大于不同条件之间的差异，我们给出了验证性研究所需的样本量。
translation.brief: 研究向重试的代码修复 agent 提供何种失败记忆（对话记录、经验教训或测试信号）最有效，核心方法是在 BugsInPy 真实 bug 上对多种记忆条件进行预注册的对照重试实验。

papers.title: BlindToChange: AI Agents Can Find Changes When Asked But Do They Look When Needed?
papers.abstract: Given that AI agents can search the web broadly and deeply in real time, it is tempting to conclude that their outputs account for recent world events. We show that this conclusion does not hold in practice. While agents can search and easily find recent changes, the correctness of their responses depends on whether they search and what they search for. Popular agentic search benchmarks like BrowseComp cannot expose failures wherein agents do not recognize their own assumptions that should be verified, since these benchmarks explicitly state what needs to be found. In contrast, many user requests state only the final information need (e.g., an itinerary for a trip), leaving the agent to discover relevant changes (e.g., the temporary closure of a museum) and account for their consequences. To highlight such gaps, we introduce BlindToChange, a benchmark that measures whether agents proactively discover recent events that affect their responses. Our benchmark comprises requests for recommendations where an obvious candidate is no longer applicable due to a recent real-world event. These events are drawn automatically from Wikidata, allowing BlindToChange to be periodically refreshed. Strikingly, we find a big gap -- as high as 27.5 points, even at high reasoning effort -- in systems' performance, when the recent event is not explicitly mentioned compared to when we ask about it directly. Analyzing search trajectories, we learn that more than half of the failures can be attributed to the fact that agents do not directly search to verify whether a relevant fact has changed. Our benchmark highlights, and tracks, a new axis of progress, wherein systems account for recent information that is not explicitly mentioned in the user request.

translation.title: BlindToChange：AI Agent 被问及时能找到变化，但需要时会主动去查吗？
translation.abstract: 鉴于 AI agent 能够实时进行广泛而深入的网页搜索，人们很容易认为其输出已考虑了最近的世界事件。我们表明这一结论在实践中并不成立。虽然 agent 能够搜索并轻松找到最近的变化，但其回答的正确性取决于它们是否搜索以及搜索什么。像 BrowseComp 这样流行的 agentic 搜索基准无法暴露 agent 未意识到自身应被验证的假设这类失败，因为这些基准明确说明了需要查找什么。相比之下，许多用户请求只陈述最终的信息需求（例如一次旅行的行程安排），需要 agent 自行发现相关的变化（例如某博物馆临时闭馆）并考虑其影响。为凸显这类缺口，我们提出 BlindToChange，一个衡量 agent 是否会主动发现影响其回答的近期事件的基准。该基准由推荐类请求构成，其中某个显而易见的候选推荐因近期真实世界事件而不再适用。这些事件自动取自 Wikidata，使 BlindToChange 可以定期更新。令人惊讶的是，我们发现当近期事件未被明确提及时，系统的表现与直接询问该事件时存在高达 27.5 分的差距，即使在高推理投入下也是如此。分析搜索轨迹后我们发现，超过一半的失败可归因于 agent 不会直接搜索以验证相关事实是否已发生变化。我们的基准凸显并追踪了一个新的进步维度：系统能够考虑用户请求中未明确提及的近期信息。
translation.brief: 解决 agent 在用户请求未明确提及时不会主动搜索验证相关事实是否已变化的问题，核心方法是构建基于 Wikidata 自动生成、可定期刷新的 BlindToChange 基准来衡量 agent 主动发现近期事件的能力。

papers.title: A prospective randomized study of patient-centered AI for clinical visit preparation
papers.abstract: Patients often arrive at brief, time-constrained clinical visits unsure of what to expect or ask, and millions of adults now turn to general-purpose AI chatbots to prepare beforehand. Yet whether conversational AI improves visit readiness remains unclear. We designed a large language model (LLM)-based visit preparation agent to guide patients before an appointment by gathering clinical context, setting visit expectations, providing relevant health information, building a prioritized list of questions for their clinician, and generating a summary. In a prospective consented randomized study in the Google Health app, 802 U.S. adults held 866 health-related conversations with the visit preparation agent (standard or concise variant) or a minimally prompted control chatbot built on the same LLM. The visit preparation agent significantly outperformed the control across blinded clinician evaluations and patient self-reports. In clinician reviews of completed sessions (n = 272), the agent achieved a 16.6% higher rate of comprehensive preparation (67.2% vs. 50.6%; P < 0.05) and an 8.5% higher rate of alignment with patients' health context (98.9% vs. 90.4%; P < 0.01), while maintaining high medical safety and appropriateness across all study arms. Patient post-surveys (n = 460) showed 16.8% higher visit preparedness (73.8% vs. 57.0%; P < 0.01), 14.3% higher confidence in knowing what to ask (81.4% vs. 67.1%; P < 0.01), and 12.0% higher overall satisfaction (74.0% vs. 62.0%; P < 0.05). Clinician and participant metrics were not significantly correlated, indicating that expert review and patient self-assessment capture complementary dimensions of patient-facing AI. These findings suggest that LLM chatbots can safely help patients prepare for clinical visits, with greater benefit when following a structured workflow, and motivate future studies on in-visit communication and clinical outcomes.

translation.title: 以患者为中心的 AI 用于临床就诊准备的前瞻性随机研究
translation.abstract: 患者常常在时间有限的简短临床就诊中不确定该期待什么或该问什么，如今数百万成年人会借助通用 AI 聊天机器人提前准备。然而，对话式 AI 是否能改善就诊准备情况仍不清楚。我们设计了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的就诊准备 agent，在预约前引导患者：收集临床背景、设定就诊预期、提供相关健康信息、为临床医生构建按优先级排序的问题清单，并生成摘要。在 Google Health 应用中开展的前瞻性知情同意随机研究中，802 名美国成年人使用就诊准备 agent（标准或简洁版本）或基于同一 LLM、仅含最少提示的对照聊天机器人进行了 866 次健康相关对话。在盲法临床医生评估和患者自报中，就诊准备 agent 均显著优于对照组。在临床医生对已完成会话的评审中（n = 272），该 agent 的全面准备率高出 16.6%（67.2% vs. 50.6%；P < 0.05），与患者健康背景的契合率高出 8.5%（98.9% vs. 90.4%；P < 0.01），同时在所有研究组中保持了较高的医疗安全性与适当性。患者事后调查（n = 460）显示，就诊准备感高出 16.8%（73.8% vs. 57.0%；P < 0.01），对知道该问什么的信心高出 14.3%（81.4% vs. 67.1%；P < 0.01），总体满意度高出 12.0%（74.0% vs. 62.0%；P < 0.05）。临床医生指标与参与者指标无显著相关，表明专家评审和患者自评捕捉了面向患者 AI 的互补维度。这些发现表明 LLM 聊天机器人可以安全地帮助患者准备临床就诊，遵循结构化工作流时收益更大，并为未来关于就诊中沟通和临床结局的研究提供了动力。
translation.brief: 解决患者就诊前准备不足的问题，核心方法是设计基于 LLM 的结构化就诊准备 agent，并通过前瞻性随机对照研究验证其相比通用聊天机器人的效果。

papers.title: From Representation to Readout: Mechanistic Analysis of Membership Signals in Language Models
papers.abstract: Membership inference aims to determine whether a particular example was included in a model's training data. Such membership signals are often broadly described as memorization, while the underlying mechanisms can involve both how information is represented internally and how it is accessed by the model to produce behaviors. We therefore present a mechanistic study of membership signals in large language models (LLMs). We introduce Decodable Information Score, Used Information Score, and Readout Accessibility Gap (DUG), a set of complementary measures that separately quantify membership information decodable from internal representations and the extent to which it is exposed through the model's readout. Across supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL)-based membership inference methods, membership-specific effects appear in both the amount of decodable information and readout under SFT, while under RL-based membership inference methods they appear primarily in readout. Activation patching further localizes this membership-specific effect to intermediate layers. To examine whether these findings extend to a more general RL setting, we further study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) contamination, where the training reward is independent of the reference solution. In this setting, we find that behavioral changes can emerge without a corresponding increase in likelihood-based membership inference signals.

translation.title: 从表示到读出：语言模型中成员信号的机制分析
translation.abstract: 成员推断旨在判断某个样本是否被包含在模型的训练数据中。这类成员信号通常被笼统地描述为记忆，但其底层机制既涉及信息在内部如何表示，也涉及模型如何访问这些信息以产生行为。因此，我们对大语言模型（LLM）中的成员信号进行机制研究。我们提出 Decodable Information Score、Used Information Score 和 Readout Accessibility Gap（DUG），这是一组互补的度量，分别量化可从内部表示解码出的成员信息，以及这些信息通过模型读出被暴露的程度。在监督微调（SFT）和基于强化学习（RL）的成员推断方法中，SFT 下成员特异性效应同时出现在可解码信息量和读出两方面，而基于 RL 的成员推断方法下则主要出现在读出中。激活修补进一步将这种成员特异性效应定位到中间层。为检验这些发现是否适用于更一般的 RL 场景，我们进一步研究了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）污染，其中训练奖励与参考解无关。在该场景下，我们发现行为变化可以在不伴随基于似然的成员推断信号相应增加的情况下出现。
translation.brief: 研究LLM成员信号的底层机制，提出DUG度量将成员信息分解为内部表示可解码性与读出暴露程度，并结合激活修补定位效应来源。

papers.title: Evidence-Guided Recovery for AI Agents with Ambiguous Tool Outcomes and Partial Execution
papers.abstract: Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed. We formulate evidence-guided task recovery over approved obligations, provider capabilities and states compatible with public evidence. A shared admissibility check handles key expiry, authorization timing, dependencies and residual effects; a terminal certificate separates actual goal satisfaction from publicly supported safe completion. The known-model implementation combines standard observation-contingent planning with a separately implemented effect-history adjudicator. In a finite study of 37 assignments, planning and three active controls each certify 28 completions; four saved synthetic fee units incur additional computation. A preregistered assignment-held-out comparison then evaluates planning advice against evidence prompting with two local model bundles. Across 58 paired units in 19 previously developed task families, advice certifies 30 completions versus 9, a 36.2-percentage-point difference (exact family sign-flip p=0.0078), using 272 proposals versus 399. All 116 trajectories pass independent replay. Both models exhibit a positive completion difference. The comparison measures the evaluated advice interface under a common shield; search-versus-rule advice requires a separate matched comparison. Unknown and handoff outcomes remain explicit, with guarantees tied to the declared provider capabilities rather than arbitrary third-party exactly-once execution.

translation.title: 面向工具结果歧义与部分执行的AI智能体证据引导恢复
translation.abstract: 工具超时可能使AI智能体面临歧义的工具结果和部分执行：某个动作可能已失败、已提交或仍在进行中，而工作流的其他步骤已经完成。我们在已批准义务、提供商能力以及与公开证据兼容的状态之上，形式化了证据引导的任务恢复。共享的可采性检查处理密钥过期、授权时序、依赖关系和残余效应；终止证书将实际目标达成与公开支持的安全完成区分开来。已知模型实现将标准的基于观测的规划与单独实现的效果历史裁决器相结合。在一项包含37个任务的有限研究中，规划与三个主动控制各自认证28次完成；节省的四个合成费用单位带来额外计算。随后一项预注册的留出任务对比，在两个本地模型包上评估规划建议与证据提示。在19个先前开发的任务族的58个配对单元中，建议认证30次完成，而证据提示为9次，相差36.2个百分点（精确的族符号翻转 p=0.0078），提案数分别为272和399。全部116条轨迹均通过独立重放。两个模型均表现出正向完成差异。该对比衡量的是共同防护下的被评估建议接口；搜索型与规则型建议需要单独的匹配对比。未知和移交结果保持显式，保证与声明的提供商能力绑定，而非任意的第三方恰好一次执行。
translation.brief: 针对工具超时导致的歧义结果与部分执行问题，提出基于公开证据的可采性检查与终止证书机制来形式化并认证AI智能体的任务恢复。

papers.title: RetryRoute: Retry-Aware Model Routing for Agentic Image Editing Services
papers.abstract: Web agents increasingly edit images by calling open editing models in a critique-and-retry loop, and these models differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. After every rejected edit, a service must decide whether to retry the same model, escalate to another or give up. Existing routers pick one model per request, and cascades escalate in a fixed order. However, both treat a retry as an independent draw. We identify sticky failures, meaning that a retry after a failure succeeds only 17-53% as often as a first try across six open models, three benchmarks and two judges. Based on this finding, we propose RetryRoute, a retry-aware router that estimates each model's chance of success given the request's failure history. It plans retries, escalations and abandonment over failure states and adds live queue waits to the cost, so the same plan becomes load-aware dispatch. At the main budget, RetryRoute's success under the in-loop judge exceeds the strongest of eleven prior baselines by 2.8 points on average over eight groups. On a GPU serving testbed it raises the share of edits delivered within the service-level objective by 5.0-6.3 points over the best prior baseline at every load.

translation.title: RetryRoute：面向智能体图像编辑服务的重试感知模型路由
translation.abstract: Web 智能体越来越多地通过在批评-重试循环中调用开放编辑模型来编辑图像，而这些模型的成本相差一个数量级以上。每次编辑被拒绝后，服务必须决定是重试同一模型、升级到另一个模型还是放弃。现有路由器为每个请求选择一个模型，级联则按固定顺序升级，但两者都把重试视为独立抽样。我们识别出粘性失败现象：在六个开放模型、三个基准和两个评判器上，失败后的重试成功率仅为首次尝试的17-53%。基于这一发现，我们提出 RetryRoute，一种重试感知路由器，它根据请求的失败历史估计每个模型的成功概率。它在失败状态之上规划重试、升级和放弃，并将实时队列等待计入成本，使同一计划成为负载感知的调度。在主预算下，RetryRoute 在循环内评判器下的成功率在八组上平均超过十一个先前基线中最强者2.8个百分点。在GPU服务测试平台上，它在各种负载下将满足服务级目标的编辑交付比例比最佳先前基线提高5.0-6.3个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对图像编辑服务中重试成功率因粘性失败而显著下降的问题，提出根据失败历史估计各模型成功概率并联合规划重试、升级与放弃的重试感知路由方法。

papers.title: When Links Mislead: Label-Free Structural Polarity for Zero-Shot Classification of Web Pages
papers.abstract: Web platforms such as digital libraries, online stores and university sites must classify new pages before anyone labels them. Large language models (LLMs) can label each page from its text, but these labels are noisy, and links could correct them only where linked pages share classes. Existing zero-shot methods ignore the links, or pull a page toward its neighbours as label propagation and graph neural networks (GNNs) do, which hurts where linked pages differ in class. Others weight propagation by an LLM-estimated homophily that costs extra calls and drifts across LLMs. We find that the sign with which links should enter a prediction, which we call structural polarity, is readable without true labels. It is the excess agreement of LLM labels and text-prototype predictions along links. We thus propose ZeroPolar, which gates one signed propagation step by this statistic. Training-free ZeroPolar mixes prototype scores with any number of LLM labels, and ZeroPolar-T denoises the labels with a text classifier once half of the pages carry one. With one GPT-4o label per page, ZeroPolar-T reaches the highest mean accuracy on eleven graphs (73.99%), 6.01 points above LLM-BP and significantly above all eighteen baselines we compare. With LLM labels on only 5% of the pages, training-free ZeroPolar leads a GNN trained on these labels by 10.80 points.

translation.title: 当链接误导时：用于网页零样本分类的无标签结构极性
translation.abstract: 数字图书馆、在线商店和大学网站等Web平台必须在任何人标注之前对新页面进行分类。大语言模型（LLM）可以根据文本为每个页面打标签，但这些标签有噪声，且只有在链接页面共享类别时链接才能纠正它们。现有零样本方法要么忽略链接，要么像标签传播和图神经网络（GNN）那样将页面拉向其邻居，这在链接页面类别不同时有害。另一些方法用LLM估计的同质性来加权传播，代价是额外调用且在不同LLM间漂移。我们发现链接应以何种符号进入预测——我们称之为结构极性——是无需真实标签即可读出的：它是LLM标签与文本原型预测沿链接的超额一致度。据此我们提出 ZeroPolar，用该统计量门控一步带符号传播。免训练的 ZeroPolar 将原型分数与任意数量的LLM标签混合；ZeroPolar-T 在一半页面带有文本分类器标签后用其去噪LLM标签。每页一个 GPT-4o 标签时，ZeroPolar-T 在十一个图上达到最高平均准确率（73.99%），比 LLM-BP 高6.01个百分点，并显著高于我们比较的全部十八个基线。当仅有5%页面有LLM标签时，免训练的 ZeroPolar 领先在这些标签上训练的GNN 10.80个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对零样本网页分类中链接可能误导传播的问题，提出无需标签即可估计链接应取符号的结构极性统计量，并据此门控带符号传播。

papers.title: Post-SQLFix: Property-Guided Repair of LLM-Generated SQL with Runtime Verification
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Text-to-SQL frequently generate queries with syntax errors, invalid identifier references, or violations of SQL scoping and typing rules. Repairing these errors is a program correctness problem, yet existing approaches rely on Execution Feedback (EF), whose symptom-level, dialect-specific error messages force the LLM to speculate on root causes. We identify an Arbitration Paradox in this paradigm: the system relies on unverified models both to propose repairs and to make the final judgment on whether those repairs satisfy the required properties. We resolve this paradox by reformulating Text-to-SQL repair as property-guided program repair. Our framework, Post-SQLFix, canonicalizes SQL into a dialect-aware Canonical Query Structure (CQS) and validates it through a hierarchical static analyzer with three stratified property layers (Syntactic, Context-Free Structural, Context-Sensitive Semantic). The analyzer produces precise, schema-aware violation diagnostics to guide the LLM's repair proposals. A Verify-Before-Apply Temporal Monitor then accepts only repairs that reduce the violation count, do not reintroduce resolved violations, and satisfy the operator contracts. These runtime invariants are bounded by the declared rule family and operator contracts, while a finite retry budget ensures halting. On three established benchmarks (BIRD, Spider, Mini-Dev) spanning over 3,000 evaluation instances, three SQL dialects (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), and six model configurations, Post-SQLFix resolves 77.8% of the execution errors that EF leaves unrepaired, while requiring less than half as many repair iterations and 30% fewer tokens. Crucially, accepted transitions under the monitor introduce no statically detectable structural regressions in our evaluation, translating checked repair fidelity into absolute accuracy improvements of up to +11.6 percentage points.

translation.title: Post-SQLFix：基于运行时验证的属性引导LLM生成SQL修复
translation.abstract: 用于 Text-to-SQL 的大语言模型（LLM）经常生成含语法错误、无效标识符引用或违反SQL作用域与类型规则的查询。修复这些错误是一个程序正确性问题，但现有方法依赖执行反馈（EF），其症状级、方言相关的错误信息迫使LLM猜测根因。我们指出该范式中的仲裁悖论：系统依赖未经验证的模型既提出修复，又对修复是否满足所需属性作最终判断。我们通过将 Text-to-SQL 修复重新表述为属性引导的程序修复来解决这一悖论。我们的框架 Post-SQLFix 将SQL规范化为方言感知的 Canonical Query Structure（CQS），并通过具有三个分层属性层（语法、上下文无关结构、上下文相关语义）的层次化静态分析器进行验证。分析器产生精确的、模式感知的违规诊断以引导LLM的修复提案。随后 Verify-Before-Apply 时序监控器只接受减少违规数、不重新引入已解决违规且满足算子契约的修复。这些运行时不变量由声明的规则族和算子契约限定，有限重试预算确保停机。在涵盖3000多个评估实例、三种SQL方言（SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL）和六种模型配置的三个成熟基准（BIRD、Spider、Mini-Dev）上，Post-SQLFix 解决了EF未能修复的执行错误的77.8%，同时所需修复迭代次数不到一半、token减少30%。关键的是，监控器下接受的转换在我们的评估中未引入任何静态可检测的结构性退化，将被检验的修复保真度转化为最高+11.6个百分点的绝对准确率提升。
translation.brief: 针对执行反馈无法定位根因且依赖未验证模型仲裁的SQL修复问题，提出将修复形式化为属性引导程序修复，用分层静态分析器诊断违规并以时序监控器验证后应用。

papers.title: EvoMCP: Co-evolving MCP agents and training data
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning of Model Context Protocol (MCP) agents is typically conducted on a static data distribution, which fails to adapt to the student's evolving capabilities and leaves newly exposed weaknesses insufficiently addressed. To address these challenges, we propose \method, an agent--data mutual evolution framework that enables MCP agents to improve through a closed loop of task evolution, trajectory evolution, and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, \method\ assesses the student's established capabilities and capability gaps from rollout feedback to identify learning targets. Task evolution then translates these targets into executable tasks by adapting the instructions and observable environment states of compatible verified seed tasks while keeping their verifiers aligned. To provide reliable and efficient demonstrations for these tasks, trajectory evolution uses reusable skills to recover failed teacher rollouts and refine successful ones. The resulting task--trajectory pairs are used to fine-tune the student, while accepted tasks seed subsequent evolution. To close the loop, we re-evaluate the updated student and use its feedback to guide the next round of data evolution. Experiments on Toolathlon, MCPMark, and MCP-Atlas demonstrate consistent improvements over the initial student, yielding absolute gains of 16.5\%, 10.2\%, and 12.6\%, respectively. Project page: this https URL.

papers.title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Recursive textual memory can carry earlier errors into later updates, yet task performance alone does not establish memory reliability. We define self-consistency bias as the persistence of incorrect claims already present in the incoming memory. We present KEEPER, a comparative analysis of four auxiliary objectives along information-content and update-sensitivity axes within a shared recursive interface, examining how supervision targets relate to agent performance. Among evaluated conditions, reward-related prediction achieve the highest task performance before and after offline reinforcement learning, outperforming joint supervision. A claim-level analysis of one baseline trajectory documents error persistence despite corrective observations. Together, these analyses motivate evaluating error persistence and valid-information retention alongside task outcomes.

papers.title: Multi-Test Nation Bias Benchmarking of LLMs with Explicit Unbiased Baselines
papers.abstract: While prior work has highlighted that systematic nation-level bias in large language models (LLMs) can pose operational risks for international relations (IR) applications, many existing evaluations still lack a clearly specified unbiased reference (ground truth), limiting fully quantitative and cross-setting measurement. Using an expanded corpus of 722 official UN Security Council (UNSC) records, we measure nation-level bias with five complementary tests, thereby extending prior approaches to cover a broader set of bias expression channels: opinion ranking (WOW), association sorting (AK+-), vote simulation (PVS), opposition attribution (F-Oppose), and framing (Headliner). To enable grounded bias evaluation, we explicitly define an unbiased status for each test; in particular, for WOW and AK+- where ground truth is difficult to specify, we propose an action-based pseudo unbiased status derived from observable voting behavior to construct a quantifiable baseline. Benchmarking 4 LLMs (GPT-4o-mini, Llama 3.3-70B, Mistral-22B-Small, and Qwen3-30B) across the five permanent members of the UNSC, we find a test-agnostic macro-pattern: relative to the reference baselines defined for each test, model outputs lean toward the opposition (red) side for China and Russia and toward the supportive (blue) side for the U.K., the U.S., and France. These results underscore the need to audit IR-facing LLM deployments with grounded, multi-test benchmarks tied to explicit reference points.

papers.title: HiState: Hierarchical Prefix Cache Management for Hybrid LLM Serving in Agentic Workloads
papers.abstract: Hybrid large language models combine full-attention and recurrent linear layers to reduce inference costs. Prefix caching can further reduce redundant computation across requests, but a recurrent checkpoint cannot recover an earlier state corresponding to a shorter prefix. Existing hybrid prefix caching systems retain checkpoints at selected boundaries to support common reuse patterns in conventional conversations. However, agent workloads modify and revisit earlier contexts, exposing reusable prefixes whose checkpoints were never saved or have already been evicted. A straightforward approach is to retain more checkpoints to reduce recomputation, but their cumulative footprint can displace reusable prefixes from other sessions and cause additional cache misses. To address these problems, we present HiState, a prefix cache management system for hybrid models serving agent workloads. Our key observation is that prefix reuse accesses all matching key-value (KV) entries but only one recurrent checkpoint, regardless of how many checkpoints are retained. This asymmetry allows HiState to retain historical checkpoints on SSD while prioritizing fast memory for KV entries: each hit retrieves only one checkpoint whose size is independent of context length. Within this hierarchy, we propose adaptive interval control to balance checkpoint storage against recomputation, and unified eviction to coordinate checkpoint sparsification with reclamation of stale trajectories. We implement HiState on top of vLLM and evaluate it on two public coding-agent trace datasets and controlled microbenchmarks. On real agent traces, HiState achieves up to 5.73x and 5.44x speedups in p99 TTFT over vLLM-Marconi and SGLang-HiCache, respectively.

papers.title: Specification-Guided Generation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured outputs, but existing constrained-decoding methods mainly enforce syntax and cannot directly enforce satisfaction of a formal specification. We introduce a neuro-symbolic, specification-guided decoding framework that combines LLM generation with symbolic reasoning. At each step, the framework refines the decoding grammar by filtering out values that cannot be extended to an output satisfying the specification. We present a forward-only variant that guarantees specification satisfaction by construction, and a backtracking variant that revises earlier feasible choices when their downstream consequences leave only values that the LLM itself judges unsuitable. The framework is model-agnostic, requires no retraining, and builds on existing grammar-constrained decoding mechanisms. Experiments on configuration and constraint-solving benchmarks show that the forward-only variant reliably produces specification-compliant outputs while reducing repeated LLM inference compared with rejection sampling and incurring modest symbolic-reasoning overhead. The backtracking variant further reduces cases in which the model is forced to select values that it has itself judged unsuitable, thereby substantially improving adherence to the LLM's stated interpretation of the prompt.

papers.title: KITE: Retrieval as a Decision Procedure for Long-Term Conversational Memory
papers.abstract: Many long-term memory systems for LLM agents are built around embedding-based retrieval. Al- though effective for semantic matching, similarity ranking alone does not establish whether re- trieved memories satisfy the conditions implied by a question. In this paper, we introduce KITE (Knowledge-Indexed Temporal Evidence), a vector-free framework that formulates memory re- trieval as an explicit decision procedure. KITE organizes multi-session conversations as structured knowledge indexed by a governed topic vocabulary, which evolves through controlled expansion and consolidation. At query time, questions are compiled into inspectable retrieval plans over the same knowledge index that guides memory construction. The plans are then executed through fixed lookup and ranking operations, while sparse lexical retrieval recovers surface details omitted from the structured representation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that KITE achieves 93.5% and 86.0% accuracy while using only about 1.6k reader-context tokens per ques- tion. These results demonstrate that conversational memory can move beyond similarity ranking by unifying memory construction and query compilation around a governed index, turning retrieval into an inspectable decision procedure for determining which evidence satisfies the question.

papers.title: DAPS: Dependency-Aware Premise Selection for LLM Theorem Proving
papers.abstract: LLM-based theorem proving in Lean 4 has advanced rapidly, but provers are difficult to leverage newly contributed lemmas, because retrieval skews toward popular foundational lemmas, leaving the right premises buried among hundreds of thousands of candidates. Existing neural selectors rank candidates by semantic similarity, with three intrinsic limitations: frequency-skewed retrieval, isolated pairwise ranking, and degradation on out-of-distribution queries such as competition problems and informal language. Given that mathematics is structured by dependencies rather than similarities, we restore this signal to both the training data and the model. We curate two underused dependency resources. We conduct the first systematic mining of 53 Lean Blueprint projects, a previously untapped corpus of 3,805 manually curated informal+formal nodes that capture rare, research-level premises absent from Mathlib4. We further pair it with the extraction of comprehensive, typed, multi-level Mathlib4 dependencies. We then introduce DAPS, a dependency-aware premise selector with a structural neighborhood encoder, a group-level contrastive objective, and a Mathlib-then-Blueprint adaptation procedure. DAPS reaches mean Recall@32 of 89.25 on Mathlib4-Heldout (+11.41 over the strong selector LeanHammer), and maintains this lead on two out-of-distribution benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that DAPS premises improve theorem proving on miniF2F and IMO-ProofBench. Project page: this https URL.

papers.title: Scalable Audio-LLM System for Speech MOS Evaluation: A Diagnostic Case Study and Adaptation Roadmap
papers.abstract: The continuous deployment of enterprise voice systems creates a critical operational bottleneck: evaluating the acoustic quality of synthetic speech across high-volume production updates. While human Mean Opinion Score (MOS) remains the quality gold standard, it introduces severe operational costs and turn-around delays that make continuous integration infeasible. In this work, we present a system design case study for a scalable, low-cost and offline evaluation pipeline capable of scoring large batches of synthetic speech at marginal cost. First, we use Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct in a zero-shot setting for granular MOS estimation, noticing perceptual blind spots and inherent biases. Then, we analyze SOMOS dataset and construct a diagnostic benchmark that operationalizes two prosodic dimensions associated with human naturalness ratings. Finally, we adapt Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct through a parameter-efficient finetuning (LoRA) on the task of MOS evaluation, observing improvements over base model and widely used neural baselines like UTMOS and establishing a practical blueprint for enterprise-grade speech quality assurance.

papers.title: FOCUS: First-Order Control Using Optimal Transport Supervision for Imitation from Observations
papers.abstract: Imitation learning from observations must recover behavior from state-only demonstrations without known temporal correspondence. Differentiable simulators provide pathwise policy gradients, but differentiating through long, contact-rich trajectories can make optimization unstable. We introduce FOCUS, which combines local optimal-transport alignment with short-horizon differentiable actor-critic learning. FOCUS matches agent rollout windows to multiple sampled expert segments using a soft best-of-$K$ objective that emphasizes locally compatible matches. The resulting transport-based costs provide differentiable imitation rewards, while a learned critic bootstraps value beyond the rollout horizon. FOCUS requires neither temporally aligned trajectories nor expert-aligned initialization or teacher forcing. Across contact-rich locomotion tasks in DFlex, including a musculoskeletal humanoid controlled by 152 muscle activations, FOCUS improves sample efficiency and training stability over adversarial imitation-from-observation methods and prior differentiable imitation baselines.

translation.abstract: Imitation learning from observations must recover behavior from state-only demonstrations without known temporal correspondence. Differentiable simulators provide pathwise policy gradients, but differentiating through long, contact-rich trajectories can make optimization unstable. We introduce FOCUS, which combines local optimal-transport alignment with short-horizon differentiable actor-critic learning. FOCUS matches agent rollout windows to multiple sampled expert segments using a soft best-of-$K$ objective that emphasizes locally compatible matches. The resulting transport-based costs provide differentiable imitation rewards, while a learned critic bootstraps value beyond the rollout horizon. FOCUS requires neither temporally aligned trajectories nor expert-aligned initialization or teacher forcing. Across contact-rich locomotion tasks in DFlex, including a musculoskeletal humanoid controlled by 152 muscle activations, FOCUS improves sample efficiency and training stability over adversarial imitation-from-observation methods and prior differentiable imitation baselines.

papers.title: Enhancing Knowledge Entity Relation Extraction in Abstracts and Full-text Content of Academic Articles Using Large Language Models
papers.abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of large pre-trained language models (LLMs) for knowledge entity relation extraction (KERE) from academic papers. Existing studies have examined individual types of LLM-based strategies and evaluated model performance using metrics such as precision and recall. To provide a broader evaluation, this study investigates multiple strategies, including closed-source LLM-based CoT prompting, LoRA-adapted open-source LLMs, LLM-enhanced small pre-trained language models (SLMs), and SLM-enhanced closed-source LLMs. In addition, this study introduces two strategies, namely SLM-enhanced open-source LLMs and closed-source LLM-enhanced open-source LLMs. These strategies are evaluated from multiple perspectives, including metrics, their ability to mitigate errors observed in SLMs, and potential directions for model optimization. This study manually constructs two annotated datasets in the NLP domain, covering Abstract and Full-Text datasets. Experimental results show that the LoRA-adapted T5 model achieves the highest macro F1 scores of 0.7408 and 0.7013 on the Abstract and Full-Text datasets, respectively. SLMs also benefit from LLM-generated entity descriptions under the LLM-enhanced SLM strategy. Error analysis further reveals that the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies in mitigating SLM errors varies across error types. Based on the identified limitations and error patterns of these strategies, several optimization directions are proposed. In addition, combining strategies with different error patterns further improves KERE performance.

papers.title: ORION: An Outcome-Driven LLM Advisor for RL-Based Multi-Domain 6G Slice Placement
papers.abstract: Deploying 6G network slices across administrative domains requires an online decision for each arriving request: which domain hosts each virtual network function, how traffic crosses domain boundaries, and whether the slice is admitted. This joint decision problem is NP-hard under continuous arrivals. Experiments on a parametrized family of multi-domain topologies show that no fixed planning strategy dominates across all regimes: the performance ranking reverses between topology classes, and feasible placements exist for most rejected requests but remain undiscovered. These findings identify the plan layer as the decisive performance lever. We introduce ORION, a hierarchical orchestrator in which two LLM agents translate service intents into structured requests and generate abstract placement plans. A cooperative multi-agent RL coordinator selects the cross-domain partition, treating the plan as a persistent soft prior, while per-domain agents place the functions. ORION main contribution lies at the plan layer: an outcome-driven episodic memory that records, for each completed attempt, the network-condition profile, the proposed plan, and its verified feasibility outcome. The memory feeds verified successes and labelled failures back to the planner, thereby closing the adaptation loop using deployment feasibility rather than a scalar reward assigned to the planner's own proposals. To isolate the effect of the plan quality, we evaluate the planner on held-out topology families while keeping the downstream selection and execution mechanisms fixed. Under this controlled setting, the proposed memory improves admission by $4.6$--$11.5$ percentage points over the same planner without memory, while importance-based retention accounts for most of the improvement over a first-in-first-out store.

translation.title: ORION：面向基于强化学习的多域6G切片部署的结果驱动LLM顾问
translation.abstract: 跨管理域部署6G网络切片需要对每个到达请求进行在线决策：由哪个域承载各虚拟网络功能、流量如何跨越域边界以及是否接纳该切片。该联合决策问题在连续到达下是NP难的。在参数化多域拓扑族上的实验表明，没有任何固定规划策略在所有情形下占优：性能排名在拓扑类别之间发生反转，且大多数被拒绝的请求其实存在可行部署但未被找到。这些发现表明规划层是决定性的性能杠杆。我们提出ORION，一个分层编排器，其中两个LLM智能体将服务意图转化为结构化请求并生成抽象部署计划。一个协作式多智能体强化学习协调器选择跨域划分，将计划视为持久的软先验，同时各域智能体负责功能放置。ORION的主要贡献在规划层：一种结果驱动的情景记忆，为每次完成的尝试记录网络状况画像、所提计划及其经验证的可行性结果。该记忆将验证过的成功和标注的失败反馈给规划器，从而利用部署可行性而非分配给规划器自身提案的标量奖励来闭合适应回路。为隔离计划质量的影响，我们在保持下游选择与执行机制不变的情况下，在留出的拓扑族上评估规划器。在此受控设置下，所提记忆使接纳率比无记忆的同一规划器提升4.6至11.5个百分点，而基于重要性的保留机制贡献了相对先进先出存储的大部分改进。
translation.brief: 解决多域6G切片部署中固定规划策略不具普适性的问题，核心方法是用LLM生成抽象部署计划，并以结果驱动的情景记忆将验证过的可行性结果反馈给规划器形成适应闭环。

papers.title: Verify--Backtrack Loop: Structured Precondition Recovery for Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.abstract: Language agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks in interactive environments, where actions often depend on latent preconditions. The core difficulty is not trajectory length but recovery: when a prerequisite is missing or an earlier decomposition fails, trying another plausible action rarely helps. ReAct and later reflection or adaptive-planning methods support local correction, but express recovery as free-form text, with no explicit control state linking the terminal goal, the active goal, and the failure source. We introduce the Verify--Backtrack Loop (VBL), a training-free extension of ReAct that turns precondition discovery and failure diagnosis into structured planning-state updates. VBL maintains the task decomposition as a bounded goal stack and, on goal activation, execution failure, or material state change, jointly verifies two horizons---whether the active goal contributes to the terminal goal and whether it is feasible in the current state. These dual-horizon judgments, combined with typed failure attribution, trigger explicit operations---Push, Pop, retry, or BacktrackTo the parent. We evaluate VBL with Qwen3.5-9B, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-V3.2 on AppWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld. VBL improves over ReAct and reflection-based control on every backbone--benchmark pair. On the challenging AppWorld setting, it improves task success by up to 22.07 percentage points over ReAct. Ablations show that removing either verification or diagnosis degrades performance, in several settings below ReAct, confirming that the two mechanisms are complementary. These results show that reliable long-horizon interaction benefits from revising the planning state, not merely the next action.

translation.title: 验证-回溯循环：面向长程语言智能体的结构化前置条件恢复
translation.abstract: 语言智能体越来越多地在交互环境中处理长程任务，其中动作往往依赖潜在的前置条件。核心困难不在于轨迹长度，而在于恢复：当某个前提缺失或先前的分解失败时，尝试另一个看似合理的动作通常无济于事。ReAct及后续的反思或自适应规划方法支持局部修正，但将恢复表达为自由文本，没有显式的控制状态来关联终止目标、当前目标与失败来源。我们提出验证-回溯循环（VBL），这是ReAct的一种免训练扩展，将前置条件发现与失败诊断转化为结构化的规划状态更新。VBL将有界目标栈作为任务分解的载体，并在目标激活、执行失败或实质状态变化时，联合验证两个层面——当前目标是否有助于终止目标，以及其在当前状态下是否可行。这些双层面判断结合类型化失败归因，触发显式操作——Push、Pop、重试或BacktrackTo父目标。我们在AppWorld、ALFWorld和ScienceWorld上用Qwen3.5-9B、GPT-4o和DeepSeek-V3.2评估VBL。VBL在所有骨干-基准组合上都优于ReAct和基于反思的控制。在具有挑战性的AppWorld设置上，其任务成功率比ReAct最高提升22.07个百分点。消融实验表明，移除验证或诊断任一机制都会降低性能，在若干设置下甚至低于ReAct，证实两种机制互补。这些结果表明，可靠的长程交互受益于对规划状态的修订，而不仅仅是下一个动作。
translation.brief: 解决语言智能体在长程任务中前置条件缺失时难以恢复的问题，核心方法是用免训练的验证-回溯循环将前置条件发现与失败诊断转化为对有界目标栈的结构化规划状态更新。

papers.title: Serial Rug-Pull-Like Exits on Pump.fun: Team-Level Evidence and Its Sensitivity to Team Construction
papers.abstract: We study repeated, team-associated selling around sharp collapses of this http URL tokens in several deliberately selected data windows, separating the measurement from claims of fraud, common ownership or realized profit. Because token prices derived from trade amounts are not fully reliable, we compare a price-based screen with a screen that uses only the bonding-curve reserve and SOL amounts; most price-based episodes are also found by the reserve screen. Episodes concentrate in groups well beyond a within-hour label-shuffle benchmark, and most of them are collapses sold by a single creator wallet. The recorded own-token cash flow of the identified groups is positive in most windows and negative in a few, but the sign of the negative results is fragile: it changes with the screen, with the definition of a group, with the length of the window and with trading costs of about two per cent per side. A daily SOL price covariate shows no association with the incidence of episodes. An agent-based simulation of a team exit on a bonding curve, extended with a latent attention to each token and calibrated to marginal moments of the data, shows that the team's result depends mainly on the attention that tokens attract, on fees and on the team's own trading, that continual trading by the team is costly and that reacting to the inflow of other traders adds little. The model reproduces the sign of group-level results but not the early exits that are common in the data. Missing token transfers, verified migration labels and human-labelled validation prevent identifying operator profit or fraud prevalence.

translation.title: Pump.fun上的连续拉毯式退出：团队层面证据及其对团队构建方式的敏感性
translation.abstract: 我们在多个刻意选取的数据窗口中研究围绕该 http URL 代币急剧崩盘的重复性、与团队相关的卖出行为，并将测量与欺诈、共同所有权或已实现利润的断言区分开来。由于由交易金额推导的代币价格并非完全可靠，我们将基于价格的筛查与仅使用联合曲线储备和SOL金额的筛查进行比较；大多数基于价格的事件也能被储备筛查发现。事件集中在远超小时内标签打乱基准的群体中，且其中大多数是由单一创建者钱包卖出的崩盘。所识别群体的自有代币现金流在多数窗口为正、少数为负，但负结果的符号是脆弱的：它随筛查方式、群体定义、窗口长度以及每边约百分之二的交易成本而改变。每日SOL价格协变量与事件发生率无关联。一个在联合曲线上模拟团队退出、扩展了每个代币的潜在关注度并按数据边际矩校准的基于智能体的仿真表明，团队的结果主要取决于代币吸引的关注度、费用以及团队自身的交易；团队的持续交易代价高昂，而对其他交易者流入的反应几乎无增益。该模型再现了群体层面结果的符号，但无法再现数据中常见的早期退出。缺失的代币转账、经验证的迁移标签和人工标注验证使得无法识别操盘者利润或欺诈流行度。
translation.brief: 研究Pump.fun代币崩盘时疑似团队协同卖出的测量问题，核心方法是比较基于价格与基于联合曲线储备的两种筛查并用经校准的基于智能体的仿真解释团队退出行为。

papers.title: Real Computation or Merely Naming? A Pre-Registered Mechanism Audit of 25 Cognitive-Architecture Modules in an LLM-Based Agent System
papers.abstract: Agent systems built on local large language models are increasingly marketed through the vocabulary of cognitive architecture: modules named global workspace, theory of mind, causal reasoning, or active inference are listed as features, and the presence of the name is taken as the presence of the mechanism. We ask the prior question -- does the named computation actually happen -- and contribute a transferable verification method for the claim-implementation gap: a four-question static audit protocol with line-number evidence and call-chain tracing, demonstrated on two systems. We audit a system claiming 25 cognitive mechanisms, pre-register falsifiable predictions for 11 modules and execute the interventions, replicate the protocol on the IIT-phi core of a second, independent system with its own pre-committed falsification criteria, and run two repair experiments as positive controls. In 18 of 25 modules the computed value never reaches any production output; three idle-wiring shapes new to the dead-code and code-smell literatures emerge (connected-but-never-called, called-but-inert, called-but-content-blind). Of 61 frozen criteria across 12 interventions, 53 were confirmed, two partially adjudicated, five falsified, one adjudication-ambiguous. Repairs raised planner task success from 0.028 to 1.000 and cut state-controller error by 52%. Module names and module computations must be audited as independent claims; the protocol and the five-class failure taxonomy are reusable for the claim-implementation gap at two-system, case-level depth.

translation.title: 真实计算还是仅仅命名？对基于LLM的智能体系统中25个认知架构模块的预注册机制审计
translation.abstract: 基于本地大语言模型的智能体系统越来越多地借助认知架构的词汇进行营销：名为全局工作空间、心智理论、因果推理或主动推理的模块被列为特性，而名称的存在被当作机制的存在。我们追问更前置的问题——被命名的计算是否真的发生——并针对声明与实现之间的差距贡献一种可迁移的验证方法：一个带行号证据和调用链追踪的四问静态审计协议，并在两个系统上进行了演示。我们审计了一个声称具有25种认知机制的系统，为11个模块预注册可证伪预测并执行干预，在第二个独立系统的IIT-phi核心上以其自身预先承诺的证伪标准复现该协议，并运行两个修复实验作为阳性对照。在25个模块中有18个的计算值从未到达任何生产输出；出现了三种对死代码和代码坏味文献而言全新的闲置接线形态（已连接但从未被调用、被调用但无效果、被调用但对内容不敏感）。在12次干预的61条冻结标准中，53条被确认，2条部分裁定，5条被证伪，1条裁定不明确。修复使规划器任务成功率从0.028提升至1.000，并将状态控制器错误降低52%。模块名称与模块计算必须作为独立声明进行审计；该协议和五类失败分类法可在双系统、案例级深度上复用于声明-实现差距。
translation.brief: 解决智能体系统中认知模块名称与实际实现不符的验证问题，核心方法是提出带行号证据与调用链追踪的四问静态审计协议并进行预注册干预审计。

papers.title: What Should LLMs Forget: Reinforcement Unlearning of Knowledge Associations
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) acquire extensive factual knowledge during pre-training, which may include sensitive, private, or copyrighted information, motivating the development of unlearning methods that selectively remove specific knowledge while preserving general capabilities. However, existing approaches typically optimize entire responses without explicitly identifying the knowledge to be forgotten, resulting in coarse and uncontrolled forgetting. To address this, we revisit the forgetting target of LLM unlearning and introduce Knowledge Association (KA), which characterizes the association between a query context and its target knowledge and is instantiated by the corresponding conditional predictive distribution, as the fundamental target of forgetting. Based on KA, we propose Knowledge Association Reinforcement Unlearning (KARU), a unified reinforcement learning framework that suppresses forgotten knowledge associations while preserving retained ones. Specifically, KARU derives complementary mechanisms from the KA-based formulation: token-level reward construction for finer-grained forgetting supervision, distribution-level regularization for precise knowledge suppression, and proximity-aware retain sampling to mitigate collateral degradation. Experiments across diverse LLMs on representative benchmarks demonstrate that KARU consistently improves forgetting effectiveness over existing baselines while maintaining comparable retention performance and general utility.

translation.title: LLM应该遗忘什么：知识关联的强化遗忘
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在预训练中获取大量事实知识，其中可能包含敏感、隐私或受版权保护的信息，这促使人们开发选择性移除特定知识同时保留通用能力的遗忘方法。然而，现有方法通常优化整个响应，而未显式识别要遗忘的知识，导致遗忘粗糙且不可控。为此，我们重新审视LLM遗忘的遗忘目标，并引入知识关联（KA）作为遗忘的基本目标，它刻画查询上下文与其目标知识之间的关联，并由相应的条件预测分布实例化。基于KA，我们提出知识关联强化遗忘（KARU），一个统一的强化学习框架，在抑制待遗忘知识关联的同时保留应保留的关联。具体而言，KARU从基于KA的表述中导出互补机制：用于更细粒度遗忘监督的token级奖励构建、用于精确知识抑制的分布级正则化，以及用于缓解附带性能退化的邻近感知保留采样。在多个LLM和代表性基准上的实验表明，KARU在遗忘效果上持续优于现有基线，同时保持相当的保留性能和通用能力。
translation.brief: 解决现有LLM遗忘方法优化整个响应导致遗忘粗糙不可控的问题，核心方法是将知识关联（KA）作为遗忘目标并构建强化学习框架KARU，结合token级奖励、分布级正则化和邻近感知保留采样实现精准遗忘。

papers.title: Prompt Less, Infer More: Static Analysis-Guided LLM Type Annotation for Python
papers.abstract: Type annotations improve the maintainability and reliability of Python programs, but many real-world projects remain under-annotated because manual annotation is time-consuming and error-prone. Recent neural and LLM-based type inference systems can recover missing annotations, yet they often trade accuracy for efficiency. Existing approaches often fail to exploit project-wide type evidence, or do so inefficiently through unnecessary model calls and noisy prompts. We present SALT, an LLM-based type inference system guided by static analysis. SALT integrates static analysis with LLM inference to resolve types statically, prioritize LLM queries, and construct concise type-aware context. To demonstrate the effectiveness of SALT, we evaluated it on 12 real-world Python projects. SALT achieves the best accuracy among the evaluated systems and reduces estimated LLM cost by up to 78.5% compared with a strong coding-assistant baseline. It also shows similar cost savings with the frontier model GPT-5.5, demonstrating that SALT remains effective with strong LLMs.

papers.title: Risk-Sensitive Mission Planning for Multi-Target On-Orbit Inspection via Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Multi-target on-orbit servicing missions require planning tools that can adapt to evolving operational conditions while accounting for the outcome variability inherent to safety-critical spaceflight. This paper presents an adaptive planning approach for multi-target servicing campaigns in low Earth orbit and applies it to inspection missions flown by a low-thrust servicer. The approach is based on Distributional Reinforcement Learning, which learns the full distribution of mission returns and thereby supports explicit risk-sensitive decision-making at each planning step. Specifically, a Quantile-Regression Deep Q-Network (QR-DQN) agent selects which target to inspect next by jointly considering the expectation and the variance of the predicted return through a mean-variance criterion. The mission environment models circular orbits with a spread in inclination and uses Edelbaum's combined-manoeuvre low-thrust transfer estimates. The observation comprises the orbital elements, the visit history, the observed risk state of each target and the remaining mission-time budget. The risk state of each target changes stochastically during the campaign, making the outcome of an inspection uncertain and creating operationally meaningful distinctions between risk-neutral and risk-averse planning strategies. Because the mission-time budget generally admits only a subset of the candidate targets, the planner must also select which targets to inspect. Numerical experiments on scenarios with five target satellites show that one risk-aversion weight moves the policy across a range of mean return and return variance, over an unchanged environment and reward. Risk-averse agents reduce the variance of the episodic return by approximately one half relative to risk-neutral agents and lower the probability of a mission loss, at a cost in mean return. To validate the learned policies, the efficient frontier, which gives the highest mean return attainable at each level of return variance, is computed exactly by enumerating the admissible visit orders. At equal variance, the learned policies lie close to this frontier in mean return, and the risk-averse policies have a lower probability of a mission loss than the frontier policies.

papers.title: When Steering Shifts Discourse: Identifying and Intervening on Discourse-Level Changes due to Activation Steering in LLMs
papers.abstract: Activation steering is an inference-time technique used to control or modify the behavior, tone, or safety properties of a large language model (LLM) without retraining the model's weights or editing its input prompt, but simply by adding a vector to its residual-stream activations. However, activation steering also changes the generated text in unintended ways, unrelated to intended behavior change, that are not well understood. Prior work has measured these changes only through coarse signals such as perplexity. In this work, we show that steering systematically produces significant changes in discourse dimensions of the generated text, such as its formality, use of evidence, and ambiguity. We present a way of countering this by adding a second, complementary vector that targets the affected discourse dimension. This intervention restores about 78% of the unintended discourse changes while preserving the intended steering behavior in about 93% of the generations.

papers.title: Supervised and LLM-Augmented Cardinality Estimation for Similarity Queries on Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Over the past decades, query cardinality estimation on relational databases has been proven crucial, enabling the result size estimation of all sub-plans of each query. This allowed query optimizers to design efficient query plans, towards minimizing the query response time. Lately, knowledge graphs are being preferred over traditional databases in various applications, due to their ability to represent complex relationships and semantic meaning in a domain-specific context. In this work, we present a novel approach for supervised similarity-aware cardinality estimation on knowledge graphs that incorporates similarities into the model training process, thus treating them as first-class citizens. To this end, we present SCE-KG, a model that employs a novel encoding scheme for cardinality estimation, named SGsplit. We further extend our approach by leveraging a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate training queries that resemble realistic user workloads, and show that combining LLM-generated and random walk samples consistently improves estimation accuracy on test workloads generated by two independent LLMs. Our experimental evaluation reveals that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art techniques in terms of prediction error, achieving 40x and 37x improvement for star and chain queries, respectively (95th percentile), whereas its online overhead accounts for less than 0.05% of the average query execution time and less than 1% of the average query planning time, showing a sub-millisecond latency in all cases.

papers.title: Understanding the Energy Cost of Quantized Agents on Shared GPUs
papers.abstract: Quantization can lower the energy of language-model calls and free memory for serving more agents, but its benefit per completed task remains unclear when agents share a GPU. Measurements of fixed requests or isolated agents leave open how the agents' generated work interact with competition for compute and cache. We present a systematic study of precision and admission limits for two agent models on A100 deployments with 40 or 80 GB of memory, using coding and data-analysis tasks with independently verified outcomes. We replay recorded calls across precisions to isolate execution energy and cap the cache to test the value of freed memory. For both models with four admitted agents where requests fit in the cache, 4-bit weights with 16-bit activations execute the same calls with 10-25% less energy than 8-bit weights and activations. Despite this saving, extra work and fewer completions in live runs raise their energy per verified completion by 49%. Where requests compete for cache on the 40 GB deployment, 4-bit weights cost less, and capping their cache raises energy per verified completion by 34% with 16 agents. These results show how generated work and cache demand change the energy benefit of quantization, providing a practical basis for choosing precision and admission limits together.
