papers.title: The Ineliminable Anchor: Human Judgment as a Structural Requirement of Autonomous Artificial Intelligence Systems
papers.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) agents carry out longer chains of tasks, oversight must establish whether their behavior still serves an authorized goal. Here, we introduce the anchor: the point at which reference information and human-authorized standards enter an autonomous system. We argue that oversight design should first identify the reference needed to assess goal drift and whether the system's internal record can supply it, then decide who checks and how often, and finally specify who may revise the goal. Goal drift can be impossible to certify from a system's internal record. The missing reference must come from outside that record. Combining a reliability model of checkpoint spacing with evidence from training, execution, and multi-agent coordination, we develop a task taxonomy to guide anchor placement and decisions about which checks to automate. For AI systems that serve human purposes, human judgment is an ineliminable structural requirement in authorizing and revising the purposes and standards that govern autonomous operation, even when routine checking and execution are automated.

translation.title: 不可消除的锚点：人类判断作为自主人工智能系统的结构性要求
translation.abstract: 随着人工智能（AI）智能体执行越来越长的任务链，监督必须确认其行为是否仍在服务于被授权的目标。本文引入“锚点”概念：即参考信息和人类授权标准进入自主系统的切入点。我们主张，监督设计应首先确定评估目标漂移所需的参考信息，以及系统内部记录能否提供该信息；然后决定由谁检查、检查频率如何；最后明确谁有权修订目标。目标漂移可能无法仅凭系统内部记录来认证，缺失的参考信息必须来自该记录之外。结合检查点间距的可靠性模型以及来自训练、执行和多智能体协调的证据，我们构建了一个任务分类法，用于指导锚点放置以及哪些检查可以自动化的决策。对于服务于人类目的的AI系统，即使常规检查和执行已实现自动化，人类判断在授权和修订支配自主运行的目的与标准方面仍是不可消除的结构性要求。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体长任务链中的目标漂移监督问题，提出“锚点”框架，论证人类判断在授权与修订系统目标标准上不可被自动化消除。

papers.title: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative foundation models have expanded the capabilities of embodied AI, enabling increasingly general navigation, manipulation, and long-horizon task execution. However, effective interaction with dynamic environments requires more than only strong perception and reasoning: agents must act with partial knowledge and retain, retrieve, and update information from past observations, actions, and experiences. This survey examines embodied memory as a mechanism for preserving decision-relevant information beyond the current observation. We organize existing approaches along two complementary dimensions: six fundamental memory requirements, spanning world-state persistence, task progress, belief maintenance, and experiential learning; and eight architectural categories, including recurrent states, fast weights, visual and symbolic representations, spatial memory, and experience-based systems. We analyze their capabilities and limitations, and examine how existing benchmarks evaluate memory-dependent behavior, distinguishing genuine use of historical information from general task performance. Finally, we identify open challenges in selecting relevant experiences, maintaining consistent beliefs in changing environments, and consolidating knowledge across episodes. Our analysis provides a framework for understanding memory as an essential component of reliable, adaptive, and lifelong-horizon embodied intelligence.

translation.title: 当过去塑造行动：理解具身记忆
translation.abstract: 生成式基础模型的最新进展扩展了具身AI的能力，使其能够执行日益通用的导航、操作和长时程任务。然而，与动态环境的有效交互不仅需要强大的感知与推理能力：智能体必须在知识不完全的情况下行动，并保留、检索和更新来自过去观察、行动和经验的信息。本综述将具身记忆视为一种在当前观察之外保存决策相关信息的机制。我们沿两个互补维度组织现有方法：六项基本记忆需求，涵盖世界状态持久化、任务进度、信念维护和经验学习；以及八类架构类别，包括循环状态、快速权重、视觉与符号表示、空间记忆和基于经验的系统。我们分析了它们的能力与局限，并考察现有基准如何评估依赖记忆的行为，区分对历史信息的真正使用与一般任务表现。最后，我们指出了在选取相关经验、在变化环境中维持一致信念以及跨回合整合知识方面的开放挑战。我们的分析为理解记忆作为可靠、自适应和终身时程具身智能的关键组成部分提供了框架。
translation.brief: 针对具身AI中记忆机制缺乏系统梳理的问题，从六项记忆需求和八类架构两个维度对现有方法与基准进行综述。

papers.title: QBX: A Compiler for Well-Formed, Auditable Alpha Programs
papers.abstract: Formulaic alpha miners increasingly differ in how they generate candidates, yet each system typically couples its own representation, evaluator, and selector into a bespoke pipeline whose results are difficult to reproduce or compare. We present QBX, a compiler that defines a well-formed, auditable space of alpha programs. A finite, versioned block registry and whole-strategy port-DAG language define the candidate space; the compiler either rejects a proposal with structured diagnostics or emits an evidence-carrying IR with types, time-availability effects, executable linkage, and Merkle-style content identities. Compiler-closed actions keep search inside the admitted space, node identities support incremental evaluation, and context-bound root identities govern program deduplication and trial provenance. The availability-effect system rejects contract-visible look-ahead while admitting legal point-in-time forecasts. On Chinese A-share panels, evaluation-valid proposals increase from 26.8% for free strings and 36.4% for a grammar-only control to 97.7% for typed programs. Incremental evaluation replays search lineages 7.5 times faster with numerical parity, while the availability checker admits zero registered-contract violations across 23,342 candidates. Under matched LLM-call budgets, compiler-closed search reaches the pool-specific diagnostic frontier with substantially fewer calls. These results concern validity, reuse, and search efficiency within the registered vocabulary, not an increase in the information available from the market panel.

translation.title: QBX：面向良构、可审计Alpha程序的编译器
translation.abstract: 公式化alpha挖掘系统在候选生成方式上日益多样，但每个系统通常将自身的表示、评估器和选择器耦合为定制流水线，其结果难以复现或比较。我们提出QBX，一个定义良构、可审计alpha程序空间的编译器。有限且带版本的块注册表和整策略port-DAG语言定义了候选空间；编译器要么以结构化诊断信息拒绝提案，要么发出携带证据的IR，包含类型、时间可用性效应、可执行链接和Merkle式内容标识。编译器封闭的动作使搜索保持在被允许的空间内，节点标识支持增量评估，上下文绑定的根标识管理程序去重和试验溯源。可用性效应系统拒绝合约可见的前视偏差，同时允许合法的时点预测。在中国A股面板数据上，评估有效提案的比例从自由字符串的26.8%和仅语法控制的36.4%提升到类型化程序的97.7%。增量评估以数值一致的方式将搜索谱系回放速度提升7.5倍，而可用性检查器在23,342个候选中零注册合约违规。在匹配的LLM调用预算下，编译器封闭搜索以显著更少的调用达到池特定的诊断前沿。这些结果涉及注册词汇内的有效性、复用和搜索效率，而非市场面板可用信息量的增加。
translation.brief: 针对公式化alpha挖掘结果难以复现和比较的问题，提出QBX编译器，通过类型化IR和可用性检查定义良构、可审计的alpha程序空间。

papers.title: TSBPO: Tree-Structured Branching for Policy Optimization in Interactive Language Agents
papers.abstract: Training interactive language agents from terminal outcomes poses three coupled problems: which task and state continuations to sample, how to assign delayed feedback to decisions, and how to aggregate token losses for multi-token actions. We present TSBPO, a tree-structured sampling-to-update paradigm that addresses these problems within one training loop. A likelihood-fitted Root/Branch allocator uses retained task and state evidence to target continuations likely to produce contrasting terminal outcomes under fixed rollout budgets. On the resulting replayed physical trees, trajectory advantages compare immediate sibling segments, while observation-group step advantages compare outcomes at matched task/observation states. The actor then sums clipped token surrogates over each complete response and normalizes across active turns, avoiding response-length averaging in the policy-gradient term. With a Qwen2.5-1.5B actor, fixed checkpoints obtain 97.79% seen and 96.64% unseen stochastic success on ALFWorld and an 81.07% per-episode success rate over six stochastic episodes for each of the 500 WebShop test goals. A WebShop step-term ablation yields 75.93% at the same update-100 evaluation; an ALFWorld aggregation comparison shows higher observed command validity with complete-turn weighting. These results support the evaluated training configuration on two interactive benchmarks.

translation.title: TSBPO：面向交互式语言智能体策略优化的树结构分支方法
translation.abstract: 从终端结果训练交互式语言智能体面临三个耦合问题：采样哪些任务和状态延续、如何将延迟反馈分配到各决策、以及如何为多token动作聚合token损失。我们提出TSBPO，一种在单一训练循环内解决这些问题的树结构采样到更新范式。基于似然拟合的Root/Branch分配器利用保留的任务和状态证据，在固定rollout预算下定向采样可能产生对比性终端结果的延续。在由此得到的回放物理树上，轨迹优势比较直接兄弟片段，而观察组步级优势在匹配的任务/观察状态下比较结果。然后，actor对每个完整响应求截断token代理项之和，并在活跃回合间归一化，避免策略梯度项中的响应长度平均。使用Qwen2.5-1.5B actor，固定检查点在ALFWorld上取得97.79%的已见和96.64%的未见随机成功率，在WebShop的500个测试目标上每个目标的六次随机回合平均成功率为81.07%。WebShop步级项消融在同一update-100评估下为75.93%；ALFWorld聚合比较显示完整回合加权具有更高的观察命令有效性。这些结果支持在两个交互基准上评估的训练配置。
translation.brief: 针对从终端结果训练交互式语言智能体中采样、延迟反馈分配和token损失聚合的耦合难题，提出树结构采样到更新范式TSBPO。

papers.title: Precision--Recall Trade-off on the Inference Level for LLMs in Grammatical Error Correction
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been adopted for Grammatical Error Correction (GEC), achieving strong performance via both full fine-tuning and prompt-based approaches. As probabilistic sequence models, LLMs expose inference-time parameters that directly modify token generation behavior; however, their potential for controlling GEC-specific trade-offs has not been systematically studied. In this work, we investigate decoding strategies for grammatical error correction. We show that the repetition penalty parameter enables controllable adjustment of the precision--recall trade-off at inference time, without modifying the model architecture, training procedure, or prompt. Through experiments on standard GEC benchmarks, we demonstrate that repetition-penalty-based decoding enables inference-time control of the precision--recall balance, conceptually related to methods previously proposed for sequence-to-sequence GEC models, such as Align-and-Predict Decoding (APD), while remaining simple and broadly applicable to existing LLMs that expose inference-time decoding penalties.

translation.title: 语法纠错中LLM推理层面的精确率—召回率权衡
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）近来被用于语法纠错（GEC），通过全量微调和基于提示的方法均取得了强劲性能。作为概率序列模型，LLM暴露出可直接修改token生成行为的推理时参数；然而，其在控制GEC特定权衡方面的潜力尚未得到系统研究。本文研究语法纠错的解码策略。我们证明重复惩罚参数能够在推理时可控地调整精确率—召回率权衡，而无需修改模型架构、训练过程或提示。通过在标准GEC基准上的实验，我们展示了基于重复惩罚的解码可实现推理时精确率—召回率平衡的控制，在概念上与先前为序列到序列GEC模型提出的方法（如Align-and-Predict Decoding, APD）相关，同时保持简单并广泛适用于暴露推理时解码惩罚的现有LLM。
translation.brief: 针对LLM语法纠错中精确率—召回率权衡缺乏推理时控制手段的问题，提出利用重复惩罚参数在不改动模型和提示的情况下实现该权衡的推理时调节。

papers.title: GraphNIAH: A Benchmark for Long-Context Reasoning over Real-World Graphs
papers.abstract: The needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) benchmark was introduced as a test for measuring a model's ability to find small relevant facts within a very large body of input text. However, existing NIAH benchmarks each suffer from one or more of the following limitations: (1) reliance on synthetic data, so their evaluations may not generalize to real-world settings; (2) reuse of previously published datasets, leading to the risk of benchmark contamination; (3) dependence on manual annotation, which requires human effort to create and update data and is prone to future benchmark contamination; and (4) unrealistic simplification of long-context multi-hop reasoning where each next step is trivial given previous steps, while real-world reasoning often requires planning over multiple possible proof paths. To address these limitations, we introduce \Benchmark, a dynamic benchmark built from real citation relationships among scientific papers published after the evaluated models' knowledge cutoff date, which utilizes real-world information while ensuring no benchmark contamination. The fully automated benchmark construction pipeline samples representative subgraphs of the citation graph formed by these papers and converts each subgraph into a long-context QA example with a verifiable answer. We use GraphNIAH to evaluate eight LLMs from the GPT-5.6, Gemini-3, and Qwen3.5 families. We find that accuracy falls as questions require longer reasoning paths: at question depths of 16 and 32, the GPT-5.6 and Qwen3.5 models answer YES/NO questions no better than random guessing, mostly by answering NO; four of the eight models answer no counting example correctly, and the others model get worse as the subgraph size increases. These findings suggest that current LLMs often stop searching the citation relationships in their context before they reach the answer, even though every fact they need is in the context.

translation.title: GraphNIAH：面向真实世界图的长上下文推理基准
translation.abstract: 大海捞针（NIAH）基准最初用于衡量模型在超长输入文本中找到少量相关事实的能力。然而，现有NIAH基准各自存在以下一项或多项局限：(1) 依赖合成数据，评估结果可能无法推广到真实场景；(2) 复用已公开数据集，存在基准污染风险；(3) 依赖人工标注，需要人力创建和更新数据，且未来易被污染；(4) 对长上下文多跳推理进行了不切实际的简化，即给定前序步骤后每一步都显而易见，而真实世界的推理往往需要在多条可能的证明路径上进行规划。为解决这些局限，我们提出\Benchmark，一个基于评估模型知识截止日期之后发表的科学论文之间真实引用关系构建的动态基准，既利用真实世界信息又确保无基准污染。该全自动基准构建流程从这些论文构成的引用图中采样有代表性的子图，并将每个子图转换为答案可验证的长上下文问答样例。我们使用GraphNIAH评估了来自GPT-5.6、Gemini-3和Qwen3.5系列的八个LLM。我们发现随着问题所需推理路径变长，准确率下降：在问题深度为16和32时，GPT-5.6和Qwen3.5模型回答YES/NO问题的表现不比随机猜测好，且大多回答NO；八个模型中有四个无法正确回答任何计数样例，其余模型随子图规模增大而表现变差。这些发现表明，当前LLM往往在到达答案之前就停止在上下文中搜索引用关系，尽管所需的所有事实都在上下文中。
translation.brief: 针对现有NIAH基准依赖合成数据、易被污染且简化多跳推理的问题，提出基于模型知识截止日期后真实论文引用关系自动构建的动态长上下文推理基准GraphNIAH。

papers.title: Simple Features Beat Most AI Control Monitors
papers.abstract: AI control relies on monitors to catch a capable model that sabotages its work. These monitors are evaluated on their ability to differentiate honest from backdoored code. We show that on a standard evaluation dataset, simple features beat most monitors without ever running the code, outranking 20 of 24 open-weight models prompted as monitors. The dataset gives its labels away in two ways. People wrote the honest solutions and older language models the backdoors, so the style of the code reveals the class. Additionally, problems that LLMs can backdoor have different characteristics, so basic facts about the problem reveal it too. Swapping one class at a time for code by Claude Sonnet 5 shows that these features reward a contrast between authors, since human code against Sonnet 5's backdoors is easier to separate than the original pairs, 0.95 against 0.79. One in seven backdoors in the standard test set fails our validity checks, which distorts comparisons between attackers. A Sonnet 5 monitor appears to catch 77% of the older models' backdoors but 37% of Sonnet 5's, and 78% against 61% once both are verified. We do not show that published monitors rely on these shortcuts, but our findings suggest that a high score on such a dataset is not by itself evidence of sabotage detection. We release the rebuilt dataset and checks.

translation.title: 简单特征胜过大多数AI控制监控器
translation.abstract: AI控制依赖监控器来捕捉破坏其工作的强大模型。这些监控器根据区分诚实代码与后门代码的能力进行评估。我们表明，在一个标准评估数据集上，简单特征无需运行代码即可胜过大多数监控器，在24个作为监控器提示的开源权重模型中超过20个。该数据集以两种方式泄露其标签。诚实解由人编写而后门由较旧的语言模型编写，因此代码风格揭示了类别。此外，LLM能够植入后门的问题具有不同特征，因此关于问题的基本事实也能揭示它。每次将一个类别替换为Claude Sonnet 5编写的代码的实验表明，这些特征奖励的是作者之间的对比，因为人类代码对Sonnet 5后门的区分比原始配对更容易，0.95对0.79。标准测试集中七分之一的后门未通过我们的有效性检查，这扭曲了攻击者之间的比较。一个Sonnet 5监控器似乎能捕获旧模型77%的后门，但只能捕获Sonnet 5的37%；在两者都经过验证后，这一比例为78%对61%。我们并未证明已发表的监控器依赖这些捷径，但我们的发现表明，在此类数据集上的高分本身并不是破坏检测能力的证据。我们发布了重建的数据集和检查。
translation.brief: 针对AI控制监控器评估数据集存在标签泄露捷径的问题，通过简单特征分析揭示代码风格和问题特征即可区分诚实与后门代码，质疑高分监控器的有效性。

papers.title: Search When Needed, Proceed When Reliable: Metacognitive Reliability Supervision for Efficient Agentic Search
papers.abstract: Efficient agentic search requires large language models (LLMs) to determine whether they can reliably proceed with their current knowledge or need additional external evidence. Supervision based on final-answer correctness or trajectory-level feedback evaluates realized trajectory performance. However, observed trajectory performance is jointly shaped by stochastic generation, retrieval quality, and downstream reasoning. Such signals therefore provide only indirect evidence of how reliable the current decision state was and how retrieved evidence changed its reliability. An effective reward should encourage search when external information is needed and favor searches that contribute to the answer. To this end, we propose a metacognitive framework for training LLMs to make search decisions based on the reliability of their intermediate reasoning states. Our framework estimates the reliability of local conclusions to distinguish whether the current information supports proceeding without search from how much retrieved evidence improves that reliability. The current-state reliability score assesses whether the model can proceed without search. The search-action score measures how retrieved evidence changes estimated reliability. Together, these scores define a reliability-aware process reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), providing finer-grained supervision for search and no-search behavior. Experiments across seven question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than strong agentic-search baselines. Our code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced.

translation.title: 需要时搜索，可靠时推进：面向高效智能体搜索的元认知可靠性监督
translation.abstract: 高效的智能体搜索要求大语言模型（LLM）判断其当前知识是否足以可靠地继续推进，还是需要额外的外部证据。基于最终答案正确性或轨迹级反馈的监督评估的是已实现的轨迹性能。然而，观察到的轨迹性能由随机生成、检索质量和下游推理共同塑造。因此，这类信号只能间接反映当前决策状态的可靠程度，以及检索到的证据如何改变其可靠性。有效的奖励应当在需要外部信息时鼓励搜索，并偏好对答案有贡献的搜索。为此，我们提出一个元认知框架，训练LLM基于其中间推理状态的可靠性做出搜索决策。我们的框架估计局部结论的可靠性，以区分当前信息是否支持无需搜索即可推进，以及检索到的证据能在多大程度上提升该可靠性。当前状态可靠性分数评估模型能否在不搜索的情况下继续；搜索动作分数衡量检索到的证据如何改变估计的可靠性。这两个分数共同定义了用于Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）的可靠性感知过程奖励，为搜索与不搜索行为提供更细粒度的监督。在七个问答基准上的实验表明，我们的方法相比强智能体搜索基线实现了更好的准确率-效率权衡。我们的代码和模型检查点将开源。
translation.brief: 针对智能体搜索中现有监督信号只能间接反映决策可靠性的问题，提出基于中间推理状态可靠性估计的元认知过程奖励框架，结合GRPO训练LLM自主决定是否搜索。

papers.title: Do LLMs Know When They Are Wrong About Molecules? In-Context Property Prediction with Self-Reported Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used in many domains, but molecular property prediction with them is still little explored. In this work we evaluate the capability of 7 frontier LLMs to predict molecular properties together with a self-reported uncertainty from in-context examples, and compare them with classical baselines trained on the same molecules. We use 4 datasets and screen each for contamination of the training data of the LLMs: three are clean, and the fourth, ESOL, is memorised by most of the models and serves as a comparison. On the clean datasets every LLM improves with the context, at 30 examples the most accurate one beats every baseline. The requested reasoning effort changes accuracy little. The self-reported uncertainty ranks the prediction errors weakly, with Spearman rank correlations of up to 0.46, about the level reached by the uncertainties of the baselines. Combining uncertainty and prediction, on lipophilicity the most certain half of the best LLM is the most accurate at small context sizes; on BACE and antiviral, and on lipophilicity at large context sizes, the best LLMs are on par with the best baseline. On the contaminated ESOL dataset the LLMs show no improvement with the context size, as expected for a memorised dataset, and their stated uncertainty is smaller on the molecules whose value they recall.

translation.title: LLM知道自己在分子问题上何时出错吗？带自报告不确定度的上下文性质预测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被应用于许多领域，但用其进行分子性质预测仍鲜有探索。在这项工作中，我们评估了7个前沿LLM从上下文示例中预测分子性质并给出自报告不确定度的能力，并与在相同分子上训练的经典基线进行比较。我们使用4个数据集，并对每个数据集筛查LLM训练数据污染情况：三个是干净的，第四个ESOL被大多数模型记忆，作为对照。在干净数据集上，每个LLM都随上下文提升，在30个示例时最准确者击败所有基线。所要求的推理努力对准确率影响很小。自报告不确定度对预测误差的排序能力较弱，Spearman秩相关最高达0.46，与基线不确定度所达到的水平大致相当。结合不确定度与预测，在亲脂性数据集上小上下文规模时最佳LLM中最确定的一半预测最准确；在BACE和抗病毒数据集上，以及大上下文规模下的亲脂性数据集上，最佳LLM与最佳基线相当。在被污染的ESOL数据集上，LLM不随上下文规模提升，符合记忆数据集的预期，且其陈述的不确定度在能回忆出数值的分子上更小。
translation.brief: 针对LLM分子性质预测能力及其不确定度校准缺乏评估的问题，在多个数据集上系统评估7个前沿LLM的上下文性质预测与自报告不确定度，并与经典基线对比。

papers.title: Latent-Lens: Visual Perception in Small Language Models Through Latent Communication
papers.abstract: Bridging independent vision-language models (VLMs) and small language models (SLMs) in a modular multi-agent system typically forces them to exchange information as discrete text, which creates a lossy bottleneck for spatial and fine-grained details. This constraint is especially acute for SLMs, whose limited capacity makes them more reliant on the quality of the input signal. Recent latent-communication methods exchange states between language models. How a VLM can pass visual information to a separately pretrained text-only SLM though remains unexplored. We propose \textbf{Latent-Lens}, a lightweight codec that bridges the representation gap between a frozen VLM and a frozen SLM directly in latent space, enabling them to communicate purely through hidden states. The codec consists of a domain encoder that projects hidden states from the VLM into the SLM's embedding space, and an attention decoder formalised as a LoRA that teaches the SLM to attend to these visual prefixes, while training only ${\sim}1.6$M parameters (0.2\% of the combined model size). On visual question answering (CLEVR, GQA), Latent-Lens achieves $81.0\pm7.9$\% and $65.4\pm5.4$\%, compared with $58.3\pm5.7$\% and $61.8\pm1.0$\% for text communication with the same LoRA budget (+30.2--69.8pp relative to frozen text communication), while on image captioning (Flickr8k) it improves over the same baseline by +16.5 (+18.8 frozen). We also evaluate Latent-Lens with TinyLlama-1.1B and InternVL2-1B, which use different architectures, vocabularies, and hidden dimensions.

translation.title: Latent-Lens：通过潜空间通信实现小语言模型的视觉感知
translation.abstract: 在模块化多智能体系统中连接独立的视觉语言模型（VLM）和小语言模型（SLM）通常迫使它们以离散文本交换信息，这对空间和细粒度细节造成了有损瓶颈。这一约束对SLM尤为严重，其有限容量使其更依赖输入信号的质量。近期的潜空间通信方法在语言模型之间交换状态，但VLM如何将视觉信息传递给单独预训练的纯文本SLM仍未被探索。我们提出\textbf{Latent-Lens}，一个轻量级编解码器，直接在潜空间中弥合冻结VLM与冻结SLM之间的表示鸿沟，使它们能够纯粹通过隐藏状态通信。该编解码器由一个域编码器（将VLM的隐藏状态投影到SLM的嵌入空间）和一个形式化为LoRA的注意力解码器（教会SLM关注这些视觉前缀）组成，仅训练约1.6M参数（占组合模型大小的0.2%）。在视觉问答（CLEVR、GQA）上，Latent-Lens分别达到81.0±7.9%和65.4±5.4%，而相同LoRA预算下的文本通信仅为58.3±5.7%和61.8±1.0%（相对冻结文本通信提升30.2–69.8个百分点）；在图像描述（Flickr8k）上，它比相同基线提升+16.5（冻结为+18.8）。我们还在使用不同架构、词表和隐藏维度的TinyLlama-1.1B和InternVL2-1B上评估了Latent-Lens。
translation.brief: 针对VLM与SLM通过离散文本通信造成视觉信息有损瓶颈的问题，提出轻量级潜空间编解码器Latent-Lens，仅训练约1.6M参数即可让冻结VLM通过隐藏状态直接向冻结SLM传递视觉信息。

papers.title: Peeling the Matryoshka: Extracting Ontological Structure from Retrieval Embeddings
papers.abstract: Taxonomy construction is essential for knowledge-intensive NLP yet remains costly: clustering-based methods (i) need careful per-corpus tuning and yield unstable hierarchies, while LLM-based pipelines (ii) depend on expensive task-specific training that does not transfer across domains. We report an empirical finding that bears on both: in Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) embeddings, where each leading prefix is itself a usable, coarser vector, prefix length aligns with the coarse-to-fine granularity of gold taxonomies; shuffled- and reverse-dimension controls isolate the alignment to the learned early prefix dimensions. The pattern holds across three architecturally distinct MRL models. To test whether this regularity is usable, we introduce PEEL (Peeling Embeddings to Extract Latent ontologies): a minimal probe over these frozen embeddings, trained once with an order-embedding objective that represents hierarchy as vector containment; a minimum spanning arborescence then decodes taxonomic DAGs. Using only a concept vocabulary (no documents), PEEL recovers taxonomic DAGs with high structural fidelity on two OLLM benchmarks, transferring to a new domain with no target-edge supervision. The end-to-end OLLM pipeline, which jointly discovers concepts and induces structure from document corpora, is reported as a cross-task reference. Pre-trained retrieval embeddings encode a decodable granularity gradient; a minimal probe renders it as explicit parent-child (is-a) structure.

translation.title: 剥开套娃：从检索嵌入中提取本体结构
translation.abstract: 分类体系构建对知识密集型NLP至关重要但成本高昂：基于聚类的方法需要对每个语料库仔细调参且产生不稳定的层级结构，而基于LLM的流水线则依赖昂贵的任务特定训练且难以跨领域迁移。我们报告了一项与两者都相关的实证发现：在Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）嵌入中，每个前缀本身就是一个可用的、更粗糙的向量，前缀长度与黄金分类体系的粗到细粒度对齐；打乱维度和逆序维度的对照实验将这种对齐隔离到学习到的前部前缀维度。该模式在三个架构不同的MRL模型上均成立。为检验这一规律是否可用，我们提出PEEL（Peeling Embeddings to Extract Latent ontologies）：一个在这些冻结嵌入上的极简探针，仅用序嵌入目标训练一次，将层级表示为向量包含关系；随后用最小生成树形图解码分类DAG。仅使用概念词汇表（无需文档），PEEL在两个OLLM基准上以高结构保真度恢复分类DAG，并能迁移到没有目标边监督的新领域。端到端的OLLM流水线（从文档语料库中联合发现概念并归纳结构）作为跨任务参考被报告。预训练检索嵌入编码了可解码的粒度梯度；一个极简探针即可将其呈现为显式的父子（is-a）结构。
translation.brief: 解决从嵌入中提取分类体系结构的问题，核心方法是利用MRL嵌入前缀长度与粒度的对齐规律，用极简序嵌入探针加最小生成树形图解码出分类DAG。

papers.title: Whose Values, Which Contexts, and What Signals? Grounding Cultural Value Alignment with Re3Culture
papers.abstract: Cultural value alignment requires not only model optimization but also a well-specified target grounded in real-human evidence. Yet how such targets should be grounded in human data remains largely unexplored, raising three fundamental questions: (1) whose values should be represented? (2) where should cultural values be observed? and (3) what signals reveal underlying values? We investigate these questions through Re3Culture, a large-scale dataset linking (i) Representative communities: 700+ human participants across four cultures recruited through cultural-affiliation screening and demographic-aware sampling; (ii) Realistic scenario: culturally sensitive scenarios selected by community members, e.g., family and kinship; and (iii) Revealed value signals: 1,400+ value surveys, 20,000+ topic-grounded behavioral principles and explicit value priorities with responses for 6,000+ situated questions. Our analysis shows why these choices matter for defining the target, with three implications. First, estimating cultural values requires both community affiliation and broad internal coverage. Substituting other cultures or restricting subgroup coverage shifts value estimates. LLM simulations also disproportionately reflect particular subgroups. Second, values must be observed in concrete, community-guided situations. Abstract questionnaire profiles weakly recover situated priorities, and communities differ in which scenarios they identify as culturally value-revealing. Third, value priorities should be elicited explicitly, not learned from response preferences or bottom-line answers alone. Preferences conflate value agreement with other response-level qualities, and similar answers can be derived from different value priorities. By addressing these requirements, Re3Culture provides the first human-grounded resource that explicitly informs target definition for cultural value alignment.

translation.title: 谁的价值、哪些情境、什么信号？以Re3Culture为文化价值对齐奠定基础
translation.abstract: 文化价值对齐不仅需要模型优化，还需要一个基于真实人类证据的明确目标。然而这类目标应如何基于人类数据来确立仍 largely 未被探索，由此引出三个基本问题：（1）应代表谁的价值？（2）应在何处观察文化价值？（3）什么信号能揭示潜在价值？我们通过Re3Culture数据集研究这些问题，该数据集关联：（i）代表性社区：通过文化归属筛查和人口统计感知抽样招募的来自四种文化的700多名人类参与者；（ii）真实情境：由社区成员选定的文化敏感情境，如家庭与亲属关系；（iii）显现的价值信号：1400多份价值调查、20000多条基于主题的行为原则，以及针对6000多个情境化问题的显式价值优先级与回答。我们的分析说明了这些选择为何对目标定义至关重要，并得出三点启示。第一，估计文化价值既需要社区归属也需要广泛的内部覆盖；替换其他文化或限制子群体覆盖会改变价值估计，LLM模拟也不成比例地反映特定子群体。第二，价值必须在具体的、由社区引导的情境中观察；抽象问卷画像难以恢复情境化优先级，且各社区在哪些情境能揭示文化价值上存在差异。第三，价值优先级应显式引出，而非仅从回答偏好或最终答案中学习；偏好会将价值认同与其他回答层面的特质混淆，相似的答案可能来自不同的价值优先级。通过满足这些要求，Re3Culture提供了首个基于人类的、显式指导文化价值对齐目标定义的资源。
translation.brief: 解决文化价值对齐目标如何基于人类数据确立的问题，核心方法是构建Re3Culture数据集，从代表性社区、真实情境和显式价值信号三方面系统回答谁的价值、哪些情境、什么信号三个问题。

papers.title: Reparo: Synthesizing and Validating Access Control Policies
papers.abstract: Writing correct access control policies for software applications is difficult because it requires expertise in the authorization language and a thorough understanding of the application's authorization requirements. Existing synthesis and mining approaches assume explicit authorization inputs and a trusted reference policy. However, authorization logic is often distributed across code, comments, and documentation rather than captured in a single artifact, and developer-defined policies in real-world application repositories are often incomplete, outdated, or incorrect. We present Reparo, an LLM-aided pipeline for access control policy synthesis, repair, and validation. Reparo collects repository evidence for authorization intent and uses it to guide an LLM in generating an initial policy. It then uses official policy-language validation tools to identify and automatically repair errors. For semantic validation, a different LLM derives a behavioral oracle from the same repository evidence, consisting of concrete authorization requests with expected allow or deny decisions, which Reparo executes against the generated policy. We manually assess the oracle on a statistically sized sample of 390 test cases. We evaluate Reparo on 228 real-world GitHub repositories that use Cedar, OpenFGA, or Rego. In these repositories, 40.6-55.7% of the repository policies fail their language's validation tool, whereas Reparo produces 99.0-100% valid policies after repair. Agreement with the oracle is 98.2-99.6% for OpenFGA, 82.0-86.5% for Cedar, and 76.3-80.2% for Rego. Manual review confirms 91.5-96.9% of the sampled test cases as correct. Synthesizing and validating the policy for one repository takes about five minutes and costs $0.55-$1.57. These results show that repository evidence can support both access policy synthesis and independent validation, even when no reliable reference policy exists.

translation.title: Reparo：访问控制策略的合成与验证
translation.abstract: 为软件应用编写正确的访问控制策略很困难，因为它既需要授权语言方面的专业知识，又需要透彻理解应用的授权需求。现有的合成与挖掘方法假设存在显式的授权输入和可信的参考策略。然而，授权逻辑往往分散在代码、注释和文档中而非集中于单一工件，且真实应用仓库中开发者定义的策略常常不完整、过时或错误。我们提出Reparo，一个LLM辅助的访问控制策略合成、修复与验证流水线。Reparo收集仓库中关于授权意图的证据，并用其引导LLM生成初始策略；随后使用官方策略语言验证工具识别并自动修复错误。在语义验证方面，另一个LLM从相同的仓库证据推导出行为oracle，即带有预期允许或拒绝决策的具体授权请求，Reparo将其对生成的策略执行。我们在统计规模为390个测试用例的样本上人工评估了该oracle。我们在228个使用Cedar、OpenFGA或Rego的真实GitHub仓库上评估Reparo。这些仓库中40.6-55.7%的策略无法通过其语言的验证工具，而Reparo修复后产生99.0-100%的有效策略。与oracle的一致率在OpenFGA上为98.2-99.6%，Cedar上为82.0-86.5%，Rego上为76.3-80.2%。人工审查确认91.5-96.9%的抽样测试用例正确。为一个仓库合成并验证策略约需五分钟，成本0.55-1.57美元。这些结果表明，即使不存在可靠的参考策略，仓库证据也能同时支持访问策略的合成与独立验证。
translation.brief: 解决在无可信参考策略时合成正确访问控制策略的问题，核心方法是用LLM从仓库证据生成初始策略，再用官方验证工具自动修复错误并用LLM推导的行为oracle进行语义验证。

papers.title: What Standard Evaluations Hide About Detectors of Hijacked LLM Agents: Rare Attacks, Unseen Tools and Benchmark Transfer
papers.abstract: Detectors can flag hijacked large language model (LLM) agents from the traces of the tools they call. In the eleven evaluations we audited, attacks or anomalies make up 16% to 86% of the test samples, no evaluation varies that share, and six report no test on data from a second benchmark or source. We ask what such evaluations hide. On the AgentDrift and AgentDojo benchmarks we test trained detectors that read tool identities, behavior, call sequences, step embeddings or text, and a released LLM action monitor, AlignmentCheck, with thresholds fixed on training data or set by the monitor's released decision rule. First, at a 2% attack rate a detector with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.879 reaches a precision of 0.076, and the mix of negatives alone moves that precision between 0.039 and 0.117. Second, as tool coverage, the share of test tool calls whose tool was seen in training, falls, detector rankings cross near 50% coverage and reverse below it, because unseen tools map to inputs that training never reached. Dropout on tool inputs largely removes the reversal. Third, no detector trained on AgentDrift ranks AgentDojo traces better than chance (AUROC 0.47 to 0.52), including one that reaches 0.996 within AgentDojo. The monitor, trained on neither, reaches 0.930, but with its open backbone its released decision rule would still mostly raise false alerts at a 2% attack rate (precision 0.096). We turn these findings into a checklist for evaluating trace detectors.

translation.title: 标准评估掩盖了什么：关于被劫持LLM智能体检测器的罕见攻击、未见工具与基准迁移
translation.abstract: 检测器可以从LLM智能体调用的工具轨迹中标记被劫持的智能体。在我们审计的十一项评估中，攻击或异常占测试样本的16%到86%，没有评估改变这一比例，且有六项未报告在第二个基准或数据源上的测试。我们探究这类评估掩盖了什么。在AgentDrift和AgentDojo基准上，我们测试了读取工具身份、行为、调用序列、步骤嵌入或文本的训练检测器，以及一个已发布的LLM动作监控器AlignmentCheck，阈值固定在训练数据上或由监控器发布的决策规则设定。第一，在2%攻击率下，AUROC为0.879的检测器精度仅0.076，且仅负样本构成的变化就会使精度在0.039到0.117之间波动。第二，随着工具覆盖率（测试工具调用中训练时见过的工具占比）下降，检测器排名在约50%覆盖率附近交叉并在其下反转，因为未见工具映射到训练从未触及的输入；对工具输入使用dropout基本消除了这种反转。第三，在AgentDrift上训练的检测器对AgentDojo轨迹的排序均不优于随机（AUROC 0.47到0.52），包括一个在AgentDojo内部达到0.996的检测器。未在两者上训练的监控器达到0.930，但使用其开放骨干时，其发布的决策规则在2%攻击率下仍主要产生误报（精度0.096）。我们将这些发现转化为评估轨迹检测器的检查清单。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体劫持检测器评估标准失真的问题，核心方法是通过系统性实验揭示攻击率、工具覆盖率和跨基准迁移对检测器性能的影响，并提出评估检查清单。

papers.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning Is an Integration Problem
papers.abstract: This paper presents an opinionated set of ten desiderata intended to inform the design and evaluation of reinforcement-learning agents that learn continually throughout a continuing lifetime. We use these desiderata to examine a representative selection of existing approaches. Progress on individual desiderata is valuable, but the longer-term aim should be to integrate all ten within a single agent. To our knowledge, no published evaluation has yet provided evidence for such an integration. Likewise, the representative benchmarks we review probe different parts of this target, but separate evaluations do not establish that the corresponding properties coexist within one agent throughout a continuing lifetime. As a secondary contribution, we therefore present a compact persistent-world scenario as a playable companion to the desiderata and outline a proposed benchmark that examines a broad range of associated behavioral capabilities together within one such lifetime.

translation.title: 持续强化学习是一个整合问题
translation.abstract: 本文提出了一套带有鲜明观点的十条设计要求，旨在指导在整个持续生命周期中不断学习的强化学习智能体的设计与评估。我们用这些要求审视了现有方法的一个代表性选择。在个别要求上取得进展是有价值的，但更长期的目标应是将全部十条整合到单个智能体中。据我们所知，尚无已发表的评估为这种整合提供证据。同样，我们回顾的代表性基准各自探测该目标的不同部分，但分离的评估并不能证明相应属性能在单个智能体的持续生命周期中共存。作为次要贡献，我们因此提出了一个紧凑的持久世界场景作为这些要求的可玩配套，并概述了一个拟议基准，在同一个生命周期内共同考察广泛的相关行为能力。
translation.brief: 解决持续强化学习缺乏统一整合评估的问题，核心方法是提出十条设计要求并配套一个在单一持续生命周期内综合考察多种行为能力的持久世界基准。

papers.title: RECAST: REconstruction of Chain-of-Thought via Auditable Structured Traces
papers.abstract: Large closed-source reasoning models expose only their final answers. The intermediate reasoning that produces those answers is hidden behind API surfaces, tool-call policies, and safety filters. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) extraction methods assume a side channel: a visible reasoning field, a scratchpad carried through tool calls, or a signed/encrypted reasoning block. We reproduce three representative state-of-the-art extraction methods and find that, on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 accessed through the standard chat-completions interface, all three return zero CoT tokens. The failure is structural rather than a bug: the reasoning field is absent, named tool selection is rejected, free-text scratchpad arguments are filtered, and no replayable reasoning block is exposed. We therefore take a different route. We present RECAST, a reconstruction-based framework that conditions a decoder on the question and the target model's final answer, reconstructs a first-person structured rationale, cleans it, and builds SFT-ready data. To the best of our knowledge, RECAST is the first system to reconstruct CoT from frontier closed models such as Claude-Sonnet-5.5, GPT-6.1, and Gemini 3 without using hidden reasoning channels. We instantiate RECAST on Claude-Sonnet-5.5 and additionally obtain successful qualitative reconstructions on GPT-6.1 and Gemini 3 with the same answer-only protocol. The system is open-source and packaged as an agent skill: one prompt deploys it and runs the complete pipeline to produce SFT-ready CoT data. This preprint describes the system, its threat model, and a controlled artifact validation; it does not claim large-scale benchmark improvements.

papers.title: Trainable Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) is a rapidly evolving technique for compressing Large Language Model (LLM) weights, reducing memory usage, and speeding up inference. However, extreme compression deteriorates model performance, which is challenging to recover due to the discrete nature of VQ parameters. Existing methods employ training-free approaches that are limited to layer-wise reconstruction loss minimization. To address this limitation, we propose TVQ, a novel method that leverages straight-through estimation to enable gradient descent-based optimization of vector-quantized LLMs. By reformulating VQ LLM optimization with trainable latent weights, TVQ enables arbitrary objective minimization. We constitute our approach by applying TVQ in a block-wise knowledge distillation paradigm, which balances quality and training efficiency, and propose several practical solutions to accelerate training. In experiments on modern LLMs, we demonstrate that TVQ is compatible with modern VQ schemes. As a result, TVQ achieves state-of-the-art quality in low-bit post-training quantization settings with a modest training budget and straightforward PyTorch implementation. For instance, TVQ achieves near-lossless 2-bit quantization for LLaMA2-70B with only 1% accuracy drop on popular Question-Answering benchmarks.

papers.title: LLM Recommenders Produce Demographic Inequality Through Content Preferences
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into systems that rank and recommend online content. We examine how this shift can produce demographic inequality in whose voices are surfaced. Using 10,000 Twitter/X posts written by 1,000 survey respondents and linked to verified self-reported characteristics across nine demographic attributes, we conduct a controlled recommendation experiment across three LLM providers, six recommendation objectives, and five levels of contextual information. By varying whether models receive post text alone, platform metadata, or explicit author demographics, we isolate three pathways to unequal recommendation: preferences for demographically patterned content, reliance on unequal engagement signals, and direct use of disclosed identity. We find that demographic inequality emerges from text alone. Models consistently favour longer, more negative, and more opinionated posts, particularly those concerning news and social issues, producing systematic differences in the demographic composition of recommended authors. Platform metadata generally amplifies these inequalities, while explicitly disclosing authors' demographic characteristics produces little additional change. Recommendation objectives mainly affect the magnitude of these patterns: controversial framing intensifies both content and demographic skew, whereas popularity-oriented framing dampens it, although for some attributes - most notably age - the objective can also reverse which group is favoured. LLM-based recommenders can therefore reproduce demographic inequality by proxy, not through explicit demographic targeting, but through preferences for content and engagement signals already structured by social inequality.

papers.title: SimXAI: A Simple Drop-in Layer Increases Interaction Quality and Understanding in Conversational XAI
papers.abstract: Conversational explainable AI (ConvXAI) agents often use GUS-style architectures with separate modules for intent recognition, dialogue management, and template-based response generation. While faithful to the underlying XAI methods, these pipelines are hard to adapt and often struggle with context-dependent follow-up questions. We present SimXAI, a lightweight LLM-centric conversational layer that replaces these modules with a single tool-calling LLM that bridges access to existing XAI resources. Rather than a standalone agent, SimXAI serves as a modular interface that enables conversational access to external XAI resources. We further introduce an evaluation suite for single- and multi-turn parsing, faithfulness, and contextualization. Across existing and new datasets, SimXAI achieves strong function-selection accuracy and high faithfulness while better handling context-dependent requests. In a user study replacing only the conversational layer of TalkToModel, a representative GUS-based agent, users completed tasks more accurately and in fewer turn. Overall, SimXAI improves GUS-based design while preserving faithfulness and improving conversational quality.

papers.title: Learning to Interact and Direct: Co-Evolving Video Director Agents
papers.abstract: Video director agents orchestrate multistage production to realize users' creative visions. Emerging research on their self-evolution advances screenplay planning effectively. However, the mutual reinforcement between directing and user interaction remains largely overlooked. Improved interaction clarifies user intent and informs workflow refinement, while more reliable execution shifts collaboration from troubleshooting to creative decisions. To this end, we introduce LIT (Learning to Interact and DirecT), a framework comprises a director agent, a simulated user, and a meta engineer. Simulated user assigns creative tasks to probe the director's weaknesses, while the meta engineer uses the task traces to revise the director's interaction and production strategy. Although this approach can address discovered interaction and production issues, it still relies on passive attribution by the meta agent. This limits its ability to adapt to broader user interaction patterns and production techniques. To solve this problem, we equip LIT with a co-evolution paradigm. The meta agent proactively learns external knowledge, thereby improving its ability to discover problems and propose solutions. The meta agent, simulated user, and director together form an evolutionary closed loop, collaboratively enhances the system's directing and interaction capabilities. Across the Test and OOD Test splits, LIT improves production and Interaction scores by 19.1% and 32.0%, respectively, relative to the initial pipeline. Controlled ablations reveal the correlation between improvements in production and interaction, where the co-evolution mechanism further encourage directing skill and interaction mode exploration.
