papers.title: AI evaluators favor job applications written by certain AI models, independent of candidate quality
papers.abstract: Job applicants increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to write cover letters, while employers deploy LLMs to screen them. In this all-AI setting, we ask whether the \emph{choice of model} affects hiring outcomes independently of candidate qualifications. We introduce a multi-model auditing framework pairing eleven LLM writer agents with nine API-hosted evaluator agents across ten job descriptions and fifty candidates per job. Four findings emerge. First, we identify a generative preference hierarchy: a consistent global ranking of writer models by evaluator acceptance, in which locally hosted models are systematically disadvantaged regardless of their license, compounded by self-preference bias where evaluators favour their own outputs. Second, evaluator models differ substantially in how much bias they introduce based on applicants' tool choice, offering actionable guidance for fairer screening design. Third, this hierarchy has measurable competitive consequences: in the most adverse pairing, approximately two (1.8) out of twenty-five qualified candidates are filtered out purely due to model mismatch. Fourth, a common mechanism explains the patterns above: writer preference and self-preference trace to a combination of how much each writer leans on specific stylistic cues and how strongly evaluators, often unanimously, reward or penalise those same cues. A further check finds little evidence that an unmeasured "writer fingerprint" remains once these same features are accounted for. We discuss implications for algorithmic fairness in employment, regulation of AI-assisted screening, and the design of auditing frameworks that can be reapplied as the model landscape evolves.

translation.title: AI 评估者偏爱由特定 AI 模型撰写的求职申请，而与候选人质量无关
translation.abstract: 求职者越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）撰写求职信，而雇主则部署 LLM 来筛选它们。在这种全 AI 场景中，我们探讨模型的选择是否会在独立于候选人资质的情况下影响招聘结果。我们提出了一个多模型审计框架，将十一个 LLM 写作代理与九个 API 托管的评估代理配对，涵盖十份职位描述和每份职位五十名候选人。研究得出四项发现。首先，我们识别出一种生成偏好层级：评估者对写作模型的接受度存在一致的全局排名，其中本地托管模型无论其许可证如何都系统性地处于劣势，且叠加了评估者偏爱自己输出的自我偏好偏差。其次，不同评估者模型因申请者工具选择而引入的偏差程度差异显著，为更公平的筛选设计提供了可操作的指导。第三，这种层级具有可衡量的竞争后果：在最不利的配对中，二十五名合格候选人中约有两人（1.8 人）纯粹因模型不匹配而被过滤掉。第四，一个共同机制解释了上述模式：写作偏好和自我偏好可追溯为两方面因素的组合——每个写作者对特定风格线索的依赖程度，以及评估者（往往一致地）对这些相同线索的奖励或惩罚强度。进一步的检验发现，在考虑这些相同特征后，几乎没有证据表明仍存在未测量的“写作者指纹”。我们讨论了对就业算法公平性、AI 辅助筛选监管以及可随模型格局演变而重复应用的审计框架设计的启示。
translation.brief: 研究 AI 评估者筛选 AI 撰写求职信时模型选择是否独立影响招聘结果，通过多模型审计框架揭示生成偏好层级及其机制。

papers.title: No More Import Errors: Constrained Decoding for Guaranteed Valid Imports in LLM-Generated Tests
papers.abstract: One of the most common failure reasons of LLM-based test generation pipelines is import errors. Grammar constrained decoding can modify the probabilities of the LLM's final layer during token generation to guarantee valid imports. However, we find that it can lead to degenerate solutions, i.e., repetitive valid imports (import streaks) that exhaust the token budget before a test is generated. We propose Constrained Beam Decoding with Lookup (CBDL), a novel method that guarantees import validity while addressing import streaks by avoiding premature commitment to tokens that lead to repetitive imports. Because it operates at the decoding stage, CBDL can be integrated into existing LLM-based test generation pipelines. We implement CBDL for Python and Java and evaluate it on two test generation tasks, showing that generated tests have 100% valid imports, outperforming both static (RAG and LIBRO) and dynamic (Agentic Repair) import-validity approaches that leave 45%, 10%, and 43% of import errors unresolved. CBDL converts on average 14% of initial import errors into functionally correct tests, increasing overall test correctness by 1-4 percentage points over unconstrained generation. Even when import validity does not directly lead to a correct test, it allows agentic repair pipelines to allocate the repair budget to remaining errors, increasing correct tests by 2-7 percentage points for Python and 1-6 for Java. Finally, we show that a hybrid pipeline, where a small local model equipped with CBDL generates imports while the frontier GPT-5.2 model generates the test body, outperforms generating both with GPT-5.2 alone by 1-3 percentage points. Overall, CBDL removes a major bottleneck in LLM-based test generation: by guaranteeing import validity with a small overhead (16-21 seconds per test), it improves test correctness and enables cost-effective hybrid generation.

translation.title: 告别导入错误：用于保证 LLM 生成测试中导入有效性的约束解码
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的测试生成流水线最常见的失败原因之一是导入错误。语法约束解码可以在 token 生成过程中修改 LLM 最后一层的概率，以保证导入有效。然而，我们发现这可能导致退化解，即重复的有效导入（导入连发）在生成测试之前耗尽 token 预算。我们提出带查找的约束束解码（CBDL），这是一种新方法，在保证导入有效性的同时，通过避免过早提交导致重复导入的 token 来解决导入连发问题。由于它在解码阶段运行，CBDL 可以集成到现有的基于 LLM 的测试生成流水线中。我们为 Python 和 Java 实现了 CBDL，并在两个测试生成任务上进行评估，结果表明生成的测试具有 100% 的有效导入，优于静态（RAG 和 LIBRO）和动态（Agentic Repair）导入有效性方法，后者分别留下 45%、10% 和 43% 的导入错误未解决。CBDL 平均将 14% 的初始导入错误转化为功能正确的测试，使整体测试正确率比无约束生成提高 1-4 个百分点。即使导入有效性并未直接带来正确的测试，它也能让代理修复流水线将修复预算分配给剩余错误，使 Python 的正确测试增加 2-7 个百分点，Java 增加 1-6 个百分点。最后，我们展示了一种混合流水线，其中配备 CBDL 的小型本地模型生成导入，而前沿的 GPT-5.2 模型生成测试主体，其表现比单独使用 GPT-5.2 生成两者高出 1-3 个百分点。总体而言，CBDL 消除了基于 LLM 的测试生成的一个主要瓶颈：以较小的开销（每个测试 16-21 秒）保证导入有效性，提高了测试正确性并实现了经济高效的混合生成。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 生成测试中的导入错误问题，提出 CBDL 约束束解码方法在解码阶段保证导入有效性并避免重复导入。

papers.title: How Much Can Tool Calls Reveal About You? Privacy Leakage from Tool-Call Traces
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents interact with external tools through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), producing tool-call traces that may expose behavioral signals about users. In this work, we systematically study the risk of user-profile inference from MCP tool-call traces, where observers infer user attributes from protocol-valid tool interactions without access to user conversations. We introduce PrivacyTrace, a benchmark containing 1,000 synthetic user profiles and 4,000 agent trajectories across four domains, generated with real MCP tools from 25 servers. Experiments with four mainstream LLM attackers show that tool-call traces enable a 26.25% attack success rate for profile inference, compared with 17.97% from prior-based guessing. Further analysis reveals that tool arguments and returned results provide the main trace-grounded evidence, while linking traces across sessions further amplifies profiling risk. These findings demonstrate that MCP tool-call traces can act as effective behavioral side channels for user profiling, motivating the development of privacy-aware mechanisms for agent-tool interactions. Code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 工具调用能泄露多少关于你的信息？来自工具调用轨迹的隐私泄露
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）等协议与外部工具交互，产生的工具调用轨迹可能暴露用户的行为信号。在本工作中，我们系统研究了从 MCP 工具调用轨迹推断用户画像的风险，即观察者在无法访问用户对话的情况下，从协议合法的工具交互中推断用户属性。我们引入 PrivacyTrace，一个包含 1,000 个合成用户画像和 4,000 条智能体轨迹的基准，覆盖四个领域，使用来自 25 个服务器的真实 MCP 工具生成。使用四种主流 LLM 攻击者的实验表明，工具调用轨迹可实现 26.25% 的画像推断攻击成功率，而基于先验的猜测仅为 17.97%。进一步分析显示，工具参数和返回结果提供了主要的轨迹证据，而跨会话关联轨迹进一步放大了画像风险。这些发现表明 MCP 工具调用轨迹可以作为用户画像的有效行为侧信道，促使人们开发面向隐私的智能体-工具交互机制。代码和数据可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 研究 MCP 工具调用轨迹导致的用户画像隐私泄露风险，构建 PrivacyTrace 基准并用 LLM 攻击者实验量化泄露程度。

papers.title: Automated Keyword Generation Using LLMs in a High-Volume Data Virtualization Service
papers.abstract: In modern data infrastructure, a data virtualization service (DVS) allows users to create many versions of source datasets for different processing tasks. For example, a multivariate or multi-modality dataset can be used for different machine learning tasks (e.g., classification, detection, segmentation, forecasting, and so on). Data selection, participation, integration, and preprocessing in different tasks result in many virtual datasets [Khan et al., SSC 2026]. Meanwhile, different users need to discover existing virtual datasets frequently and easily to avoid duplicate efforts. To enable an effective search engine in a DVS, it is desirable to automatically generate keywords for each virtual dataset. In this work, we present a solution for generating keywords for virtual datasets using large language models (LLMs). We propose five strategies for selecting different collections of text data for processing by the LLMs. We applied the five strategies to virtual datasets created in five application case studies with different source datasets. We conducted experiments with three LLM generators and two embedding techniques. The experiments show that the performances of the five strategies depend on the quality of the text descriptions. The results help us adopt a multi-strategy implementation of a new keyword generation service (KGS) as part of an extended DVS. The work demonstrates that the capability of automated keyword generation is indispensable for a high-volume DVS that is dataset-rich and frequently accessed.

translation.title: 在高吞吐量数据虚拟化服务中使用 LLM 自动生成关键词
translation.abstract: 在现代数据基础设施中，数据虚拟化服务（DVS）允许用户为不同的处理任务创建源数据集的多个版本。例如，多变量或多模态数据集可用于不同的机器学习任务（如分类、检测、分割、预测等）。不同任务中的数据选择、参与、集成和预处理产生了许多虚拟数据集 [Khan et al., SSC 2026]。同时，不同用户需要频繁且便捷地发现现有虚拟数据集，以避免重复劳动。为了在 DVS 中构建有效的搜索引擎，为每个虚拟数据集自动生成关键词是理想的。在本工作中，我们提出了一种使用大语言模型（LLM）为虚拟数据集生成关键词的解决方案。我们提出了五种策略，用于选择不同的文本数据集合供 LLM 处理。我们将这五种策略应用于五个应用案例研究中创建的虚拟数据集，这些案例使用不同的源数据集。我们使用三个 LLM 生成器和两种嵌入技术进行了实验。实验表明，五种策略的表现取决于文本描述的质量。这些结果帮助我们采用多策略实现方式，将新的关键词生成服务（KGS）作为扩展 DVS 的一部分。这项工作表明，对于数据集丰富且访问频繁的高吞吐量 DVS，自动关键词生成能力是不可或缺的。
translation.brief: 解决数据虚拟化服务中虚拟数据集难以被发现的问题，提出用 LLM 配合五种文本选择策略自动生成搜索关键词。

papers.title: ReX-GG: a LLM Ensemble Pipeline for Relation-extraction and Graph Generation
papers.abstract: Current LLM ensemble frameworks focus on multi-step setups with additional modules for answer ranking, often opting for token and span analysis rather than structured outputs, leading to heavyweight architectures with potential fail states along the pipeline. Faster, lighter solutions are more vulnerable to hallucination propagation and can lack output control in more complex pipelines. This paper proposes a customisable, lightweight ensemble workflow of coordinated Large Language Models that leverages JSON-structured outputs and anonymous peer-review ranking to mitigate hallucinatory outputs and single-model failure points. The pipeline is demonstrated on a relation extraction task applied to popular science articles in English, targeting four ontologically-grounded relation types (strong causation, weak causation, contrastive, and compositional), with semantic node canonicalisation and interactive, colour-coded HTML causal graphs as the final output. Performance is evaluated through an anonymous user study, achieving an average perceived accuracy of 0.778 against a human-annotated gold standard. The modular architecture supports flexible deployment across both API-based and in-house LLM setups, and the full framework is released under an open license to foster reproducibility and collaborative research.

translation.title: ReX-GG：用于关系抽取与图生成的 LLM 集成流水线
translation.abstract: 当前的 LLM 集成框架侧重于带有额外答案排序模块的多步骤设置，往往选择 token 和 span 分析而非结构化输出，导致架构笨重且流水线中存在潜在的失败状态。更快、更轻量的解决方案则更容易出现幻觉传播，并且在更复杂的流水线中可能缺乏输出控制。本文提出了一种可定制、轻量级的协同大语言模型集成工作流，利用 JSON 结构化输出和匿名同行评审排序来缓解幻觉输出和单模型故障点。该流水线在应用于英文科普文章的关系抽取任务上进行了演示，针对四种基于本体的关系类型（强因果、弱因果、对比和组合），最终输出为语义节点规范化以及交互式、彩色编码的 HTML 因果图。性能通过匿名用户研究进行评估，相对于人工标注的金标准，平均感知准确率为 0.778。模块化架构支持在基于 API 和自托管 LLM 设置中灵活部署，整个框架以开放许可证发布，以促进可复现性和协作研究。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 集成框架笨重且易传播幻觉的问题，提出基于 JSON 结构化输出和匿名同行评审排序的轻量级关系抽取与图生成流水线。

papers.title: Completeness and Cost of Retrieval Structures for Multi-Tool Requests in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: An agent that must call several tools to fulfill a request fails when the tool retriever omits any one of them, yet tool retrievers are mostly built and evaluated on queries requiring a single tool. We compare representatives of six retrieval structures (flat lexical and dense retrieval, LLM query decomposition, LLM-navigated hierarchies, server-then-tool matching, dependency graphs, and trained set-level retrievers) across two multi-tool testbeds: 345 AppWorld queries with expert dependency labels and 103 MCP-Bench tasks over 257 MCP tools. We measure completeness@k, the share of queries whose entire required tool set appears in the top k, alongside the LLM calls, tokens, and latency that each structure incurs at retrieval time. A motivating analysis on all 7,961 ToolRet queries shows that aggregate completeness mixes two regimes: completeness at 10 is .58 to .67 on single-target queries and .08 to .17 on queries with four or more targets, and the ordering of retrievers on single-target queries reverses on multi-target ones. Across the two testbeds, none of the compared structures that is untrained on the testbed and makes at most one LLM call per query completes more than 10% of AppWorld queries at k = 16. The two structures that do better incur different costs: a set-level retriever trained on 75 to 90 in-domain queries reaches .33 on AppWorld and .58 on MCP-Bench with no LLM calls, while an LLM-navigated hierarchy reaches .30 and .40 with a median of 31 to 38 LLM calls and about five minutes per query. Their failure modes also differ: the trained retriever mostly ranks the missing tools just below the cutoff, whereas the hierarchy finds the target API and stops before collecting its prerequisites. In a downstream check with the official AppWorld agent, tasks with a complete retrieved set succeeded 21 of 21 times, whereas incomplete ones succeeded 2 of 39 times.

translation.title: LLM智能体多工具请求中检索结构的完整性与成本
translation.abstract: 一个需要调用多个工具才能完成请求的智能体，只要工具检索器遗漏其中任何一个就会失败，然而工具检索器大多是在只需单个工具的查询上构建和评估的。我们在两个多工具测试平台上比较了六类检索结构的代表（扁平词法与稠密检索、LLM查询分解、LLM导航的层次结构、先服务器后工具匹配、依赖图以及训练过的集合级检索器）：包含专家依赖标注的345条AppWorld查询，以及覆盖257个MCP工具的103个MCP-Bench任务。我们测量completeness@k，即完整所需工具集出现在前k个结果中的查询比例，同时测量每种结构在检索时产生的LLM调用次数、token数和延迟。在全部7,961条ToolRet查询上的动机性分析表明，总体completeness混合了两种情形：单目标查询在k=10时completeness为.58到.67，而四个及以上目标的查询仅为.08到.17，且检索器在单目标查询上的排序在多目标查询上会反转。在两个测试平台上，所有未在测试平台上训练且每条查询最多进行一次LLM调用的被比较结构，在k=16时对AppWorld查询的completeness均不超过10%。表现较好的两种结构成本不同：一个仅用75到90条域内查询训练的集合级检索器在AppWorld上达到.33、MCP-Bench上达到.58，且无需LLM调用；而LLM导航的层次结构达到.30和.40，但中位数需要31到38次LLM调用，每条查询约五分钟。它们的失败模式也不同：训练过的检索器大多把缺失工具排在截止线略下方，而层次结构找到目标API后就在收集其前置依赖之前停止。在使用官方AppWorld智能体的下游检验中，检索集完整的任务21次全部成功，而不完整的任务39次中仅成功2次。
translation.brief: 针对多工具请求下工具检索器易遗漏工具的问题，系统比较六类检索结构在完整性与成本上的表现，并提出集合级训练检索器与LLM导航层次结构两种改进方案。

papers.title: Structure-Aware Skill Retrieval and Arbitration for Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can turn natural-language optimization tasks into solver-checked answers, but current agents remain brittle under narrative rewrites and often store reusable experience at the instance level. We introduce \textsc{ArchOR}, an archetype-centric skill agent that builds on \textsc{OptSkills} by adding two retrieval-focused modules. \emph{Centroid-Aware Representation Learning} (CARL) refines the ordering of cached skill representations through a low-rank prototype residual. \emph{Signature-Guided Retrieval} (S\textsuperscript{3}R) attaches open-dimensional structural signatures to skills, prioritizes candidates by weighted Jaccard overlap, and bounds semantic re-ranking to a top-$K$ set. A baseline-preserving arbitration rule determines when the structural route should replace the original selector. With the same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone and released skill library, \textsc{ArchOR} reaches 65.00\% Micro-Avg.\ Pass@1 across five benchmarks, improving over \textsc{OptSkills} by 1.64~pp Micro-Avg.\ and 2.68~pp Macro-Avg.

translation.title: 面向优化建模的结构感知技能检索与仲裁
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以将自然语言优化任务转化为经求解器验证的答案，但当前的智能体在叙述改写下仍然脆弱，且往往以实例级别存储可复用经验。我们提出以原型为中心的技能智能体\textsc{ArchOR}，它在\textsc{OptSkills}基础上增加了两个以检索为核心的模块。质心感知表示学习（CARL）通过低秩原型残差优化缓存技能表示的排序。签名引导检索（S³R）为技能附加开放维度的结构签名，通过加权Jaccard重叠对候选进行优先级排序，并将语义重排序限制在top-K集合内。一条保持基线的仲裁规则决定何时结构化路线应替换原始选择器。在相同的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash骨干和已发布的技能库下，\textsc{ArchOR}在五个基准上达到65.00%的Micro-Avg. Pass@1，相比\textsc{OptSkills}提升1.64个百分点（Micro-Avg.）和2.68个百分点（Macro-Avg.）。
translation.brief: 针对优化建模智能体在叙述改写下脆弱且经验存储粒度过细的问题，提出基于结构签名与质心感知表示的技能检索方法及仲裁规则。

papers.title: Matching Workloads to Blackwell: Power-Resolved Benchmarking of NVIDIA B200 and B300 across HPC and AI Workloads
papers.abstract: We evaluate NVIDIA B200 and B300 (Blackwell Ultra) GPUs on two independent eight-GPU clusters, spanning computer-vision inference and training, LLM inference with Llama-3-8B and 70B~\cite{llama3}, and six production HPC codes. The B300 is not a uniform successor to the B200: it trails by up to 5.6$\times$ on convolutional inference, 8$\times$ on 3D vision transformer training, 24--27\% on 70B LLM throughput, and 16$\times$ on double-precision Quantum ESPRESSO. We resolve the convolutional deficit using per-GPU board power rather than throughput alone: on the affected workloads the B300 draws only 36--53\% of its 1100\,W envelope, whereas on ViT-Large, which it wins, both parts saturate at 95--97\% of TDP. Because our harness keeps inputs resident in device memory, a host-side data pipeline is excluded by construction, localizing the cause to per-kernel cost. Two B300 nodes of identical silicon differ by 2.1$\times$ in time-to-first-token solely from a development vLLM build. We give per-workload procurement guidance.

translation.title: 工作负载与Blackwell的匹配：NVIDIA B200与B300在HPC与AI工作负载上的功耗解析基准测试
translation.abstract: 我们在两个独立的八GPU集群上评估NVIDIA B200和B300（Blackwell Ultra）GPU，涵盖计算机视觉推理与训练、使用Llama-3-8B和70B的LLM推理，以及六个生产级HPC代码。B300并非B200的全面升级版：它在卷积推理上落后最多5.6倍，在3D视觉transformer训练上落后8倍，在70B LLM吞吐量上落后24–27%，在双精度Quantum ESPRESSO上落后16倍。我们利用每GPU板卡功耗而非仅吞吐量来解析卷积性能差距：在受影响的工作负载上，B300仅使用其1100 W功耗包络的36–53%，而在其胜出的ViT-Large上，两款芯片均达到TDP的95–97%。由于我们的测试框架将输入常驻设备内存，从构造上排除了主机端数据流水线的影响，将原因定位于单kernel开销。两台硅片完全相同的B300节点仅因开发版vLLM构建而在首token时间上相差2.1倍。我们给出了按工作负载的采购建议。
translation.brief: 针对B300相对B200在部分工作负载上性能反常落后的问题，通过结合板卡功耗与常驻显存的测试框架将性能差异定位于单kernel开销并给出采购建议。

papers.title: Adaptive Coverage Algorithms for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks in Dynamic Worlds
papers.abstract: This paper extends an existing framework for the coordination of mobile agents in unknown worlds, by considering the possibility of dynamic instability. In the original problem, known as the Partially Observable Cooperative Guard Art Gallery Problem (POCGAGP) (arXiv:2512.09495), the multi-agent system must establish a communication network which completely covers an initially unknown constrained space. However, the POCGAGP fails to account for the unpredictability often seen in real-world deployment. To address this, the dynamic case (DPOCGAGP) introduces two settings which can influence the mobile network during deployment: Agent Loss and World Change, which represent dynamic changes to the world. Within this study, we present advancements to two state-of-the-art algorithms, the Centralized Agent-Directed Exploration for Network Coverage (CADENCE), and its decentralized analogue, DADENCE, to provide solutions in these cases. We then compare their performance against another state-of-the-art benchmark algorithm, and show that the adapted algorithms outperform across our benchmark test set, which comprises over 4500 test cases of varied size and structure.

translation.title: 动态世界中移动自组织网络的自适应覆盖算法
translation.abstract: 本文通过考虑动态不稳定的可能性，扩展了未知世界中移动智能体协调的现有框架。在原始问题（即部分可观测协作警卫画廊问题POCGAGP，arXiv:2512.09495）中，多智能体系统必须建立一个完全覆盖初始未知受限空间的通信网络。然而POCGAGP未能考虑现实部署中常见的不确定性。为此，动态情形（DPOCGAGP）引入了两种可在部署过程中影响移动网络的设定：智能体丢失（Agent Loss）和世界变化（World Change），用以表示世界的动态变化。在本研究中，我们对两种最先进算法——集中式的CADENCE（Centralized Agent-Directed Exploration for Network Coverage）及其去中心化对应版本DADENCE——进行了改进，以在这些情形下提供解决方案。随后我们将其与另一个最先进的基准算法进行比较，结果表明改进后的算法在包含4500多个不同规模和结构测试用例的基准测试集上表现更优。
translation.brief: 针对移动智能体网络覆盖中智能体丢失与世界变化等动态扰动问题，改进集中式CADENCE与去中心化DADENCE算法以实现自适应覆盖。

papers.title: When Is a Game a Markov Decision Process? Correspondences Between Game Theory and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning and game theory describe the same object from two sides. Game theory says what a rational outcome of a strategic interaction is; reinforcement learning says how an agent could reach one through experience. The two literatures nevertheless keep separate vocabularies for identical structures, and the treatments that bridge them present the correspondence as analogy rather than theorem. This monograph supplies the theorems. A game is a Markov decision process in three distinct senses, and every table entry is labelled with the one that applies: a definitional identity, an exact reduction carried by a value- and solution-preserving map, or a structural analogy that fails under identifiable conditions. We take every standard class of game, from normal-form through repeated, stochastic, partially observable, extensive-form with imperfect information, Bayesian, graphical, Stackelberg, potential, coalitional, mean-field and evolutionary games, and identify for each the decision-theoretic model that reinforcement learning already studies under another name. The same treatment is applied to solution concepts: Nash equilibrium and the fixed point of the Bellman optimality operator, quantal response equilibrium and the soft Bellman operator, the Shapley value and credit assignment, Blackwell approachability and no-regret learning. We map each model class onto the training procedures sound for it and record the complexity of the associated solution problems. A final part collects the correspondences that do not hold: the non-stationarity that invalidates the independent-learner reduction, the impossibility results that forbid uncoupled convergence to Nash equilibrium, and the gap between the coarse correlated equilibria that no-regret self-play reaches and the correlated equilibria it is credited with.

translation.title: 博弈何时是马尔可夫决策过程？博弈论与强化学习之间的对应关系
translation.abstract: 强化学习与博弈论从两个侧面描述同一对象。博弈论说明策略互动的理性结果是什么；强化学习说明智能体如何通过经验达到这一结果。然而两派文献对相同的结构使用各自独立的术语，且连接二者的论述多将这种对应关系呈现为类比而非定理。本专著提供这些定理。博弈在三种不同意义上是马尔可夫决策过程，每个对应条目都标注了所适用的意义：定义上的同一性、由保值且保解的映射承载的精确归约，或在可识别条件下失效的结构性类比。我们考察每一类标准博弈——从标准型到重复、随机、部分可观测、不完全信息扩展型、贝叶斯、图博弈、Stackelberg、势博弈、联盟、平均场和演化博弈——并为每一类指出强化学习已以另一名称研究的决策论模型。我们对解概念进行同样处理：纳什均衡与Bellman最优算子的不动点、量化响应均衡与软Bellman算子、Shapley值与信用分配、Blackwell可达性与无悔学习。我们将每类模型映射到其适用的训练程序，并记录相关求解问题的复杂度。最后一部分收集不成立的对应关系：使独立学习者归约失效的非平稳性、禁止无悔动态收敛到纳什均衡的不可能性结果，以及无悔自博弈实际达到的粗相关均衡与其被认定的相关均衡之间的差距。
translation.brief: 针对博弈论与强化学习术语割裂、对应关系缺乏定理化的问题，以定理形式系统刻画各类博弈与解概念同强化学习模型之间的精确对应与失效边界。

papers.title: Prune Gradually, Adapt Sparsely: Efficient Pruning of Large Language Models at Extreme Sparsity
papers.abstract: Weight pruning can reduce the storage and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), but preserving quality at high sparsity levels remains challenging. Existing methods face a quality-cost trade-off in this regime. One-shot pruning is cheap but degrades sharply as sparsity increases, even when followed by post-pruning recovery. A growing line of work instead optimizes the mask directly from the dense model under the end-to-end objective; among these methods, [Lee et al.,2026], the recent state of the art at extreme sparsity, reaches high quality but at the cost of model-sized optimizer state and auxiliary variables. To address this gap, we propose ETAPS, which prunes gradually and adapts sparsely: it tightens a global sparsity constraint in progressive stages while training a sparse delta with a small, fixed budget. Our key observation is that gradual weight removal keeps each pruning step small enough for sparse adaptation to compensate, allowing the adapted model to provide end-to-end gradients that guide the next pruning decision without model-sized optimizer state. Across six models from 125M to 13B parameters, ETAPS achieves lower perplexity than ELSA at every evaluated sparsity from 50% to 90%, with perplexity reductions of up to 42%. ETAPS is also far cheaper: at 90% sparsity, it prunes LLaMA2-7B on a single H200, where ELSA uses four, with $5.0\times$ smaller total persistent state and 49% fewer GPU-hours. Together, our findings point to a promising direction for achieving high quality in demanding regimes such as extreme sparsity at substantially lower cost.

translation.title: 渐进剪枝，稀疏适配：极端稀疏度下大语言模型的高效剪枝
translation.abstract: 权重剪枝可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的存储和推理成本，但在高稀疏度下保持模型质量仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在这一区间面临质量与成本的权衡。一次性剪枝虽然成本低，但随着稀疏度增加质量急剧下降，即使加上剪枝后恢复也是如此。越来越多的一系列工作转而在端到端目标下直接从稠密模型优化掩码；其中[Lee et al.,2026]是近期极端稀疏度下的最先进方法，能达到高质量，但代价是模型规模的优化器状态和辅助变量。为填补这一空白，我们提出ETAPS，它渐进剪枝、稀疏适配：在渐进阶段逐步收紧全局稀疏约束，同时以小而固定的预算训练稀疏增量。我们的关键观察是，渐进的权重移除使每一步剪枝足够小，从而稀疏适配能够补偿，使适配后的模型提供端到端梯度来指导下一步剪枝决策，而无需模型规模的优化器状态。在从125M到13B参数的六个模型上，ETAPS在50%到90%的每个评估稀疏度下都比ELSA取得更低的困惑度，困惑度降低最多达42%。ETAPS成本也低得多：在90%稀疏度下，它在单个H200上剪枝LLaMA2-7B，而ELSA需要四个，总持久状态小5.0倍，GPU小时数减少49%。总之，我们的发现为在极端稀疏等严苛场景下以显著更低的成本实现高质量指明了一个有前景的方向。
translation.brief: 解决极端稀疏度下LLM剪枝质量与成本难以兼顾的问题，核心方法是渐进收紧稀疏约束并用小预算稀疏适配提供端到端梯度引导剪枝。

papers.title: SecPO: Principled Adversarial Training for Prompt Injection Security
papers.abstract: Recognized as a top threat to AI agents, prompt injection allows instructions from untrusted data (email, documents, websites) to manipulate the agent's operation. The existing best-defended LLM, Meta-SecAlign, is trained with the DPO loss but still suffers from attack success rates (ASRs) approaching 100% under adaptive prompt injections. One reason is that DPO anchors the model around the undefended reference model, which is insecure. We show an idealized reference model---an injection-invariant, utility-preserving oracle---can nevertheless be approximated, as its output distribution in training is interestingly accessible. This new observation motivates a theoretically principled SecPO loss. Another Meta-SecAlign shortcoming is that it trains on weak simulated attacks. We implement an efficient adversarial training (AT) pipeline that synthesizes strong injected inputs (best@240), and train the model on them. Our AT reduces ASRs by 1.5-14.5$\times$ across three SoTA adaptive attacks, compared with Meta-SecAlign; the SecPO loss reduces them by a further 2.4-4.6$\times$ compared with using DPO loss. In agentic workflows, our SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B is much more secure than Meta-SecAlign: 8.8% vs. 78.8% AgentDojo ASR@800 under the AttackerMovesSecond attack. Moreover, our defended model shows no noticeable reduction in benign utility in nine benchmarks covering agentic tool calling, instruction following, science, and math. We release our $\href{//github.com/Sizhe-Chen/SecPO}{\text{code}}$, $\href{//huggingface.co/datasets/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO-trainset}{\text{training data}}$ (with optimized injections from AT), and $\href{//huggingface.co/Sizhe-Chen/Qwen3.6-27B-Instruct-SecPO}{\text{model}}$.

translation.title: SecPO：面向提示注入安全的原则性对抗训练
translation.abstract: 提示注入被公认为AI智能体的头号威胁，它允许来自不可信数据（电子邮件、文档、网站）的指令操纵智能体的运行。现有防御最强的LLM Meta-SecAlign使用DPO损失训练，但在自适应提示注入下攻击成功率（ASR）仍接近100%。原因之一是DPO将模型锚定在无防御的参考模型上，而该参考模型是不安全的。我们证明一个理想化的参考模型——注入不变且保持效用的oracle——仍然可以被近似，因为其训练中的输出分布有趣地是可获取的。这一新观察促成了理论上更有原则的SecPO损失。Meta-SecAlign的另一个缺陷是它用弱模拟攻击进行训练。我们实现了一个高效的对抗训练（AT）流水线来合成强注入输入（best@240），并在其上训练模型。与Meta-SecAlign相比，我们的AT在三种SoTA自适应攻击下将ASR降低1.5-14.5倍；SecPO损失相比DPO损失进一步降低2.4-4.6倍。在智能体工作流中，我们的SecPO + AT Qwen3.6-27B比Meta-SecAlign安全得多：在AttackerMovesSecond攻击下AgentDojo ASR@800为8.8%对78.8%。此外，我们的防御模型在涵盖智能体工具调用、指令遵循、科学和数学的九个基准上没有明显的良性效用下降。我们发布了代码、训练数据（包含AT优化的注入）和模型。
translation.brief: 解决LLM在自适应提示注入攻击下防御失效的问题，核心方法是提出SecPO损失以近似理想化安全参考模型，并结合强对抗训练合成攻击样本进行训练。

papers.title: AutoAnalysis: An automated, self-updating meta-analysis of human-AI collaboration
papers.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more capable and widely used, understanding when and how humans should work with these systems is becoming increasingly important. However, the empirical evidence in this space offers conflicting recommendations, which leaves individuals and organizations without clear guidance on when to combine human and AI capabilities. Existing meta-analyses can help reconcile these findings, but they require substantial manual effort and cannot readily incorporate new evidence as it emerges. To address this challenge, we introduce AutoAnalysis: an automated, self-updating meta-analysis of when humans and AI work better together, and when they work better alone. AutoAnalysis' most recent run synthesizes 1,955 effect sizes from 420 papers. Across this body of work, we found that, on average, human-AI combinations performed significantly better than humans alone, but they performed significantly worse than the better of humans or AI alone. These findings highlight the important distinction between improving human performance and achieving human-AI synergy and underscore the need to evaluate collaboration against both human and AI performance alone. As new studies emerge, AutoAnalysis will integrate their findings into the meta-analysis, providing cumulative evidence about when humans and AI perform better together and how human-AI performance varies across AI agents, tasks, and processes.

translation.title: AutoAnalysis：人机协作的自动化、自更新元分析
translation.abstract: 随着生成式人工智能（AI）能力增强并被广泛使用，理解人类何时以及如何与这些系统协作变得越来越重要。然而，该领域的实证研究给出了相互矛盾的建议，使个人和组织无法就何时结合人类与AI的能力获得明确指导。现有元分析可以帮助调和这些发现，但需要大量人工工作，且无法方便地纳入新出现的证据。为应对这一挑战，我们提出AutoAnalysis：一个关于人类与AI何时协作更好、何时单独工作更好的自动化、自更新元分析。AutoAnalysis最近一次运行综合了来自420篇论文的1,955个效应量。在这批研究中，我们发现平均而言人机组合的表现显著优于人类单独工作，但显著差于人类或AI中较强的一方。这些发现凸显了提升人类表现与实现人机协同之间的重要区别，并强调需要同时对照人类单独表现和AI单独表现来评估协作。随着新研究的出现，AutoAnalysis将把其发现整合进元分析，提供关于人类与AI何时协作更好以及人机表现如何随AI智能体、任务和流程变化的累积证据。
translation.brief: 解决人机协作实证结论矛盾且元分析难以更新的问题，核心方法是构建自动综合并随新研究自更新的元分析系统。

papers.title: TradeWar: A Benchmark for Execution-Grounded Trade Negotiation with Adaptive LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-turn negotiation remains a challenging problem for large language model (LLM) agents. While LLMs can conduct natural-language dialogue, existing benchmarks predominantly assess only agreement rates, overlooking whether negotiated commitments actually create value once executed. To address this gap, we introduce TradeWar, a multi-country simulation benchmark that translates negotiation dialogues into concrete tariff and trade-share policies, enforces capacity and network constraints during settlement, and evaluates outcomes via an Economic Health Index (EHI). To solve this execution-grounded task, we propose TACTIC (Trade-aware Adaptive Consolidation and Theory-of-mind for International Commerce), an agent that iteratively refines its negotiation strategy across episodes-without updating base LLM weights-by leveraging prior experience, opponent behavior, and past settlement outcomes. Despite using zero-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, PromptLLM attains a 75% agreement rate but only 57.1 final EHI (*100), whereas TACTIC reaches 68.8. Across 20 sequential episodes and three seeds, TACTIC's final EHI improves from 58.2 to 73.2, compared with 65.2 for an ablation without cross-episode updates. Under technology-controls and energy-crisis shocks, TACTIC also exhibits smaller performance degradation than PromptLLM and MemoryLLM. These results indicate that CoT deliberation and interaction memory alone do not fully address delayed execution feedback, whereas settlement-grounded adaptation improves long-horizon negotiation in TradeWar.

translation.title: TradeWar：基于执行落地的自适应LLM智能体贸易谈判基准
translation.abstract: 多轮谈判对大语言模型（LLM）智能体而言仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。虽然LLM可以进行自然语言对话，但现有基准主要只评估达成协议的比率，忽视了谈判达成的承诺在执行后是否真正创造价值。为填补这一空白，我们提出TradeWar，一个多国模拟基准，它将谈判对话转化为具体的关税和贸易份额政策，在结算时强制执行产能和网络约束，并通过经济健康指数（EHI）评估结果。为解决这一以执行为依据的任务，我们提出TACTIC（Trade-aware Adaptive Consolidation and Theory-of-mind for International Commerce），一个跨回合迭代优化谈判策略的智能体——不更新基础LLM权重——通过利用先前经验、对手行为和过往结算结果。尽管仅使用零样本思维链（CoT）提示，PromptLLM达到75%的协议达成率，但最终EHI（*100）仅为57.1，而TACTIC达到68.8。在20个连续回合和三个种子下，TACTIC的最终EHI从58.2提升到73.2，而去除跨回合更新的消融版本为65.2。在技术管制和能源危机冲击下，TACTIC的性能退化也小于PromptLLM和MemoryLLM。这些结果表明，仅靠CoT推理和交互记忆无法完全应对延迟的执行反馈，而基于结算的适配能改善TradeWar中的长程谈判。
translation.brief: 解决现有谈判基准只看协议达成率而忽视执行后价值的问题，核心方法是构建将谈判转化为可执行贸易政策并结算评估的TradeWar基准，以及基于结算反馈跨回合自适应的TACTIC智能体。

papers.title: Know When the Equation Is Wrong: Structural Uncertainty for LLM-Guided Symbolic Regression under Extrapolation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can help discover mathematical equations from data, but most LLM-guided symbolic regression methods focus on a single best equation without quantifying uncertainty over alternative functional forms. This is challenging because distinct equations can fit the observed data similarly while producing substantially different extrapolations. Our experiments on the LLM-SRBench dataset show that standard conformal intervals achieve nominal in-distribution coverage but frequently fail under extrapolation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce LLM-SR-UQ, a framework that retains competing equation structures and uses their disagreement to characterize uncertainty about the underlying functional form. We extend the standard fixed-width conformal approach to quantify structural intervals, which measure disagreement among candidate equations and identify where prediction intervals should widen. Extensive experiments show our framework substantially improves coverage attainment by incorporating structural disagreement while preserving in-distribution coverage. Our approach also shows good generalizability when it is applied to other symbolic-regression methods.

translation.title: 知道方程何时出错：外推下LLM引导符号回归的结构不确定性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以帮助从数据中发现数学方程，但大多数LLM引导的符号回归方法只关注单一最优方程，而不对备选函数形式量化不确定性。这具有挑战性，因为不同的方程可以同样好地拟合观测数据，却产生差异巨大的外推结果。我们在LLM-SRBench数据集上的实验表明，标准的保形区间在分布内达到名义覆盖率，但在外推时经常失效。为应对这一挑战，我们提出LLM-SR-UQ，一个保留相互竞争的方程结构并利用它们之间的分歧来刻画底层函数形式不确定性的框架。我们扩展标准的固定宽度保形方法来量化结构区间，该区间衡量候选方程之间的分歧并指出预测区间应在何处加宽。大量实验表明，我们的框架通过纳入结构分歧显著提高了覆盖率达成，同时保持分布内覆盖率。我们的方法在应用于其他符号回归方法时也表现出良好的泛化性。
translation.brief: 解决LLM引导符号回归在外推时无法量化函数形式不确定性的问题，核心方法是保留多个候选方程结构并以它们之间的分歧构建结构化保形区间。

papers.title: CausalXRL: Explainable Reinforcement Learning through Causal Graph Reasoning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning is a powerful paradigm for training autonomous agents and has achieved impressive performance in complex environments. However, this success often comes at the cost of interpretability, diminishing trust and complicating efforts to debug and improve agent behavior. To address these challenges, we introduce CausalXRL, a novel framework for explainable reinforcement learning (XRL). A key feature of CausalXRL is its use of causal graph reasoning, which provides transparent, structured, multi-level explanations of agent decision-making. We validate CausalXRL through comprehensive case studies and a two-part evaluation: (1) a quantitative analysis of explanation fidelity and causal-structure learning efficiency in benchmark RL environments, and (2) a qualitative expert study assessing explainability in the real-time strategy (RTS) benchmark MicroRTS. The quantitative results show that CausalXRL can provide faithful explanations while efficiently learning causal structures, and the qualitative expert study suggests that participants found CausalXRL useful for inspecting high-level RTS strategies.

translation.title: CausalXRL：通过因果图推理实现可解释强化学习
translation.abstract: 强化学习是训练自主智能体的强大范式，在复杂环境中取得了令人瞩目的性能。然而，这种成功往往以牺牲可解释性为代价，削弱了信任并使调试和改进智能体行为变得困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CausalXRL，一个新颖的可解释强化学习（XRL）框架。CausalXRL的一个关键特性是使用因果图推理，为智能体决策提供透明、结构化、多层次解释。我们通过全面的案例研究和两部分评估验证了CausalXRL：（1）在基准RL环境中对解释忠实度和因果结构学习效率进行定量分析；（2）在即时战略（RTS）基准MicroRTS上进行定性专家研究以评估可解释性。定量结果表明CausalXRL能够提供忠实的解释并高效学习因果结构，定性专家研究表明参与者认为CausalXRL有助于检视高层RTS策略。
translation.brief: 针对强化学习缺乏可解释性的问题，提出通过因果图推理为智能体决策提供透明多层次解释的CausalXRL框架。

papers.title: Beyond Smart Homes: Characterizing IoT Vulnerabilities Across Sectors, Vendors, and Products
papers.abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has expanded beyond consumer smart homes to sectors, such as industrial systems, healthcare, and smart cities, broadening the IoT attack surface. Prior empirical work has focused on studying aggregate IoT vulnerability characteristics or specific protocols, so patching is directed by aggregate security guidance. However, if dominant weaknesses differ substantially across sectors or products, such uniform guidance misdirects the remediation effort. To address this gap, we present a fine-grained, data-driven analysis of IoT vulnerabilities using a dataset of more than 15,000 IoT specific CVEs. We design a pipeline to enrich noisy CPE (Common Platform Enumeration) metadata, normalizing vendors and products, then assigning product type and sector labels using lexical matching, fuzzy clustering, and LLM-assisted classification. We find meaningful differences in the weakness profile of IoT sectors. For example, healthcare is dominated by authentication and credential weaknesses, while automotive faces memory issues. More importantly, we find that weakness profiles are more similar across different product types from the same vendor than across the same product type built by different vendors. This suggests vendor-level factors such as shared code and development practices dominate weakness inheritance, making a vendor's disclosure history informative about its other products. Our findings suggest weakness classes should be used to prioritize remediation efforts.

translation.title: 超越智能家居：跨行业、厂商与产品的IoT漏洞特征分析
translation.abstract: 物联网（IoT）已从消费级智能家居扩展到工业系统、医疗健康和智慧城市等领域，扩大了IoT攻击面。以往的实证工作侧重于研究IoT漏洞的总体特征或特定协议，因此补丁修复由总体安全指南指导。然而，如果主要弱点在不同行业或产品间差异显著，这种统一指南会误导修复工作。为填补这一空白，我们基于超过15,000个IoT特定CVE的数据集，对IoT漏洞进行了细粒度的数据驱动分析。我们设计了一条流水线来丰富嘈杂的CPE（Common Platform Enumeration）元数据，规范化厂商和产品，然后通过词汇匹配、模糊聚类和LLM辅助分类为产品分配类型和行业标签。我们发现IoT各行业的弱点特征存在显著差异。例如，医疗健康行业以认证和凭证弱点为主，而汽车行业则面临内存问题。更重要的是，我们发现同一厂商不同产品类型之间的弱点特征比不同厂商同一产品类型之间更为相似。这表明共享代码和开发实践等厂商层面因素主导了弱点继承，使厂商的漏洞披露历史对其其他产品具有参考价值。我们的发现表明应使用弱点类别来优先安排修复工作。
translation.brief: 针对统一安全指南可能误导IoT漏洞修复的问题，基于1.5万余条CVE构建元数据富化流水线，进行跨行业、厂商和产品的细粒度漏洞特征分析。

papers.title: Same Question, Different Answers: Auditing Persona-Dependent Variation in Six LLMs on Smoking-Cessation Advice
papers.abstract: Hundreds of millions of people now ask large language model (LLM) chatbots for health advice, which raises a question that is simple to pose and hard to answer: does everyone get the same advice? We audit six widely deployed LLMs from four providers on smoking cessation, a domain with codified clini- cal guidance and substantial public-health stakes, by putting the same four cessation questions to twelve user personas that differ in life stage, self-described expertise, and smoking history, for a total of 2,880 responses. What the models say depends on who appears to be asking. Every model named FDA-approved prescription cessation medications less often to teen personas than to adult personas, by 32 to 67 percentage points, and in five of six models a persona presenting health- care expertise received fewer facts than a persona presenting none. We then evaluate one deployable intervention: a short system prompt specifying a factual floor, the set of core med- ical facts every user should receive when they are relevant, while leaving tone, vocabulary, and framing free to adapt. The prompt narrows persona differences in every model, but its effect on overall fact coverage varies in both magnitude and direction across models, so a prompt validated on one system cannot be assumed to transfer to another. Two cautions frame these results. Equal mention rates are not always the correct clinical target, because prescription cessation pharmacother- apy is not recommended for minors, so a defensible factual floor must be age-aware rather than uniform. And because our personas vary on several attributes at once, we report scenario- level differences rather than isolated effects of age or expertise. We release all 2,880 responses and the analysis code.

translation.title: 同一问题，不同答案：审计六个LLM在戒烟建议上依赖用户画像的差异
translation.abstract: 数以亿计的人现在向大语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人寻求健康建议，这引出一个提出容易、回答困难的问题：每个人得到的建议都一样吗？我们审计了来自四家提供商的六个广泛部署的LLM在戒烟领域的表现——该领域有成文的临床指南且涉及重大公共卫生利益——通过向十二个在人生阶段、自述专业水平和吸烟史上各不相同的用户画像提出相同的四个戒烟问题，共获得2,880条回复。模型所说的内容取决于提问者的身份。所有模型对青少年画像提及FDA批准的处方戒烟药物的频率比对成人画像低32至67个百分点，且六个模型中有五个对自称具备医疗专业知识的画像提供的事实更少。随后我们评估了一种可部署的干预措施：一个简短的系统提示词，规定事实底线——即每个用户在相关时都应获得的核心医学事实集合——同时让语气、词汇和表述方式自由适配。该提示词在所有模型中都缩小了画像间差异，但其对整体事实覆盖率的影响在不同模型间幅度和方向各异，因此在一个系统上验证过的提示词不能假定可迁移到另一个系统。两个注意事项贯穿这些结果：同等的提及率并不总是正确的临床目标，因为处方戒烟药物治疗不推荐用于未成年人，所以合理的事实底线必须具备年龄感知而非一刀切；由于我们的画像同时变化多个属性，我们报告的是场景级差异而非年龄或专业水平的孤立效应。我们公开了全部2,880条回复和分析代码。
translation.brief: 针对LLM健康建议是否因用户画像而异的问题，用12个画像×4个戒烟问题审计六个LLM共2,880条回复，并评估规定事实底线的系统提示词干预效果。

papers.title: RAMA: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Routing with Episodic Memory for LEO Satellite Networks
papers.abstract: Low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks present a challenging routing environment due to rapidly changing topology, traffic, and link conditions. Existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) routing methods typically rely on current observations and information encoded in network weights, limiting their ability to exploit successful past experiences. We propose RAMA, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent DRL framework with Approximate Information State (AIS), in which each satellite combines its local observation, recent routing history, neighboring state information, and retrieved entries from a per-satellite episodic memory. Retrieved experiences are integrated through a Transformer-based decision network trained with AIS-based auxiliary objectives. With weights frozen in a 140-satellite Kepler constellation, RAMA reduces mean end-to-end latency by 13.4% and 99th-percentile latency by 66.7% relative to the state-of-theart double deep Q-network (DDQN) routing method, mainly by avoiding long detours. Updated online, RAMA remains stable while DDQN degrades. On the 1,584-satellite Starlink shell 1, the reduction in mean latency grows to 93.2%, and updating RAMA online lowers its mean latency by a further 25.5%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of retrieval-augmented memory for scalable decentralized routing in LEO satellite networks.

translation.title: RAMA：面向LEO卫星网络的检索增强多智能体情景记忆路由
translation.abstract: 低轨（LEO）卫星网络由于拓扑、流量和链路条件快速变化，是一个具有挑战性的路由环境。现有的深度强化学习（DRL）路由方法通常依赖当前观测和网络权重中编码的信息，限制了其利用过去成功经验的能力。我们提出RAMA，一个结合近似信息状态（AIS）的检索增强多智能体DRL框架，其中每颗卫星结合其本地观测、近期路由历史、邻居状态信息以及从每卫星情景记忆中检索到的条目。检索到的经验通过基于Transformer的决策网络整合，该网络使用基于AIS的辅助目标进行训练。在140颗卫星的Kepler星座中冻结权重的情况下，RAMA相比最先进的double deep Q-network（DDQN）路由方法将平均端到端时延降低13.4%，99分位时延降低66.7%，主要通过避免长绕路实现。在线更新时，RAMA保持稳定而DDQN性能退化。在1,584颗卫星的Starlink shell上，平均时延降幅扩大到93.2%，在线更新RAMA进一步将其平均时延降低25.5%。这些结果证明了检索增强记忆对LEO卫星网络可扩展去中心化路由的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对LEO卫星网络中DRL路由无法利用历史成功经验的问题，提出结合情景记忆检索与AIS的多智能体DRL框架RAMA。

papers.title: Think in 360°: Benchmarking and Bootstrapping Panoramic Video Reasoning
papers.abstract: A panoramic video captures all directions around the camera, but relevant evidence can appear in different directions and at different times. Understanding it requires models to connect observations across the viewing sphere and time. We introduce PanoVideoBench, the first manually annotated benchmark for comprehensive panoramic video understanding. Its 1,000 questions span five categories and 15 question types, with diagnostic annotations for target search and panoramic capabilities. Evaluation of 11 proprietary, open-source, and panoramic-specialized models identifies cross-view tracking and sphere-time evidence integration as their weakest capabilities. To strengthen these capabilities, we construct PanoVideoCoT, the first reasoning dataset grounded in real panoramic video, through sphere-time-grounded synthesis that converts verified panoramic observations and successful agentic explorations into 13,465 QA-CoT pairs. Starting from a general video MLLM, PanoVideoReasoner learns from this corpus through Panoramic CoT SFT and Evidence-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation, a panoramic instantiation of Vision-OPD's OPSD in which the teacher uses verified perspective views to guide student-generated trajectories. It reaches 55.7% on PanoVideoBench, improving the backbone by 12.5 points and the previous SOTA by 2.6. The gains concentrate on the same spatial, cross-view, and temporal capabilities exposed by the benchmark, showing that grounded sphere-time supervision can equip a general video MLLM with panoramic reasoning.

translation.title: 360°思考：全景视频推理的基准测试与能力提升
translation.abstract: 全景视频捕捉相机周围所有方向，但相关证据可能出现在不同方向和不同时间。理解它需要模型连接跨观察球面和时间的观测。我们提出PanoVideoBench，首个用于全面全景视频理解的人工标注基准。其1,000个问题涵盖五个类别和15种问题类型，并带有针对目标搜索和全景能力的诊断性标注。对11个专有、开源和全景专用模型的评估发现跨视角跟踪和球面-时间证据整合是其最弱的能力。为强化这些能力，我们构建了PanoVideoCoT，首个基于真实全景视频的推理数据集，通过球面-时间接地的合成方法，将经验证的全景观测和成功的智能体探索转化为13,465个QA-CoT对。从一个通用视频MLLM出发，PanoVideoReasoner通过Panoramic CoT SFT和Evidence-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation（Vision-OPD的OPSD在全景上的实例化，教师使用经验证的透视图指导学生生成的轨迹）从该语料库学习。它在PanoVideoBench上达到55.7%，比骨干模型提升12.5分，比之前的SOTA提升2.6分。提升集中在基准所揭示的相同空间、跨视角和时间能力上，表明接地的球面-时间监督可以为通用视频MLLM配备全景推理能力。
translation.brief: 针对全景视频理解中跨视角跟踪与球面-时间证据整合能力薄弱的问题，构建首个全景视频推理基准PanoVideoBench和推理数据集PanoVideoCoT，并通过CoT SFT与自蒸馏训练PanoVideoReasoner。

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
papers.abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. We study this interplay systematically, training SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks augmented with controlled levels of observation and action noise. We find that plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness on the two harder tasks, with their advantage growing as observation noise increases, while combining resets with layer normalization underperforms resets alone at every observation noise level tested. Further, stochasticity can accelerate the loss of plasticity in harder environments, whereas in easier settings noise can act as a regularizer that sustains plasticity. Lastly, plasticity loss is most pronounced in the early stages of training. In the most challenging stochastic settings, TD instability rather than gradual plasticity loss becomes the dominant failure mode.

translation.title: 理解随机环境中可塑性损失对强化学习的影响
translation.abstract: 深度强化学习（RL）是序列决策的强大框架。尽管近年来取得了许多瞩目的成功，深度RL的脆弱性众所周知。一系列新兴研究将这种脆弱性归因于神经网络的可塑性损失。然而，可塑性损失在随机环境中迄今研究不足。我们系统地研究了这种相互作用，在三个增加了可控观测和动作噪声水平的DeepMind Control任务上训练SAC智能体。我们发现，可塑性保持方法在两个较难的任务上提高了学习鲁棒性，其优势随观测噪声增加而扩大，而在所有测试的观测噪声水平下，将重置与层归一化结合的表现均不如单独使用重置。此外，随机性在较难的环境中会加速可塑性损失，而在较简单的环境中，噪声可以起到维持可塑性的正则化作用。最后，可塑性损失在训练早期阶段最为显著。在最具挑战性的随机设置中，TD不稳定性而非渐进的可塑性损失成为主导的失败模式。
translation.brief: 研究随机噪声环境下强化学习可塑性损失的影响，通过在带可控噪声的DeepMind Control任务上训练SAC智能体进行系统实验分析。

papers.title: Strategic Tanking in Stable Matching Markets
papers.abstract: Motivated by a broad literature in psychology, organizational behavior, and matching markets, we introduce strategic tanking: an agent deliberately makes themselves less attractive to selected potential partners in order to improve their eventual assignment. Unlike traditional manipulation in stable matching, a tanker does not misreport whom they prefer; instead, they influence how others rank them. We show that tanking has a striking connection to classical preference manipulation. Cutoff tanking, in which an agent tanks with every potential partner below a chosen threshold, has exactly the same effect on the stable set as truncating one's own preference list at that threshold. Thus an agent can reproduce the power of a classical truncation while leaving their own preferences unchanged and every match acceptable. Arbitrary tanking, however, can go substantially further: under proposer-deferred acceptance, tanking equilibria can lie outside the sincere stable set. More broadly, whenever the sincere stable set contains multiple matchings, profitable strategic behavior remains available through either traditional preference manipulation or tanking, even when one side is restricted to honestly reporting their own preferences.

translation.title: 稳定匹配市场中的战略性摆烂
translation.abstract: 受心理学、组织行为学和匹配市场广泛文献的启发，我们引入战略性摆烂：智能体故意降低自己在选定潜在伙伴眼中的吸引力，以改善其最终匹配结果。与稳定匹配中的传统操纵不同，摆烂者并不误报自己的偏好，而是影响他人对自己的排名。我们证明摆烂与经典偏好操纵有惊人的联系。截断式摆烂，即智能体对低于所选阈值的每个潜在伙伴都摆烂，对稳定集的影响恰好等同于在该阈值处截断自己的偏好列表。因此，智能体可以在不改变自身偏好且所有匹配均可接受的情况下复现经典截断的威力。然而，任意摆烂可以走得更远：在提议者延迟接受算法下，摆烂均衡可以位于真实稳定集之外。更广泛地说，只要真实稳定集包含多个匹配，即使一方被限制只能诚实报告自己的偏好，仍可通过传统偏好操纵或摆烂获得有利可图的策略行为。
translation.brief: 研究稳定匹配市场中通过故意降低自身吸引力（摆烂）而非误报偏好来改善匹配结果的操纵策略，并分析其与经典截断操纵的等价关系及更强的操纵能力。

papers.title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
papers.abstract: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

translation.title: 基于层次树结构索引器的次二次注意力
translation.abstract: 注意力的二次方扩展是限制大语言模型（LLM）长上下文能力的根本瓶颈。已有多种方法试图绕过这一问题，但它们要么无法匹配注意力的表达能力（如具有固定大小状态的滑动窗口或线性注意力变体），要么只能实现常数倍的加速（如索引器本身按二次方扩展的稀疏注意力方法）。本文提出一种基于层次树结构索引器的渐近次二次稀疏注意力方法，称为Zyphra Hierarchical Attention（ZHA）。ZHA在KV缓存上构建一棵递归压缩的键摘要树，未来的查询自顶向下遍历该树以检索稀疏的键子集。关键在于，通过迭代增长树的深度，包括路由和最终注意力在内的总成本随序列长度次线性增长，使注意力整体呈次二次（但超线性）扩展。我们证明ZHA可以低成本地应用于现有预训练模型，只需在数十亿token上进行短暂的KL蒸馏训练，并在长上下文检索以及具有挑战性的推理、数学和智能体编程评测任务上保持性能。此外，我们证明该方法对树几何结构高度鲁棒，包括多达6层的非常深的树。最后，我们建立了详细的性能模型，表明我们的方法呈次二次扩展，在超过100万上下文时大幅超越竞争方法，并最终有潜力将有效上下文窗口扩展到数亿或数十亿token。
translation.brief: 提出基于层次树结构索引器的稀疏注意力方法ZHA，通过递归压缩的键摘要树实现次二次复杂度的长上下文注意力。

papers.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
papers.abstract: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. When the same context is reused across models, however, each newly selected target model typically has to process it again, repeatedly incurring substantial computational costs. Therefore, we propose ACCT (Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer), which targets KV cache transfer between models of different scales within the same model family. ACCT transforms the KV cache produced by a source model into sparse KV states that can be directly consumed by a target model, thereby enabling cross-model reuse of context computation and decoupling context computation from downstream inference. ACCT consists of three lightweight components: the Cartographer identifies query-relevant context tokens for each target layer and KV head; the Allocator determines how many context tokens each target layer and KV head retains under a shared total KV budget; and the Compiler transforms selected source KV into sparse target KV. The target model can therefore perform inference using the transferred KV without reprocessing the original context. We evaluate ACCT in two complementary settings comprising five general-capability benchmarks and six highly context-dependent tasks. Experiments show that ACCT matches or exceeds the target model's original inference performance even when reducing the KV cache size by 75%. At a context length of approximately 19K tokens, ACCT's KV conversion achieves a 6.5-21.2 times speedup over target context prefill. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transferring context computation across models under a limited KV budget.

translation.title: ACCT：非对称跨LLM上下文迁移
translation.abstract: 在实际部署中，大语言模型（LLM）系统正日益从单模型调用演变为动态调用不同模型进行推理的异构部署。然而，当同一上下文在不同模型间复用时，每个新选定的目标模型通常必须重新处理它，反复产生大量计算成本。因此，我们提出ACCT（非对称跨LLM上下文迁移），针对同一模型家族内不同规模模型之间的KV缓存迁移。ACCT将源模型产生的KV缓存转换为可被目标模型直接消费的稀疏KV状态，从而实现上下文计算的跨模型复用，并将上下文计算与下游推理解耦。ACCT由三个轻量组件组成：Cartographer为每个目标层和KV头识别与查询相关的上下文token；Allocator在共享的总KV预算下决定每个目标层和KV头保留多少上下文token；Compiler将选定的源KV转换为稀疏的目标KV。因此目标模型可以使用迁移的KV进行推理，而无需重新处理原始上下文。我们在包含五个通用能力基准和六个高度依赖上下文任务的两种互补设置中评估ACCT。实验表明，即使将KV缓存大小减少75%，ACCT也能达到或超过目标模型原有的推理性能。在约19K token的上下文长度下，ACCT的KV转换相比目标上下文预填充实现6.5-21.2倍的加速。这些结果证明了在有限KV预算下跨模型迁移上下文计算的可行性。
translation.brief: 提出ACCT方法，通过将源模型的KV缓存转换为稀疏KV状态供目标模型直接使用，实现同家族不同规模LLM间的上下文计算复用。

papers.title: Where ADS Crashes Differ: A Harmonized Comparison Against Human Baselines
papers.abstract: Crash-rate comparisons between automated driving systems (ADS) and human drivers require an exposure denominator that only a few operators publish. We instead ask a composition question: given a crash, does the mix of crash types differ between ADS and human-driven vehicles? The question needs no mileage and can therefore cover every ADS operator. We assemble the NHTSA Standing General Order (SGO) ADS incident files across both file generations into 2,450 distinct in-scope incidents (2021-2026), of which 828 fall within the 2021-2024 window covered by the Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), the national police-reported human comparator. A schema-constrained large language model (LLM) codes each SGO narrative into the CRSS crash-type taxonomy. Because SGO compels reporting far below the police-reporting threshold, we bracket reportability with an objective severity floor and a reasonable-person rubric, and claim a difference only where it survives both. Two composition differences hold under every reportability definition, tow definition and weighting of the human side, and under both definitions of driverless operation: turn-across-path crashes are under-represented among ADS crashes (0.23-0.46x the CRSS share under the primary driverless definition) and so are single-vehicle crashes (0.19-0.56x). In severity-floor rear-end crashes the ADS vehicle is the striking party at a quasi-induced-exposure ratio of 0.121 (95% CI [0.05, 0.23]) against a human baseline of 1.000. If the ADS vehicle is also struck more often than its exposure implies, this ratio overstates the ADS-human difference. We also document three pitfalls in the federal data: an operator-specific coding of driverless operation, a tow-away criterion confounded by fleet recovery practice, and an occupancy confound that accounts for about 42% of the apparent ADS-human severity gap.

translation.title: 自动驾驶系统事故的差异所在：与人类基线的统一比较
translation.abstract: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）与人类驾驶员之间的事故率比较需要只有少数运营商公布的风险暴露分母。我们转而提出一个构成性问题：给定一起事故，ADS与人类驾驶车辆的事故类型构成是否不同？该问题无需行驶里程，因此可以覆盖所有ADS运营商。我们将NHTSA Standing General Order（SGO）两个文件版本的ADS事故文件汇总为2,450起不同的范围内事故（2021-2026），其中828起落在Crash Report Sampling System（CRSS）覆盖的2021-2024窗口内，CRSS是全国警察报告的人类对照数据。一个受模式约束的大语言模型（LLM）将每份SGO叙述编码为CRSS事故类型分类。由于SGO要求报告远低于警察报告阈值的事故，我们用客观严重性下限和合理人标准来界定可报告性，只在两种界定下都成立的差异上做出结论。两个构成差异在所有可报告性定义、拖车定义和人类侧加权方式以及两种无人驾驶操作定义下均成立：横穿转弯事故在ADS事故中占比偏低（在主要无人驾驶定义下为CRSS份额的0.23-0.46倍），单车事故同样偏低（0.19-0.56倍）。在严重性下限的追尾事故中，ADS车辆作为撞击方的准诱导暴露比为0.121（95% CI [0.05, 0.23]），而人类基线为1.000。如果ADS车辆被撞的频率也高于其暴露所隐含的水平，该比值会高估ADS与人类的差异。我们还记录了联邦数据中的三个陷阱：运营商特定的无人驾驶操作编码、受车队回收实践混淆的拖车标准，以及可解释约42%表面ADS-人类严重性差距的乘员混淆。
translation.brief: 通过分析NHTSA事故报告的事故类型构成而非事故率，用LLM将事故叙述编码为统一分类，比较自动驾驶系统与人类驾驶员的事故构成差异。

papers.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
papers.abstract: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditional feedback to directly supervise those scores. Combined with offline ranking supervision, DecisionRank achieves state-of-the-art performance on both general and reasoning-intensive retrieval benchmarks such as TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT. Across four benchmarks, item-space OPD consistently outperforms alternative training objectives. Even at 1.7B parameters, DecisionRank surpasses its 27B generative teacher on TREC DL19--23. At 8B, it outperforms its generative listwise counterpart while running $24.5\times$ faster on TREC DL and $16.7\times$ faster on BRIGHT.

translation.title: DecisionRank：面向决策模型重排器的在线策略蒸馏
translation.abstract: 决策模型通过直接预测选择或分数来处理结构化任务，避免了自回归解码的延迟。然而，将生成式 LLM 的排序知识迁移到决策模型仍然具有挑战性：教师模型通过文档 ID 序列的排序列表表达偏好，而学生模型则利用首 token 位置的分数确定排序。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 DecisionRank，一种通过 item 空间在线策略蒸馏（OPD）训练的决策模型。Item 空间 OPD 通过将学生模型的文档分数排序为有序序列来构建其 rollout。生成式教师模型以得到的排序列表作为输入，提供条件反馈以直接监督这些分数。结合离线排序监督，DecisionRank 在 TREC DL、BEIR 和 BRIGHT 等通用及推理密集型检索基准上取得了最先进的性能。在四个基准上，item 空间 OPD 持续优于其他训练目标。即使仅有 1.7B 参数，DecisionRank 在 TREC DL19–23 上也超越了其 27B 的生成式教师模型。在 8B 规模下，它优于其生成式 listwise 对应模型，同时在 TREC DL 上快 24.5 倍，在 BRIGHT 上快 16.7 倍。
translation.brief: 解决生成式 LLM 排序知识难以迁移到决策模型的问题，核心方法是通过 item 空间在线策略蒸馏，让教师模型对学生分数排序结果提供条件反馈监督。

papers.title: Dittany: Contribution-Guided Repair Framework for MAS Applications
papers.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) applications can produce useful intermediate results while leaving task requirements unsatisfied. Repairing such executions requires identifying the work still needed and the completed results that can support it. We present \tool, a contribution-guided runtime repair framework for MAS applications. \tool derives expected contributions and acceptance conditions from task requirements and method specifications, and connects their dependencies in a contribution graph. Runtime checks locate unmet conditions and establish which results remain usable. These results guide action-level correction when available inputs suffice, or graph-level recovery when prerequisites or unfinished work need revision. Both repair scopes retain validated contributions and check repaired outputs before subsequent work uses them. We evaluate \tool on 30 applications across six MAS frameworks and 9,000 tasks. It detects runtime failures with 88.28\% precision and 79.18\% recall, and achieves 84.76\% task accuracy, improving over Native execution by 26.74 percentage points and the strongest of four recovery baselines by 21.28 points. Estimated deployment token consumption is 17.92\% above Native, but 24.19\% below Reflexion and 13.05\% below Iterative Rollback. Ablation results show that combining the two repair scopes achieves higher accuracy and lower token consumption than graph-level repair alone.

translation.title: Dittany：面向 MAS 应用的贡献引导修复框架
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）应用可能产生有用的中间结果，却未能满足任务需求。修复此类执行需要识别尚需完成的工作以及可支持该工作的已完成结果。我们提出 Dittany，一个面向 MAS 应用的贡献引导运行时修复框架。Dittany 从任务需求和方法规范中推导预期贡献与接受条件，并将其依赖关系连接成贡献图。运行时检查定位未满足的条件，并确定哪些结果仍然可用。这些结果在可用输入充足时指导动作级修正，或在先决条件或未完成工作需要修订时进行图级恢复。两种修复范围均保留已验证的贡献，并在后续工作使用修复输出前对其进行检查。我们在六个 MAS 框架的 30 个应用和 9,000 个任务上评估 Dittany。它以 88.28% 的精确率和 79.18% 的召回率检测运行时故障，达到 84.76% 的任务准确率，比 Native 执行提升 26.74 个百分点，比四个恢复基线中最强者提升 21.28 个百分点。估计部署 token 消耗比 Native 高 17.92%，但比 Reflexion 低 24.19%，比 Iterative Rollback 低 13.05%。消融结果表明，结合两种修复范围比仅用图级修复获得更高准确率和更低 token 消耗。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 多智能体系统执行失败后的修复问题，核心方法是从任务需求构建贡献图，通过运行时检查定位未满足条件并执行动作级或图级修复。

papers.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
papers.abstract: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. By prioritizing local physical feasibility over global behavioral patterns, ID-WM synthesizes novel long-horizon plans from short segments, transcending the specific behavioral modes seen during training. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three navigation and manipulation suites, achieving a 38.5% improvement over state-of-the-art policy and diffusion-based planners. Crucially, by leveraging this hierarchical structure to mitigate compounding errors, our approach yields a 135% performance gain over single-level world model MPC, particularly in complex, unseen configurations for long-horizon tasks. Videos can be viewed at this https URL

translation.title: 具有隐式动力学的分层世界模型
translation.abstract: 利用世界模型进行规划使具身智能体能够进行测试时适应，相比直接策略学习具有更强的泛化能力。然而，长时程任务仍受累积误差和搜索复杂度的制约。现有分层方法通常使用僵化的宏动作或潜在技能，导致表示脆弱且细粒度控制受限。我们提出 ID-WM（隐式动力学世界模型），一种将状态空间可达性与局部控制解耦的分层世界模型。我们的框架利用高层模型在状态流形上采样可行转移，并利用低层世界模型作为逆动力学求解器将这些转移落地为精确动作。这使规划器能够识别可达子目标，而不受低层执行细节的约束。通过优先考虑局部物理可行性而非全局行为模式，ID-WM 从短片段合成新颖的长时程计划，超越训练中见到的特定行为模式。我们在三个导航与操作套件上验证了其有效性，相比最先进的策略和基于扩散的规划器取得 38.5% 的提升。关键的是，通过利用这种分层结构缓解误差累积，我们的方法相比单层世界模型 MPC 取得 135% 的性能提升，尤其是在长时程任务的复杂未见配置中。视频可访问此 https URL 查看。
translation.brief: 解决长时程任务中世界模型规划的累积误差与搜索复杂度问题，核心方法是分层解耦状态可达性与局部控制，用高层模型采样可行转移、低层逆动力学模型落地为动作。

papers.title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
papers.abstract: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. Yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. We address this with Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. In LSA, keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space, and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key, making prefill, decode and training faster at long context. We propose two variants, Distilled-LSA (D-LSA), which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation, and Native-LSA (N-LSA), which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. On GLM-5.3-FLASH (QWEN-3.8-27B) at 10M tokens, D-LSA speeds up one attention layer by 22.7x (72.4x) in prefill and 4.6x (42.5x) in decode over its original sparse attention (full attention), while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. N-LSA matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6x per layer at 128k tokens. LSA offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.

translation.title: 潜在稀疏注意力：迈向亚二次复杂度的超长上下文注意力
translation.abstract: 智能体工作流日益转向长时程任务，如开放式科学研究，模型可从长上下文窗口中受益。然而，在超长上下文（超过 1M token）下，全注意力的代价过高。一种有前景的方法是稀疏注意力，由专用索引器为注意力选择键的子集。然而当前的索引方法要么仍具有关于上下文长度的二次复杂度，要么在超长上下文规模下损失精度。我们提出潜在稀疏注意力（LSA），一种在超长上下文下保持精度的高效注意力方法。在 LSA 中，键在学习的潜在空间中被分层聚类，查询对聚类层次进行打分而非对每个键打分，使预填充、解码和训练在长上下文下更快。我们提出两个变体：Distilled-LSA（D-LSA），可通过蒸馏应用于预训练模型；Native-LSA（N-LSA），仅用下一 token 损失原生训练。在 GLM-5.3-FLASH（QWEN-3.8-27B）的 10M token 下，D-LSA 相比其原始稀疏注意力（全注意力）在预填充阶段将单层注意力加速 22.7 倍（72.4 倍），解码阶段加速 4.6 倍（42.5 倍），同时在多种任务上保持相近精度。N-LSA 在 128k token 下匹配全注意力精度，且每层训练加速 1.6 倍。LSA 为模型利用超长上下文提供了实用且高效的注意力机制。
translation.brief: 解决超长上下文下全注意力代价过高而现有稀疏索引方法二次复杂度或精度损失的问题，核心方法是在学习的潜在空间中分层聚类键，让查询对聚类层次打分而非逐键打分。

papers.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
papers.abstract: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and decision models demonstrate that Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance. By unifying physical execution throughput with mathematical exactness, Flide establishes a principled foundation for scalable, latency-critical decision intelligence in agent systems.

translation.title: Flide：通过精确状态分叉加速决策推理
translation.abstract: 以 Jev 为代表的决策模型已成为 LLM 智能体系统中极具前景的范式，为快速 System One 执行提供轻量可靠的分类推理。然而，现有的面向生成的推理引擎无法有效支持这些工作负载，存在严重的 prefix 重计算开销或输出概率失真问题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Flide，一个高效且精确的推理引擎，它将决策请求的逻辑树结构与单一扁平化 token 流中的物理执行解耦。通过 ForkAttention，Flide 使用驻留 GPU 的索引在标准注意力和循环 Gated DeltaNet 层中导航请求依赖，以精确算术保证每个查询分支的求值与隔离前向传播完全一致。通过将分支拓扑直接表达为 GPU 驻留元数据，Flide 以一组紧凑的预录制执行图适应多样的请求组合，同时使不断扩展的智能体历史能够从先前保存的检查点恢复。在公开混合模型和决策模型上的大量评估表明，Flide 的查询响应速度最高比 vLLM 和 SGLang 快 9.5 倍，同时在总变差距离上最接近 float32 参考值。通过将物理执行吞吐量与数学精确性相统一，Flide 为智能体系统中可扩展、延迟敏感的决策智能奠定了原则性基础。
translation.brief: 解决现有推理引擎处理决策模型工作负载时 prefix 重计算开销大或输出概率失真的问题，核心方法是通过 ForkAttention 将请求的逻辑树结构与扁平化 token 流中的物理执行解耦，实现精确状态分叉。
